title: Practice Associate
description:
Who We Are:

Join our innovative team at NHOMS | MassOMS and play an essential role in creating outstanding experiences for our clients, partners, and communities. By embracing our core values of innovation, compassion, accessibility, and one team, you will play a part in a mission to make a lasting impact on our organization's growth and success.


Our core values center around healing first for our patients. Members of our team approach each day with compassion for both patients and colleagues. We promote innovation on every level and ensure we are accessible to one another as we work as one team.


We are searching for individuals who can help us continue pursuing our goal of reaching prospective patients and helping to transform their lives - all while having a little fun!


Position Summary:

The Practice Associate plays a pivotal role in the efficient and smooth functioning of the clinic. This multifaceted position requires a candidate with a strong organizational skill set, excellent communication abilities, and a comprehensive understanding of medical office operations. The primary responsibilities include coordinating administrative tasks, managing patient interactions, and supporting the healthcare team to ensure the delivery of high-quality patient care.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Assisting patients with check-in and check-out procedures, managing telephone calls, and addressing inquiries.
  • Effectively communicate with referring practices, patients, and teammates.
  • Schedule appointments for the practice to optimize patient satisfaction, surgeon time, and the most effective use of treatment rooms.
  • Independently and accurately complete treatment planning and benefits verification.
  • Create, access, and verify patient records in Open Dental, retrieve patient files, prepare flow charts, and place charts in sequence for surgeon examination.
  • Maintain the reception area in a neat and orderly condition.
  • Receive letters, packages, etc., and distribute them accordingly.
  • Prepare outgoing mail and packages, dropping them off at mail facilities for processing.
  • Check, sort, forward, and respond to emails and any correspondence from teammates.
  • Collaborate with all teammates and organizational levels, including Marketing, Human Resources, Operations and RCM teams.
  • Perform closing procedures at the end of the day, including depositing cash and checks.
  • Take up other duties as assigned.

title: Product Manager, Multi-Family & CRE
description:
About EyeQ Monitoring

EyeQ Monitoring is a fast-growing leader in AI-driven remote video monitoring, delivering real-time security, operational intelligence, and business visibility across industries like automotive, multifamily, commercial real estate, construction, and retail.

Our solutions combine live monitoring, IoT-enabled camera technology, intelligent deterrence, and investigative support to help customers protect their properties, reduce risk, and make smarter business decisions. As we continue to grow, we are looking for team members who are excited to help build scalable, thoughtful, and customer-focused solutions that make a real impact.

About the Role

The Product Manager owns the Multi-Family & Commercial Real Estate vertical at EyeQ Monitoring — including retail stores and shopping centers. This person is responsible for the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for IoT and camera-based solutions serving these customers, including how Virtual Guard, License Plate Management, Forensics, and Case Management are configured, packaged, and extended for vertical-specific needs. They are the voice of the Multi-Family/CRE customer inside EyeQ and the owner of the vertical's product P&L narrative.

Here at EyeQ, people matter. Any new team members we bring on have to live and breathe our core values, just like we do.

  • We value trusted partnerships.
    We believe in transparent, reliable, and growing relationships with our team and customers—and we turn away people and businesses that don’t fit.
  • We build to last.
    We focus on long-term solutions and spend the time upfront to ensure our work is done right the first time.
  • We take the hill.
    We lean into challenges, push into new technology frontiers, and solve problems others avoid. We value speed, ownership, and people we trust to run toward the hard things together.
  • We enjoy the journey.
    We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We’re proud of what we’re building and the team we get to build it with.


Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product roadmap for the Multi-Family & Commercial Real Estate vertical
  • Define and prioritize product investments based on customer needs and business goals
  • Drive product strategy across Virtual Guard, License Plate Management, Forensics, Case Management, and future vertical-specific capabilities
  • Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, and business impact when making roadmap decisions

Customer Discovery & Market Expertise

  • Build strong relationships with Multi-Family, CRE, retail, and shopping center customers
  • Conduct customer interviews and field visits to understand operational workflows and pain points
  • Gather customer feedback and translate insights into prioritized product initiatives
  • Represent the voice of the customer throughout the product development lifecycle

Product Development

  • Partner closely with Engineering and IoT teams to deliver high-quality product enhancements
  • Write clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Participate in sprint planning, prioritization, and feature validation
  • Ensure successful delivery of roadmap commitments

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing on product positioning, messaging, launches, and demos
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success on pricing, packaging, rollout strategies, and customer adoption
  • Communicate roadmap priorities and product updates across the organization
  • Represent EyeQ at customer meetings, advisory boards, and industry events

Product Performance

  • Define and measure product success through adoption, retention, expansion, customer satisfaction, and competitive performance
  • Conduct competitive analysis to identify market opportunities and product differentiation
  • Continuously refine strategy based on customer feedback, market trends, and business performance

title: Certified Residential Medication Aide (CRMA) - Weekend Warrior (Fri-Sun)
description:

title: Intake Navigator
description:
Summary:

The Intake Navigator is responsible for the end-to-end coordination and management of patient referrals within the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. This role serves as a primary point of contact for electronic referral workflows, ensuring referrals from both internal and external providers are efficiently retrieved, reviewed, and processed. The Intake Navigator supports seamless transitions of care by collaborating closely with clinical teams and specialists while managing referral activity within the EHR environment.

Key Responsibilites

  • EHR Referral Management: Monitor, retrieve, and process referrals from EHR work queues, electronic referral portals, and in-basket messages in a timely manner.
  • Intake & Review: Evaluate incoming referrals for completeness and accuracy, ensuring all required documentation (e.g., demographics, clinical notes, discharge summary/orders) is included before acceptance.
  • Insurance Verification: Perform insurance eligibility checks, confirm in-network status, and obtain necessary prior authorizations to support referral processing.
  • Clinical Liaison: Collaborate with clinical staff to redirect referrals that do not meet criteria and escalate complex or unclear cases to providers for further review.
  • Data Accuracy & Documentation: Accurately upload, scan, and attach referral documentation into the EHR and intake systems to ensure compliance, completeness, and audit readiness.
  • Communication & Coordination: Serve as a liaison between referring sources/providers, specialty offices, and patients to confirm referral receipt, communicate status updates, and assist with appointment scheduling.
  • Closing the Loop: Ensure referrals are properly documented and closed within the EHR, including obtaining and attaching specialist consultation notes when applicable.

  • You could get paid to fold t-shirts or you could get paid to act like a dinosaur. The choice is yours.
  • This may not be your career, but we are surely going to train you like it is.
But seriously read the fine print…
With more than 300 locations across the globe, The Little Gym is the world’s premier enrichment and physical development center for kids 4 months through 12 years. For over four decades, The Little Gym has helped millions of kids experience the thrill of achievement, develop new skills, and find new confidence through a variety of gymnastics-based programs. Parent/Child, Pre-K, and Grade School classes are all taught in a clean, fun, safe, and nurturing environment, which encourages children to develop at their own pace.

As a part of The Little Gym team, you will be part of a family dedicated to the growth and development of children all over the globe. If this sounds like the job you’ve been dreaming about, what are you waiting for? We’ve been waiting for you!

title: Teamchef 2:a färskvaror, Willys Ronneby Centrum
description:
Vi är alla olika. Och det är härligt! Vi anställer inte människor efter en viss mall utan efter vem du är. För oss är driv och personlighet viktigare än erfarenhet och bakgrund. Det går bra för oss, och vi växer så det knakar. Nu söker vi fler glada medarbetare med rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas!

Om jobbet

Vi söker dig som gillar mat, människor och försäljning och vill bli en del av vårt härliga gäng på Willys Ronneby Centrum! Tjänsten innebär kort och gott att du bidrar till att våra kunder kan handla bra och hållbar mat till riktigt bra priser, samtidigt som du förbereds att ta klivet till att bli en ledare på Willys.

Tjänsten avser: Vikariat på heltid t.o.m. 2027-08-31.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetstider: Du kommer att variera mellan att arbeta tidig morgon, dagtid, kvällar och helger.

Krav: Gymnasial utbildning, goda kunskaper i svenska (tal och skrift). Vi välkomnar sökande i alla åldrar, men med hänvisning till Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter AFS 2023:2 kapitel 8 och bilaga 2, anställer vi inte personer under 18 år beroende på arbetsuppgifternas art.

Här kommer lite mer om tjänsten:

  • Du är en lagspelare med mer ansvar än andra i ditt team, men utan att ha teamchefens fulla personalansvar.
  • Tillsammans med din teamchef leder och planerar du verksamheten i ert team. Självklart tar du aktivt del i det dagliga operativa butiksarbetet.
  • Du lär dig de kunskaper och färdigheter som krävs för att så småningom axla en roll som teamchef. Det här är en språngbräda för att ta dig vidare i din Willys-karriär med målet att bli en framtida teamchef eller kanske så småningom butikschef?
  • Du arbetar målinriktat för att utveckla butikens försäljning, lönsamhet och övriga viktiga nyckeltal.
  • Du ingår i arbetsledningen i butiken och har teamchefens arbetsbeskrivning på din utvecklingsplan. Du praktiserar de färdigheter som du har lärt dig i arbetet och genom utbildningar.
  • Du är en förebild i arbetet med att möta våra kunder med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett stort leende.

Om oss

För oss är rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas viktigare än erfarenhet och utbildning. Vi jobbar tillsammans som ett lag, då vi ser att ett riktigt bra samarbete ger det bästa resultatet – samtidigt som vi har kul på jobbet. Lite mer om oss kommer här:

  • Vi arbetar med konceptstyrning och kedjedrift – det finns tydliga rutiner och strukturer på plats, vilket frigör tid för dig att fokusera på att utveckla dig mot att bli teamchef och bistå din teamchef med att arbetsleda teamet.
  • Willys är ett av branschens mest framgångsrika företag och vi fortsätter att växa. Och eftersom vi växer, kan du också göra det. Som ett stort företag finns många möjligheter att utvecklas i din ledarroll hos oss, bland annat genom en rad olika utbildningar.
  • Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här.

Om dig

Du gillar mat, människor och försäljning lika mycket som vi! Willys växer och utvecklas hela tiden, och det gillar du också att göra. Du vill gärna lära dig nya saker, tycker om att utmanas och drivs av att ta ett större ansvar. Det är också toppen om:

  • Du är junior i ditt ledarskap och behöver inte ha erfarenhet från en ledarroll, men ser dig som en framtida ledare och drivs av att leda andra. Alternativt har du redan erfarenheten, men inte inom dagligvaruhandeln.
  • Du är bra på att kommunicera, tycker om att engagera dina kollegor och är bra på att skapa ett positivt arbetsklimat.
  • Du gillar människor, sätter kundens behov först och är bra på att få med dig folk – såväl kunder som medarbetare.


Om du vill veta mer om vad tjänsten innebär, kontakta Björn Svensson, bjorn.svensson@willys.se. Vi ser gärna att du vid intresse skickar din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag den 2026-09-02. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via våra jobbsidor.

För att ta reda på om just du är den vi söker så innehåller vår rekryteringsprocess både tester och intervjuer.

Vi kontrollerar ID och gör bakgrundskontroller vid samtliga rekryteringar. Läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood

Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod. Vid frågor kontakta Medarbetarsupporten via kontaktformulär.

title: Undersköterskor till Team Strandgården
description:
Orust – den gröna och trygga ön där tanken är fri och drömmar får liv. Vi satsar på utveckling och investerar i både välfärd och våra medarbetare. Vi är stolta över att vår senaste medarbetarenkät visade att närmare 90% av våra medarbetare är stolta över att arbeta i Orust kommun. Välkommen till oss!

Om arbetsplatsen

Är du en driven och strukturerad person med lyhördhet för hyresgästernas behov och välbefinnande så är du personen vi söker! Vår vision är att bli Sveriges bästa äldreomsorg, en resa vi redan har påbörjat. Vårt fokus har tre grundben: Kärnan, samordnande undersköterska och ett gott ledarskap. Strandgården är ett särskilt boende vackert beläget precis intill havet, med fina promenadstråk och en fantastisk badplats med tillgänglighet för alla. Strandgården består av tre enheter, en för kognitiv svikt och två somatiska enheter. På Strandgården bor det 35 hyresgäster som alla ska ges möjlighet att leva ett gott liv, där personalen dygnet runt, arbetar med att säkerställa detta genom ett salutogent arbetssätt. Strandgården drivs som en intraprenad, vilket bland annat innebär att vi ansvarar för schemaläggningen själva, har högre delaktighet i beslut som berör verksamheten genom ombudsmöten och vi har nyrenoverade och fräscha lokaler. Vi arbetar i team och har samordningsansvariga undersköterskor på varje enhet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Hos oss på Strandgården är hyresgästen alltid i fokus – varje dag, i varje möte. Ditt arbete inom vård och omsorg handlar inte bara om att ge stöd, utan om att skapa trygghet, delaktighet och livskvalitet. Genom aktivt kvalitetsarbete, dokumentation och kontinuerlig uppföljning bidrar du till god kvalitet och att göra skillnad på riktigt.

Som kontaktperson är du och hyresgästen kärnan i verksamheten och tillsammans med hyresgästen utformar du en genomförandeplan som speglar deras behov och önskemål.

Vi är stolta över vår verksamhet och arbetar aktivt för att vara ambassadörer för äldreomsorgen. På Strandgården står glädje, professionalism och omtanke i centrum – där vi aktivt jobbar med bästa bemötande. Vi är även alltid nyfikna på att prova nytt och vi deltar ofta i forskningsprojekt eller andra testpiloter av till exempel digitala verktyg.

Om dig

Du är utbildad undersköterska med ett genuint intresse för människor och deras välmående. Du trivs i mötet med andra, samarbetar gärna i team och bidrar till en positiv och stödjande arbetsmiljö där vi hjälps åt och lär av varandra.

Med ditt engagemang, din omtanke och ditt prestigelösa förhållningssätt skapar du trygghet och kvalitet i omsorgen. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, är flexibel och ser möjligheter i vardagen – alltid med hyresgästernas bästa i fokus.

Du arbetar målinriktat och strukturerat, samtidigt som din humanistiska människosyn genomsyrar allt du gör. För dig är det självklart att möta varje individ med respekt, värme och professionalitet.

Vi ser också att du har god fysik och känner dig trygg i att använda digitala verktyg i ditt arbete. Eftersom verksamheten pågår dygnet runt innebär tjänsten arbete dag, kväll och varannan helg.

Välkommen in med din ansökan!

Övriga upplysningar:

Arbetstid/varaktighet: Heltid, tillsvidare

Lön: Individuell lönesättning

Tillträdesdag: Enligt överenskommelse

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-09-13

Körkort: B-körkort är ett krav då kollektivtrafiken är begränsad till Ellös

För Orust kommun är det en självklarhet att mångfald och jämställdhet gynnar arbetsgruppen, arbetsplatsen och arbetsgivaren.Vi tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.Orust kommun arbetar för trygga och säkra verksamheter. Därför genomförs registerkontroll i samband med vissa rekryteringar.Inför anställning kan du som slutkandidat behöva visa utdrag ur belastningsregistret och i vissa fall misstankeregistret. Detta gäller exempelvis arbete med barn, arbete inom omsorg samt vid rekrytering till ledande befattningar eller andra roller som är av väsentlig betydelse för kommunen.Registerkontrollen utgör en del av helhetsbedömningen i rekryteringsprocessen.Vill du veta mer om Orust kommun som arbetsgivare och de förmåner vi erbjuder kan du läsa mer på vår webb:Orust.se Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Min Doktor söker Sjuksköterskor till  Min Doktor i Stockholm
description:
Vi söker nu våra nästa stjärnor till våra team.

Att arbeta som sjuksköterska hos oss

Du är en legitimerad sjuksköterska som brinner för bra service och alltid gör det lilla extra för dina patienter. Du har förmågan till självständigt arbete och beslutsfattande utifrån din kompetens. Du arbetar nära kollegorna på Apotek Hjärtat och dina kollegor runtom i landet. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med vaccinationer är meriterande men skall ej ses som ett krav.

Vill du veta mer? Se vår film om hur det är att arbeta hos oss

Det här söker vi hos dig

Vi söker utåtriktad sjuksköterska med god datorvana för arbete på våra mottagningar i Stockholm. Tjänsterna är tillsvidareanställningar på 80%.

Tillsammans med dina kollegor kommer du främst att arbeta med vaccinationer samt enklare vårdbesök som tex öronspolning, såromläggning och blodtryck. Läkare finns tillgängliga på telefon för samråd.

Vi söker sjuksköterskor med huvudarbetsplats till följande: Sickla, Bromma, Mall of Scandinavia, Haninge, Barkarby, Fältöversten, Odenplan och Häggvik. I ansökan skriver du vilken klinik du är intresserad av.

Arbetet hos oss är självständigt och innefattar bland annat:

  • Vaccinering

  • Journalföring

  • Hantering av betalning

  • Enklare inventering

Övrig information

Placering: Plats Stockholm

Omfattning: Sysselsättningsgrad 80% tillsvidareanställning.

Tillträde: Efter överenskommelse.

Välkommen med din ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan så snart som möjligt (urval och intervjuer sker löpande). Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Om Min Doktor

Min Doktor är Sveriges första digitala vårdgivare och erbjuder sedan 2013 snabba och trygga vårdbesök över nätet, oberoende av tid och plats. Idag är vi en av Sveriges största digitala vårdcentraler. Sedan 2018 bedriver vi även sjuksköterskeledda fysiska vård- och vaccinationsmottagningar i anslutning till Apotek Hjärtat och ICA Maxi, samt en vårdcentral i Nyköping. Min Doktor är registrerad vårdgivare och omfattas av hälso- och sjukvårdslagen, personuppgiftslagen, patientdatalagen och patientsäkerhetslagen.

title: Porter - FT 7am - 4:00pm
description:
Job Title: Porter

Location: Palmetto on West, Clearwater, FL 33755

Work Schedule: Full Time | 40 Hours per Week

Pay Rate: $19 - $21 DOE Per Hour


Job Description

HallKeen Management is seeking a dependable, motivated, and customer-focused Porter to join our team at Palmetto Park Apartments. This position plays a vital role in maintaining the appearance of the community, supporting the maintenance team, and preparing apartments for new residents.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform daily grounds inspections and remove litter and debris throughout the property.

  • Assist the maintenance team with apartment unit turnovers to ensure units are move-in ready.
  • Assist with painting, touch-ups, cleaning appliances, replacing light bulbs, installing air filters, and other turnover tasks as assigned.

  • Help maintain maintenance shops, storage rooms, and inventory areas in a clean and organized manner.
  • Report maintenance concerns, safety hazards, and property damage promptly.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance activities as directed by the Maintenance Supervisor.
  • Provide excellent customer service while interacting with residents, vendors, and visitors.
  • Respond professionally to resident requests and communicate maintenance concerns to the appropriate team members.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the overall operation of the community.

title: Gym Director
description:
Benefits:
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Competitive salary
  • Health insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
Do you light up when you’re around kids, and do they light up around you? Do you love leading a team as much as you love a good round of applause for a first somersault? The Little Gym of Seekonk is looking for a Gym Director to lead our gym, inspire our team, and help hundreds of local kids build confidence one skill (and one giggle) at a time.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll run the business side of the gym, but you’ll also be on the floor teaching, high-fiving, and cheering kids on every week. If you want a desk job, this isn’t it. If you want a job where "serious fun" is literally the product, keep reading.

Why is The Little Gym a great place to work?
  • Strong sense of fulfillment
  • Keep fit as you work
  • Fun, high-energy work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive ongoing career training
  • Excellent opportunity for career growth and advancement
Company Overview:
With more than 300 locations across the globe, The Little Gym is the world’s premier enrichment and physical development center for kids 4 months through 12 years. For over four decades, The Little Gym has helped millions of kids experience the thrill of achievement, develop new skills, and find new confidence through a variety of gymnastics-based programs. Parent/Child, Pre-K, and Grade School classes are all taught in a clean, fun, safe, and nurturing environment, which encourages children to develop at their own pace.

As a part of The Little Gym team, you will be part of a family dedicated to the growth and development of children all over the globe.

Job Summary:
The Gym Director is a full-time career-level position, responsible for the overall performance of The Little Gym location. Typically, the Gym Director reports directly to the owners of a specific The Little Gym location.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead and inspire the team. Hire, train, coach, and celebrate a crew of instructors and directors. Run weekly team meetings and 1:1s, give in-the-moment feedback, and build a culture people love being part of.
  • Teach! Spend roughly 25–50% of your time in the gym teaching classes and programs. You’ll be trained in our curriculum; you bring the energy and the love of kids.
  • Grow enrollment. Own the member experience from first phone call to first forward roll. Drive introductory visits, conversion, and retention, and partner with the owners on enrollment and revenue goals.
  • Create raving fans. Deliver exceptional customer service, know families by name, resolve concerns with empathy, and schedule intentional "WOW" moments for members.
  • Run a tight ship. Oversee scheduling, payroll and labor costs, facility cleanliness, safety standards, and day-to-day operations so the gym runs smoothly and profitably.
  • Rally the community. Support marketing, social media, member events, and grassroots outreach that make us the place for kids in the area.
Qualifications:
  • Love to have fun and not only smiles easily but finds joy in making others smile.
  • Several years of experience working with kids (teaching, coaching, childcare, education, recreation, or similar) and experience supervising or leading a team.
  • Comfort teaching or excited to learn. A background in gymnastics, physical education, or child development is a big plus, but not required. We provide full training and certification support (CPR/First Aid).
  • Ability to work Saturdays. It’s our biggest day, and our Director is there leading it. Your full-time schedule will include weekday flexibility to balance it out.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to communicate warmly and clearly with parents, kids, and teammates alike.
  • Experience managing a P&L is a plus.
What we offer
  • Competitive salary of $55,000–$75,000 depending on experience.
  • Paid time off and paid holiday closures.
  • Performance bonus potential tied to the gym’s success.
  • Paid training, including The Little Gym’s professional curriculum and leadership development.
  • Real growth: as we expand into Rhode Island, top performers will have the opportunity to grow into regional leadership roles.

title: Sr. Clinical Data Associate
description:
Work Schedule

Second Shift (Afternoons)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Data Associate – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in organizational performance. As a Senior Clinical Data Associate, you will perform all aspects of the data cleaning process, with minimal supervision, in accordance with Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and Standard Operating Procedures/Work Process Documents (SOPs/WPDs), to assess the safety and efficacy of investigational products and/or medical devices.
What You’ll Do:

  • Supports the setup of study activities such as database design, testing of data entry screens, and Data Validation Manual (DVM) creation, as required.

  • Reviews data listings for accuracy and consistency of data.

  • Acts as point person and subject matter expert for specialized study-specific processes.

  • Generates, tracks and resolves data clarifications and queries and makes changes to the clinical database (EDC) as required.

  • Contributes to the improvement of data management processes on a global level.

  • Produces project-specific status reports for management and/or clients on a regular basis.

  • Provides training and work direction to junior staff as required.


Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with relevant formal academic or vocational qualifications.

  • Prior experience in clinical research, including hands-on experience managing and handling clinical data, is required.



Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Applies knowledge and skills in a highly organized fashion while adhering to regulatory guidelines, global SOPs and client expectations
• Strong attention to detail and skill with numbers
• Good written and verbal communication skills
• Good analytical/problem-solving skills
• Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality with clinical data and client's proprietary data
• Strong customer focus and excellent interpersonal skills.
• Proven flexibility and adaptability
• Must be able to set and meet timelines or be able to negotiate schedule changes in response to project demands
• Knowledge of medical/clinical terminology
• Understands project protocol and DVM
• Proven ability in achieving applicable technical competencies per the DM competency grid


Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.

  • Hybrid Work Arrangement (2x a week in the office)

  • Occasional drives to site locations


Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

title: Division Director, Engineering Solutions & Services
description:
About Chartis Federal

Chartis Federal is a premier systems engineering and integration firm specializing in mission-critical IT and communications solutions for law enforcement, homeland security, and defense. As a trusted prime contractor with over $160 million in task order awards, we operate across 22 states and support essential government missions worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has fueled our year-over-year growth, earning us recognition twice as a Washington Technology FAST 50 company and securing a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years. At Chartis Federal, our mission is clear: keeping heroes safe and connected—on the battlefield, on the border, and in our backyards.


Position Overview

The Division Director – Engineering Solutions & Services (ESS) is a senior leadership role at Chartis Federal responsible for the strategy, execution, and growth of the company’s Engineering Solutions & Services vertical, including TACCOM, Land Mobile Radio (LMR), and mission-critical engineering services.


This leader owns delivery excellence, technical integrity, customer relationships, and financial performance for the ESS portfolio and plays a critical role in expanding Chartis Federal’s position as a trusted engineering and communications partner across DHS and Federal Civilian agencies.


The Division Director reports directly to the COO and provides leadership to five Program Managers supporting the ESS portfolio.

The role blends technical leadership, operational oversight, program management, and growth strategy, with the expectation that the individual can serve as a hands-on Program Manager or technical authority for select strategic or high-complexity programs when required.


Duties and Responsibilities

ESS Portfolio & Financial Leadership

  • Own full P&L responsibility for the Engineering Solutions & Services (ESS) portfolio, including TACCOM, LMR, and engineering services contracts
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, forecasting accuracy, and cost discipline across fielded and developmental engineering programs
  • Develop workforce planning strategies, succession plans, and staffing models to ensure the ESS portfolio maintains the technical talent necessary to support current and future growth objectives
  • Provide executive oversight for all ESS programs, ensuring performance against technical, schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction objectives
  • Establish and enforce engineering-centric program execution standards, ensuring consistency across design, deployment, sustainment, and lifecycle support efforts

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

Atom Computing is seeking a Principal Platform Engineer to build and operate the systems that power our quantum computing and research workflows. In this role, you will design and design infrastructure spanning on-prem lab environments and cloud platforms, driving key trade-off decisions across reliability, security, scalability, and cost. This position requires solid expertise in infrastructure and platform engineering and strong systems thinking, along with the ability to navigate complex design problems.

Due to the need for collaboration with Atom's software, hardware, and control systems teams, this role is required to be in the office in Boulder, CO at least 3 days per week.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain classical compute infrastructure supporting quantum control systems
  • Work closely with Atom Computing's software engineers, control systems engineers, and physicists to understand workload requirements and deliver compute infrastructure that meets them
  • Own infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, and system observability across on-prem lab environments and cloud platforms
  • Establish and enforce security, access control, and compliance standards (e.g., NIST 800-53, SOC2) across systems
  • Participate in on-call rotation and drive incident response, root-cause analysis, and reliability improvements
  • Evaluate and integrate new infrastructure tooling, balancing build-vs-buy decisions against team velocity and operational overhead

Experience & Education

  • BS or advanced degree in Computer Science
  • 7+ years of post-degree experience as an infrastructure, platform, or systems engineer

Qualifications

  • Have gone through a complete infrastructure build-out or major platform migration
  • Currently working with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, or similar)
  • Currently working with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes)
  • Experience managing hybrid environments spanning on-prem hardware (Proxmox, K8S) and cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals, Linux systems administration, and CI/CD pipeline design
  • Expertise in monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent)

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The base salary range for this position is between $170,000 - $200,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

title: Clinical Assistant II
description:
Turn Your Healthcare Experience Into a Career You'll Love!!


Dental Assistant at NHOMS | MassOMS

Who We Are:
Join our innovative team at NHOMS | MassOMS and play an essential role in creating outstanding experiences for our clients, partners, and communities. By embracing our core values of innovation, compassion, accessibility, and one team, you will play a part in a mission to make a lasting impact on our organization's growth and success.


Our core values center around healing first for our patients. Members of our team approach each day with compassion for both patients and colleagues. We promote innovation on every level and ensure we are accessible to one another as we work as one team.

We are searching for individuals who can help us continue pursuing our goal of reaching prospective patients and helping to transform their lives — all while having a little fun!

Ready to grow your career in healthcare? This is the place to be. Whether you're coming from a related medical field or already have dental experience under your belt, we'll help you build on it — including opportunities to earn certifications and advance along the way.

Position Summary
The role of a Dental Assistant is pivotal in supporting oral surgeons and facilitating the smooth operation of the clinic. This position demands a proficient and driven individual with a robust foundation in dental assisting, with a preferred emphasis on oral surgery. The right candidate will actively engage with oral surgeons, offering invaluable support during surgical procedures, upholding sterility in the surgical environment, and ensuring unwavering adherence to the highest standards of patient care. This role includes travel between our Andover and Burlington locations.

Those who should apply: LPNs, Medical Assistants, CNAs, Medical Techs, Nurse's Aids, Sterilization Techs, Phlebotomists, IV Techs, and others with related hands-on healthcare experience — we will train on the dental-specific skills!

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Assist chairside proficiently during a diverse range of dental surgical procedures.
  • Prepare, break down, disinfect, and sterilize treatment rooms and instruments to maintain optimal hygiene standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with infection control, CDC, OSHA, and HIPAA regulations, guaranteeing a safe and secure environment for both patients and staff.
  • Capture high-quality radiographic images and maintain meticulous documentation of patient records.
  • Provide patients with comprehensive pre-operative and post-operative care instructions to enhance their overall experience and recovery.
  • Maintain accurate and thorough patient charting for effective record-keeping and continuity of care.

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Possession of a High School Diploma and reliable transportation is essential.
  • Demonstrated motivation to learn with a genuine passion for healthcare and a commitment to direct patient care.
  • Previous experience in dental or oral surgery is a strong plus, showcasing a solid foundation in dental assisting.
  • Familiarity with Open Dental software is a plus, demonstrating adaptability to dental practice management tools.
  • Basic computer literacy, including proficiency in email and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel between our Andover and Burlington locations as required to support clinic operations.
  • Strong follow-through, effective communication, and reliability are paramount for success in this role.
  • Growth-minded candidates encouraged to apply — opportunities to pursue certifications and advance your career await!

As a Technical Records Officer, you’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate aircraft maintenance records and ensuring all documentation is processed, reviewed, and stored in line with regulatory, business, and operational requirements. You’ll play an important role in supporting continuing airworthiness by ensuring aircraft records are complete, compliant, and available to key stakeholders when required.

Working closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Planning, and operational teams, you’ll assist with the review and management of technical documentation, data entry, record updates, and reporting activities to support the safe and efficient operation of our fleet.

You’ll have:

  • Experience in technical records, aviation records, maintenance administration, or a similar administrative role
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing and maintaining documentation
  • Sound computer literacy and confidence using records management systems
  • Ability to interpret and process maintenance documentation, work packs, logbooks, or technical records
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with internal stakeholders across Engineering, Maintenance, and Planning teams
  • A proactive approach to problem solving and process improvement
  • An understanding of aviation compliance, safety, or regulatory requirements would be highly regarded
  • Previous experience in an airline, MRO, or aviation maintenance environment would be advantageous

title: Personlig assistent kvällstid sökes till man i Hammarby Sjöstad
description:
På Bonzi arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

Om tjänsten

Bonzi söker nu en personlig assistent som vill arbeta 2 pass per vecka hos vår kund i Hammarby Sjöstad, med närhet till Södermalm.

1 tjänst – 2 pass per vecka Arbetstid: 16.00–21.00

Utrymme kommer även att kunna finnas att arbeta vid ordinarie assistenters frånvaro, exempelvis vid semester eller sjukdom. Arbetstiderna kan då vara både dag och kvällstid vardag som helg

Som personlig assistent stöttar du kunden i hans dagliga liv och bidrar till en trygg, aktiv och meningsfull vardag. Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta som vikarie vid behov .

Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och innefattar bland annat:

  • Assistera i dagliga rutiner och förekommande hushållssysslor

  • Assistera vid personlig hygien, av- och påklädning samt måltider

  • Förflyttningar där lyft förekommer

  • Att följa med på olika aktiviteter

Om kunden:

Kunden är en aktiv man i 30-årsåldern med en förvärvad hjärnskada. Han är verbal, kommunikativ och kan själv uttrycka sina behov, önskemål och åsikter. För att kunna leva ett självständigt och aktivt liv behöver han stöd i vissa delar av vardagen.

Han kan behöva hjälp med att komma ihåg tider, aktiviteter och andra vardagliga saker samt stöd med vissa praktiska moment. Målet med stödet är att skapa struktur och trygghet, samtidigt som kundens självständighet, delaktighet och möjlighet att leva ett aktivt liv står i fokus.

Om dig:

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta nära människor och som har förmågan att se och möta andras behov. Du är empatisk, lyhörd, lösningsfokuserad och tar gärna egna initiativ.

Pålitlighet och ansvarskänsla är självklara egenskaper hos dig. Dubbelbemanning förekommer dag- och kvällstid, vilket innebär att du behöver ha god samarbetsförmåga och fungera väl i team.

Du har lätt för att sätta dig in i andras livssituationer och vill göra skillnad i någon annans vardag.

Krav: Fysisk stark , manuella förflyttningar förekommer. Rökfri. Svenska i både i tal och skrift är ett krav då dokumentation ingår i arbetet.

Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent eller inom vård och omsorg

  • Yrkesmässig erfarenhet av kundens funktionsvariation

Omfattning: 1 tjänst 2 pass per vecka. 2 tjänster vikarie vid behov

Tillträde: Intervjuer sker löpande och kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal

Att tänka på inför din ansökan:

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos på Bonzi är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned från Skatteverkets webbplats.

För att arbeta som personlig assistent, ledsagare eller avlösare hos oss måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Ålderskravet följer av reglerna om personlig assistans, ledsagning och avlösning i LSS och socialförsäkringsbalken.

För att arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdragen beställs via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Du beställer enkelt utdragen med Bank-ID via denna länk:

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

För dig med anställningsstöd: Bonzi är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Om rekryteringsprocessen: Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia.

En del av Team Olivia

Bonzi ingår i koncernen Team Olivia. Team Olivia har utvecklats till ett ledande omsorgsföretag med att etablerade bolag under lokala varumärken.

title: Research Technician
description:
Position Number: JR-017610

Role type: Full-time; Fixed-term (18 months)
Faculty: Medicine, Dentistry and Health Sciences
Department/School: Department of Anatomy and Physiology, School of Biomedical Sciences
Salary: Level A - $87,266 – $118,416 p.a. plus 17% super

  • Lead longitudinal phenotyping in an ARC Discovery ageing project / Use advanced in vivo techniques flow cytometry platforms / Collaborate across the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct

  • Apply now to advance ageing biology through sophisticated in vivo phenotyping and immune profiling in mouse models.

  • Investing in you – 17% superannuation, benefits package including salary packaging, health and wellbeing programs, discounted services, and professional development opportunities.

The University of Melbourne
We take pride in our people, who all contribute to our mission to benefit society through the transformative impact of education and research. Discover more via our website.

Your next career opportunity
You will lead longitudinal physiological and immune phenotyping in mouse models within a landmark ARC Discovery Project. You will gain deep expertise in ageing biology, health-span assessment and translational research using advanced platforms and facilities. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary experts across the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct and contribute to high-impact publications and presentations.

What you will deliver:

  • Lead longitudinal cardiovascular, metabolic and functional phenotyping in ageing mouse models using specialized physiological assessment platforms.

  • Conduct in vivo rodent studies, including monitoring, sample collection and scheduling, ensuring strict compliance with animal ethics requirements.

  • Perform immune cell isolation and multiparameter flow cytometry, then integrate immune and physiological datasets with collaborators.

  • Analyse complex longitudinal datasets using appropriate statistical approaches, preparing high-quality figures, reports, manuscripts and project documentation.

  • Support laboratory operations, including reagent ordering, equipment maintenance, record-keeping, and contributing to meetings, seminars and retreats.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Hold a relevant Masters in Physiology, Biomedical Science, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular Science, Immunology or related discipline.

  • Demonstrate substantial experience with in vivo rodent experimentation and physiological phenotyping, ideally including cardiovascular or metabolic assessments.

  • Bring hands-on expertise in flow cytometry, including immune cell isolation, panel execution, and data analysis.

  • Apply robust statistical analysis to complex biological datasets using tools such as R, GraphPad Prism or Python.

  • Utilise strong organisational skills to coordinate longitudinal studies across multiple facilities and manage competing experimental priorities.

  • Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams and support junior researchers learning specialised physiological and immune techniques.

For further information, please refer to the attached PD.

What we offer you!
We offer the opportunity to be part of a vibrant community and enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits to support your success and sense of fulfilment, including:

  • Build future financial security with 17% superannuation

  • Supportive flexible work arrangements underpinned by our commitment to inclusion and well-being

  • Career development opportunities, including access to a range of tailored programs, such as Academic Women in Leadership, and learning platforms including LinkedIn Learning

  • Progressive, considerate leave provisions to empower your work-life balance and well-being, including leading parental leave, gender affirmation leave and cultural leave

  • Salary packaging and access to a range of discounted services including Bupa health insurance, and access to unique cultural and recreational benefits such as discounts for the Melbourne Theatre Company

  • Health and well-being services including a leading Employee Assistance Program

For more information check out our benefits page!

Your new team

Your new team in the Department of Anatomy and Physiology sits within the School of Biomedical Sciences. You will join a vibrant community of researchers exploring metabolic, cardiovascular, neuroscience and developmental biology. The Department hosts 35 world-class laboratories, cutting-edge facilities and strong clinical and industry partnerships. You will benefit from supportive leadership, collaborative culture and outstanding training opportunities for emerging scientists. Working within the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct, you will engage with partner institutes and hospitals to translate discovery science into improved human health.

Be Yourself
The University of Melbourne is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a child-safe organisation. The diversity of our community enriches us all, and we are committed to creating an inclusive and fair workplace where everyone is valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Discover more about Diversity and Inclusion at UniMelb.

We're committed to a barrier-free recruitment process and ongoing workplace support, providing adjustments throughout. We warmly encourage applications from people with disabilities. Learn more about how we support an accessible recruitment process.

Indigenous applicants are encouraged to connect with Korin Korin, our Indigenous Employment and Development team, via korin-korin@unimelb.edu.au

title: Director of Build Services
description:
Why This Role Exists

The Director of Build Services leads the operational systems, processes, and teams that prepare projects for successful execution and maintain project performance throughout delivery. This role establishes consistent project service standards, ensures seamless coordination across stakeholders in Design, Purchasing, Construction, and Client Experience, and provides the operational discipline necessary to deliver exceptional client experiences while protecting schedule, quality, and financial performance.

By driving standardized processes, monitoring leading performance indicators, and proactively resolving issues, this role enables projects to move efficiently from design completion through construction while supporting Blue Heron's integrated design-build model.


Core Accountabilities

Operational Excellence & Project Services

  • Establishes, communicates, and continuously improves standardized project services processes that create consistency, predictability, and operational excellence across all projects.
  • Ensures projects are properly prepared for construction through disciplined oversight of project starts, project management, schedule development, documentation, and operational readiness.
  • Develops scalable workflows that improve efficiency, reduce variability, and support sustainable organizational growth.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Fosters partnership with Design, Purchasing, Construction, and Client Experience to ensure seamless handoffs, aligned priorities, and coordinated project execution.
  • Identifies operational bottlenecks and leads cross-functional improvements that enhance project delivery and the client experience.
  • Facilitates proactive communication and issue resolution to minimize project disruptions and maintain momentum.

Schedule & Financial Performance

  • Oversees project schedule creation, maintenance, and performance to ensure realistic planning and consistent execution.
  • Reviews project budgets and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle, identifying risks early and driving corrective actions when needed.
  • Monitors leading indicators that influence project profitability, schedule adherence, and overall operational performance.

Change Management & Project Controls

  • Oversees the administration and compliance of project change orders to ensure accurate documentation, timely approvals, and financial accountability.
  • Ensures project controls, documentation, and administrative processes support informed decision-making and consistent project execution.
  • Promotes disciplined management of project changes while balancing client expectations, financial outcomes, and schedule impacts.

Client Experience & Issue Resolution

  • Provides operational leadership in addressing project issues requiring cross-functional coordination or executive involvement.
  • Ensures clients receive timely, accurate communication throughout project execution by establishing consistent update processes and service standards.
  • Supports project teams in resolving challenges while reinforcing trust, transparency, and accountability throughout the client journey.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Leads and develops the Build Services team by establishing clear expectations, promoting accountability, and fostering continuous improvement.
  • Uses operational data, performance metrics, and team feedback to improve systems, processes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Builds a culture focused on collaboration, execution excellence, and measurable business outcomes.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is demonstrated through predictable project execution, strong cross-functional alignment, and consistently positive client experiences. Project starts occur on schedule with complete and accurate documentation. Operational processes are standardized and consistently followed across the organization. Project schedules remain accurate and proactively managed, financial performance is monitored through leading indicators, and change orders are processed efficiently and compliantly.

This leader anticipates issues, removes operational obstacles, improves organizational efficiency, and enables teams to execute with confidence while protecting margins, schedules, and client satisfaction.


How This Role Sets Others Up for Success

This role enables the success of Design, Purchasing, Construction, Client Experience, Finance, and Executive Leadership by creating clear operational processes, reliable project information, and disciplined execution standards.

Through consistent communication, proactive coordination, timely decision-making, and operational leadership, the Director of Build Services ensures projects transition smoothly between departments, risks are identified early, and teams have the information and support needed to perform at a high level. By maintaining alignment across functions, this role improves organizational efficiency, strengthens client confidence, and creates a more predictable project delivery experience.


How Performance Is Measured

Key performance indicators include:

  • Gross margin performance
  • Client Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Change order compliance and processing timeliness
  • Schedule adherence across active projects
  • On-time project starts
  • Budget variance and financial forecasting accuracy
  • Operational process adoption and compliance

Represent the product area with senior leadership and cross-organizational stakeholders, providing clear recommendations on roadmap priorities, investment needs, risks, and execution status.

Build deep expertise in data center support operations, cloud infrastructure workflows, hardware lifecycle processes, inventory dependencies, and operational analytics.

description:
Location: Marylebone, London (Hybrid)

Job type: Full time

Who we are

At Tenzo, we’re transforming the way restaurants operate. Our Restaurant Reporting & Intelligence platform brings together data from multiple systems to deliver real-time, actionable insights - helping operators boost sales, cut waste, and run smoother businesses. As one of our customers put it, “It’s helped us make smarter, faster decisions and spot opportunities we might have missed before.”

We’re a team of hospitality enthusiasts and tech builders backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors and guided by experienced advisors including Jane O'Riordan and Floor Bleeker. Join us on our mission to help restaurants around the world move from surviving to thriving.

About the role

You'll join the APA (Analyse, Predict & Act) team that owns everything customers actually look at: the web app, the mobile app, the metrics engine behind our analytics cards, the scheduled reports, and our AI and MCP services.

A typical feature means adding a query capability to a Django service, exposing it through an API, then building the interface for it in React. You own that whole path. Right now that means a big push on our BI capabilities, covering new chart types, heatmaps, drilldowns and a reworked dashboard grid, plus targets and budgets, a semantic layer, and AI features including a chat over a customer's own data.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Performance work. These are dashboards over millions of rows of transaction data, and speed is a feature.

  • Targets and budgets: letting operators set goals per site, per revenue centre, and track against them.

  • Our semantic layer, so metrics mean the same thing everywhere they're used.

  • AI features: dashboard summaries, an AI chat over a customer's own data, and our MCP server that lets tools like Claude query Tenzo directly

  • A significant push on our BI capabilities, including new chart types, heatmaps, and more flexible ways to organise and explore your data.

What we’re looking for:

  • Substantial experience (around 4-6 years) building, shipping, and maintaining production software.

  • Genuinely capable in React and TypeScript, with a sharp eye for UX polish and detail.

  • Experience working on products with active users - handling releases that can't break and data that must be protected.

  • Clear, effective written communication - how you articulate technical tradeoffs in pull requests matters to us!

  • Nice to have: Experience with analytics or data-heavy products, multi-tenant architectures, or handling flaky, unpredictable third-party APIs.

A Quick Note on Tech Stacks: You won't have used everything in our stack. Strong depth in Python and React, paired with the drive to pick up new tools quickly, is what counts most.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a UNIX/Linux/Solaris Engineer to support NIH CIT’s HSS program. You will keep mission-critical systems stable, secure, and performant across Solaris (Zones/LDOMs) and Red Hat Linux on VMware, while applying careful, responsible automation to reduce toil—modernizing only where it strengthens reliability, security, and customer outcomes.

Location: Hybrid (3 days/week onsite, Bethesda, MD)

Responsibilities:

  • Operate and administer Solaris and Red Hat estates: Solaris—administer Zones and Logical Domains (LDOMs); manage OS lifecycle, patching, and hardware (Oracle platforms such as T-series where applicable). Red Hat—administer RHEL systems virtualized on VMware (in partnership with the Windows/VMware team).

  • Patching & change execution: Drive Solaris patching using Alternate Boot Environments (ABE)—build, patch, and reboot into ABEs on standard cycles (e.g., 3rd Friday for non-prod, 4th Friday for prod) with rapid rollback capability if needed.

  • Adapt to Oracle’s revised patch cadence (security bundles every ~6 weeks, with potential interim bundles) and plan out-of-band updates when required by vulnerability severity.

  • Maintain Red Hat patching via Puppet, ensuring customer-managed servers also receive monthly OS updates.

  • Automation & tool transitions: Lead the transition off Oracle Ops Center (EOL/waiver ends Dec 31) toward Ansible (preferred) or Puppet playbooks for Solaris patch automation; author playbooks/modules and operational runbooks for the new process.

  • Support upgrade from Oracle OEM 13.5 to 24 AI and ensure monitoring/administration workflows remain reliable during and after the migration.

  • Monitoring & security operations: Configure and consume SL1 monitoring for OS/hardware health (CPU/memory/filesystems) and notifications; coordinate with DCOB (operations management) for platform configuration as needed.

  • Triage security alerts from Tenable scans and follow-on tickets in Tripwire (file integrity) and Splunk (log-based anomalies such as SSH attempts); enforce host-level firewalls and raise network blocks when needed.

  • Implement account policies (e.g., password expiration changes) safely across environments; validate changes in non-prod first to avoid service impact.

  • Service models & customer engagement: Solaris—own root and full OS/hardware administration; grant sudo for customer application operations. Red Hat—support both managed (GDIT administers OS; customers manage apps) and customer-managed servers (customers hold root; GDIT ensures OS patching and provides consulting on request).

  • Incident response & governance: Use ServiceNow for change and incident management; adhere to CAB approvals and standard change windows; deliver post-incident RCA where applicable.

  • Participate in XMatters on-call rotations (15-minute acknowledge; tiered escalation), coordinating with NOC bridge during enterprise events (e.g., DNS or network issues).

  • Documentation & collaboration: Maintain SharePoint-hosted SOPs/runbooks (with screenshots) covering patch orchestration (ABE), rollback, automation playbooks, OEM upgrade steps, SL1 alerting, and security/vulnerability remediation workflows; align with weekly UNIX–security syncs and customer meetings.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years administering Oracle Solaris (Zones/LDOMs) and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux at scale, including OS patching and change execution in regulated environments.

  • Hands-on with ABE-based Solaris patching, rollback, and vendor bundle planning; experience adjusting to non-monthly patch cadences.

  • Practical experience with Puppet and Ansible for UNIX automation (playbooks/modules), plus strong shell scripting (bash/ksh).

  • Familiarity with VMware-hosted Linux operations and coordination with platform teams.

  • Operational monitoring and security tooling: SL1, Tenable, Tripwire, Splunk; host-level firewall management and security policy enforcement (e.g., password lifecycles).

  • Proven use of ServiceNow (CAB/change templates; incident/RCA) and on-call processes via XMatters.

  • Strong documentation habits (SOPs/runbooks with screenshots) and collaborative posture with customers and cyber teams.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Designed Ansible-first automation to replace legacy tools (e.g., Oracle Ops Center) for Solaris patch management; integrated automation outputs with ServiceNow tasks/approvals.

  • Experience upgrading Oracle OEM and validating monitoring/administration flows during cutover.

  • Familiarity with CIS controls and practical hardening for UNIX/Linux (file integrity, SSH posture, logging, firewall).

  • Capacity to coach customers on reliable application monitoring (SL1 hooks or customer tools like SiteScope) while keeping OS monitoring/alerting clean.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust (onsite fingerprinting required)

title: Läkare till Företagshälsa
description:
Med 1 000 experter på närmare 100 enheter över hela landet är Falck Sveriges mest kompletta leverantör av tjänster inom hälsa och arbetsliv. Vi erbjuder företagshälsovård, kris- och personalstöd, organisations- och ledarskapsutveckling, omställnings- och karriärtjänster samt primärvård och hälsotjänster för privatpersoner. Falcks tjänster inom hälsa och arbetsliv når 1,2 miljoner människor över hela Sverige och bidrar till ett hållbart arbetsliv och privatliv för alla.

Är du specialistläkare som söker en vardag där du erbjuds en strukturerad arbetsdag med reglerade, helgfria arbetstider och möjlighet att planera din tid? Tilltalas du av att arbeta förebyggande och konsultativt tillsammans med andra yrkeskategorier, med fokus på våra kunders verksamhet? En av våra läkare går nu i pension och vi söker därför en ny stjärna till vårt team i Nyköping med omnejd.

Hos oss på Falck får du en attraktiv läkarroll i en verksamhet med hög kompetens där du blir en del av ett tvärvetenskapligt team med ett nära och coachande ledarskap, där du får göra meningsfull skillnad för våra kunder. Som läkare på Falck jobbar du i partnerskap med allt från stora rikstäckande bolag till lokala företag. Du blir en viktig del av en nationell organisation vars tjänster når 1,2 miljoner människor och varje dag bidrar till ett mer hållbart arbetsliv i hela Sverige.

Din roll hos oss

Du har en viktig medicinsk roll internt och på uppdrag av våra kunder, där du arbetar med:

  • Lagstadgade undersökningar och medicinska kontroller inom olika områden.
  • Arbetslivsinriktade rehabiliteringsåtgärder som arbetsförmågebedömningar och stöd i sjukskrivningsprocesser.
  • Hälsofrämjande insatser, såsom föreläsningar och rådgivning för ledningsgrupper.
  • Hälsokontroller för privatpersoner

Vi söker dig som är

  • Specialistläkare inom Arbetsmedicin, Arbets- och miljömedicin, Företagshälsovård eller Yrkes- och miljömedicin.
  • Vi är även öppna för dig med annan specialitet (t.ex. allmänmedicin, internmedicin, psykiatri, rehabilitering) som är genuint nyfiken på sambandet mellan arbete och hälsa.
  • Bekväm med och har intresse för att arbeta i digitala verktyg.
  • Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person söker vi dig som är en prestigelös och flexibel lagspelare som arbetar strukturerat och kvalitetsmedvetet. Du är trygg i en konsultativ roll där du kombinerar din medicinska expertis med ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt. Slutligen ser vi att du känner igen dig i våra Winning Behaviours: vi bryr oss om, bygger förtroende och tillsammans skapar mer värde.

Vi erbjuder dig

  • En förutsägbar och planerbar arbetsdag (helgfria vardagar kl. 8-17).
  • Ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete i tvärvetenskapliga team med trevliga kollegor.
  • Verksamhetsanpassad kompetensutveckling med mentorskap och handledning vid behov.
  • Kollektivavtal, marknadsmässiga förmåner.
  • Tillgång till ett nära, coachande och närvarande ledarskap.
  • Inspirerande kundkontakter med möjlighet att skapa resultat på individ-, team- och organisationsnivå.

Övrigt:

Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med 6 månaders provanställning. Tjänstgöringsgrad och tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Rollen är placerad i Nyköping men kan även utifrån verksamhetens behov, innebära viss tjänstgöring på våra enhet/er i Oxelösund, Katrineholm och Flen, samt resor i närområdet till våra kunder. B-körkort är därmed ett krav, tjänstebil finns att nyttja i vår verksamhet.

Är du intresserad?

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Konsultchef Simon Lundqvist på simon.lundkvist@falcksverige.se alt. Regionchef Lisa Bond på lisa.bond@falcksverige.se

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-31. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Vi undanber oss kontakt med annonserings- och rekryteringsföretag.

description:
Garner Foods is seeking a dependable and safety-focused Process Line Technician to support safe, efficient, and high-quality production. This role performs essential process line functions and helps ensure equipment operates effectively, efficiently, and at peak performance.

What Success Looks Like


A successful Process Line Technician is dependable, safety-minded, detail-oriented, and able to work at production pace without taking shortcuts. This person understands that line operation affects equipment performance, product integrity, food safety, quality, documentation, customer readiness, and the overall flow of production.

HallKeen is seeking a strategic, hands-on leader to serve as Director of Asset Preservation, Construction & Development. This newly created executive role will help protect, enhance, and grow HallKeen’s residential portfolio by strengthening building operations, capital planning, construction oversight, inspection readiness, and long-term asset stewardship.

HallKeen is a mission-driven real estate management and investment organization dedicated to expanding access to affordable and workforce housing along the Eastern Seaboard. With a diverse residential portfolio and decades of operational experience, HallKeen brings together property management, asset management, acquisition, development, and community impact to support long-term resident and portfolio success.


About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director will partner closely with Residential Operations, Asset Management, Development, Finance, and Executive Leadership to ensure HallKeen communities remain safe, financially sustainable, operationally efficient, and inspection-ready.

This is an ideal opportunity for a servant leader who can set enterprise strategy while staying connected to the field—someone equally comfortable advising senior leadership, coaching site teams, supporting emergency response, and overseeing complex capital or occupied rehabilitation projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an enterprise-wide asset preservation strategy aligned with HallKeen’s mission, growth plans, and long-term portfolio objectives.
  • Lead portfolio-wide preventive maintenance, life-cycle replacement, inspection readiness, and capital planning programs.
  • Establish scalable operating standards, technical procedures, KPIs, quality audits, and best practices across a decentralized maintenance organization.
  • Serve as HallKeen’s owner’s representative for acquisitions, redevelopment, rehabilitation, construction, and capital improvement projects.
  • Partner with Development, Operations, Finance, Asset Management, and Executive Leadership on planning, budgeting, permitting, procurement, construction oversight, and project closeout.
  • Build a field-first leadership culture rooted in visibility, accountability, coaching, collaboration, and resident-focused service.
  • Support readiness for HUD NSPIRE, state agency, insurance, lender, investor, fire/life safety, and other regulatory inspections.
  • Champion safety, environmental compliance, sustainability, technology, innovation, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.

title: Senior Associate, Loan Operations
description:
The Senior Associate, Loan Operations, is responsible for managing a portfolio of agented and non-agented loan transactions throughout their lifecycle. This role serves as a key operational partner to Monroe Capital's investment and portfolio management teams, supporting loan closings, funding activities, servicing, cash management, reconciliations, participant settlements, and ongoing portfolio administration. The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of syndicated lending, loan documentation, and servicing operations, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. This is a hybrid position requiring 3-4 days per week in Monroe Capital's Chicago office.


Primary Job Responsibilities:


Loan Portfolio Administration

  • Manage a portfolio of direct agented and non-agented loan transactions from closing through repayment.
  • Monitor loan activity and ensure accurate processing of borrower advances, payments, fees, and contractual events.
  • Maintain complete and accurate loan records within servicing systems.
  • Respond to internal and external inquiries regarding loan balances, interest calculations, fees, expenses, and transaction activity.
  • Proactively identify operational issues or portfolio concerns and escalate to appropriate stakeholders.

Deal Closing and Funding

  • Coordinate the operational execution of new transactions, amendments, restructurings, and other credit-related events.
  • Review credit agreements and related legal documentation to ensure accurate deal setup and servicing requirements.
  • Prepare closing documentation, funding notices, and operational workflows for transaction execution.
  • Collaborate closely with underwriting, legal, treasury, and portfolio management teams to facilitate efficient closings and fundings.
  • Coordinate funding activities with lenders, participants, borrowers, and agent banks.

Cash Management and Reconciliation

  • Perform daily cash reconciliations and ensure accurate recording of all cash activity.
  • Monitor multiple bank accounts and identify incoming borrower, lender, and participant payments.
  • Investigate and resolve cash and position discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Initiate and process wire transfers in accordance with established procedures and controls.

Participant and Stakeholder Management

  • Communicate loan activity, funding events, and servicing updates to lending partners and participants.
  • Coordinate settlement activity among participants and funding partners to ensure accurate allocations and reporting.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with borrowers, lenders, agent banks, and internal business partners.
  • Support audit requests, reporting requirements, and special projects assigned.

title: Foundry Operator
description:
Ermak Foundry & Machining, a fast-growing manufacturing company, is seeking a motivated Foundry Worker to join our team in Chaska, Minnesota. In this entry-level manufacturing role, you will earn a competitive wage, depending on experience, with an incentive based on performance.

  • Operating both manual and automatic molding machines
  • Identifying and addressing any defects in the molds

Our company has been in business for over 60 years and specializes in a unique set of technologies to create our customers' desired products, such as sand casting, CNC machining, and 3D printing. Our goal is to create a network of manufacturing facilities that combine the fantastic customer service you can expect from small businesses with the technology modern factories provide.

Our ideal candidate is a:

  • Self-starter who takes pride in their work and has a strong attention to detail
  • Hard worker who is always willing to put in their best effort
  • Reliable individual who shows up for work on time
  • Responsible person who is cautious and alert when in a manufacturing setting

If you are a hardworking, detail-oriented individual who is looking to take the first step in their manufacturing career, we encourage you to apply today! Our initial mobile-friendly online application is quick and easy to fill out, and we look forward to meeting you soon.

-------

The CaneKast Network

Ermak Foundry & Machining is part of CaneKast. At CaneKast, we believe in the power of local manufacturing and are creating a coast-to-coast network of non-ferrous casting facilities that provide top-quality products, on-time delivery, and outstanding customer service.

We are a team, offering a supportive work environment where everyone is valued and appreciated. We believe that every worker has a vital role to play in our company's success, and we work hard to create a culture of collaboration and innovation where ideas are shared, and everyone has a voice.

Joining the CaneKast team means being part of a company that is dedicated to excellence in everything we do. We are always looking for talented and motivated individuals to join our team and help us achieve our mission of providing high-quality casting services to businesses of all sizes.

Mission:

At CaneKast, we are passionate about providing our customers with the best possible casting services. Our customers have access to workers with decades of experience in the "art" of casting, along with the technological know-how to implement the "science" of materials. We are committed to delivering outstanding customer service and support, and our management team is always available to answer your questions and address your concerns.

Services:

We specialize in non-ferrous foundries and associated services such as CNC machining, heat treating, pattern/prototype development, and secondary finishing. We cover the breadth of casting production from green sand to no-bake/air-set to gravity-fed die-cast/permanent mold.

Join our team and be a part of something great. With CaneKast, you can make a real impact and help us shape the future of manufacturing.

title: Shipping/Receiving Clerks
description:
Verify and maintain records on incoming and outgoing shipments involving inventory. Duties include verifying and recording incoming raw materials, preparing items for shipment, and arranging for the transportation of finished products.

Accountabilities:

· Examine shipment contents and compare with records, such as manifests, invoices, or orders, to verify accuracy.

· Requisition and store shipping materials and supplies to maintain inventory of stock.

· Prepare documents, such as bills of lading or shipping orders, to route materials.

· Pack, seal, label, or affix postage to prepare materials for shipping, using hand tools, power tools, or postage meter.

· Record shipment data, such as weight, charges, space availability, damages, or discrepancies, for reporting, accounting, or recordkeeping purposes.

· Correspond with manufacturing team to rectify problems, such as damages, shortages, or nonconformance to specifications.

· Deliver or route materials to departments using fork-truck, skid-steer, and sorting bins.

· Contact carrier representatives to for arrangements or to issue instructions for shipping and delivery of materials.

· Determine shipping methods, routes, or rates for materials to be shipped.

· Compute amounts, such as space available, shipping, storage, or demurrage charges, using computer or price list.

· Compare shipping routes or methods to determine best option.
