title: Senior Director, Growth
description:
We are entering our next massive phase of growth. As demand for edge AI and intelligent automation skyrockets, we need a leader to shape our market presence, drive global demand, scale ecosystem partnerships, and establish SNUC as the category-defining platform for AI at the edge.


This isn't a role for someone who wants to inherit a machine. It's a role for someone who wants to build one.


The Mission

The next wave of AI won't run in the cloud. It will run at the edge. From military vehicles and autonomous robots to retail floors and critical infrastructure, the future demands split-second decisions with zero tolerance for failure.


SNUC Systems builds the rugged, modular, AI-ready compute platforms that power these mission-critical applications worldwide. Originally founded in 2015 as Simply NUC, we’ve evolved to dominate the edge AI infrastructure space.


Why Join Us?

  • Massive Scale: 950,000+ computing solutions deployed across 65+ countries.
  • Elite Trust: Our solutions support national tactical operations, border networks, aerospace facilities, and advanced industrial automation.
  • Our DNA: We do what others won't, saying yes to customization, speed, and complex hardware problems.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Growth leads SNUC's Growth function and is responsible for market awareness, demand generation, product marketing, partner marketing, communications, and commercial insight.


Working closely with Sales, Channel, Strategic Alliances, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations, this role helps identify growth opportunities, strengthen market positioning, accelerate pipeline creation, and improve commercial effectiveness.


The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with practical execution and be comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth technology environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Strategic Growth & Commercial Planning

  • Develop and execute SNUC's growth strategy in alignment with company objectives and revenue priorities.
  • Contribute to go-to-market planning and commercial strategy as a member of the commercial leadership team.
  • Translate market intelligence into actionable growth initiatives, investment priorities, and commercial programs.
  • Provide executive insight on market trends, competitive dynamics, pipeline performance, campaign effectiveness, and future growth opportunities.

Market Intelligence & Commercial Insights

  • Develop a deep understanding of customers, markets, competitors, industry trends, and emerging technologies.
  • Define and maintain Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and Ideal Partner Profiles (IPPs) to guide commercial decision-making.
  • Identify and prioritize target industries, customer segments, and strategic growth opportunities.
  • Provide actionable insight that helps the business prioritize customers, partners, markets, and investments.
  • Establish repeatable processes for competitive intelligence, market research, and commercial analysis.

Demand Generation & Pipeline Development

  • Lead demand generation programs across digital marketing, account-based marketing, partner marketing, field marketing, events, and targeted growth initiatives.
  • Drive measurable pipeline growth across SNUC's Sell-To, Sell-With, and Design-In go-to-market motions.
  • Ensure growth programs align with strategic priorities and revenue objectives.
  • Monitor, measure, and optimize campaign performance, engagement, and pipeline contribution through data-driven decision making.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Strategic Alliance teams to maximize growth program effectiveness and pipeline conversion.

Product Marketing & Market Positioning

  • Own the company's product marketing strategy and market positioning framework.
  • Develop differentiated messaging that clearly communicates SNUC's value proposition to customers, partners, and the sales organization.
  • Support product launches and go-to-market initiatives through coordinated messaging, enablement, and market activation.
  • Ensure consistent positioning across sales, marketing, partner, and customer-facing activities.

Brand, Communications & Digital Strategy

  • Oversee corporate communications, digital strategy, website development, social media, public relations, and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Ensure consistent messaging, positioning, and brand representation across all external communications and engagement channels.
  • Strengthen market awareness, brand credibility, and industry visibility within target customer and partner communities.

Partner Marketing

  • Develop joint marketing programs in collaboration with Channel and Strategic Alliance teams.
  • Support co-marketing initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and pipeline creation.
  • Help strengthen SNUC's presence within key partner communities and routes to market.
  • Collaborate closely with partner-facing teams while maintaining clear separation from commercial ownership of partner relationships.

Data, Automation & AI Enablement

  • Leverage data, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve market intelligence, campaign execution, customer engagement, and commercial effectiveness.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve reporting, attribution, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Identify technologies and processes that create competitive advantage and improve the effectiveness of the Growth organization.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and evolve an existing Growth team while building additional capabilities as the business scales.
  • Establish scalable operating models, processes, and performance frameworks.
  • Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on market trends, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities.
  • Carry out any other duties as reasonably required in line with the needs of the business

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day team operations, including scheduling, attendance, and time-off coordination to ensure appropriate coverage
  • Set clear performance expectations and monitor progress against established metrics; provide regular feedback and conduct 1:1 check-ins
  • Train, coach, and develop team members to support skill development, performance improvement, and operational flexibility
  • Ensure people management practices are applied consistently and in line with company policies and applicable regional employment requirements; partner with Human Resources to seek guidance where needed
  • Expected direct reports may include:
  • Marketing Communications
  • Product Marketing
  • Partner Marketing
  • Creative Services and Multimedia
  • Web Development and Digital Experience resources

Travel

  • 25% - 40% Required, including international travel

Working Conditions/Physical Demands

  • Requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Frequent use of video conferencing tools and participation in virtual meetings across global time zones; occasional early morning or evening meetings may be required.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate in a professional environment, both virtually and in person.
  • Occasional walking or movement within the office (e.g., to attend in-person meetings, access office equipment, or collaborate with local teams).
  • Minimal physical exertion; occasional lifting of office materials or equipment (e.g., laptops, projectors) under 20 lbs may be required.
  • The office environment may include moderate noise levels from standard office equipment and conversations.

title: Senior Analyst Components
description:
• Challenge yourself in a critical procurement role supporting Qantas Engineering operations
  • Join a collaborative Supply Chain team focused on performance and continuous improvement
  • Permanent, full-time opportunity based at the Sydney Distribution Centre, Mascot
  • Competitive salary package (ASU Level 9) plus employee travel benefits

Today, we’re busy planning for tomorrow. We look to the future to guide the way we innovate, helping us stay relevant and responsive in an always evolving industry.

We pride ourselves on forward thinking. We’re not afraid to challenge, we invent boldly, and we purposefully disrupt. In an industry defined by constant competition and transformation, we stay ahead by creating outstanding products and services for our customers. Together, we deliver positive business outcomes through thoughtful, cost-conscious decisions that make a genuine difference to the customer experience.

As part of Supply Chain Operations, the Senior Analyst Components plays a critical role in ensuring the timely procurement and availability of aircraft components to support Qantas Engineering and operational requirements. Working with both contracted and non-contracted suppliers, you'll manage end-to-end purchasing activities, monitor supplier performance, and ensure materials are delivered to meet business and customer expectations.

You'll collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to resolve supply and inventory issues, expedite critical orders, and drive effective procurement outcomes. Using data and insights to identify trends and improvement opportunities, you'll also support supplier performance management, investigate quality and service issues, and provide guidance to team members to help achieve supply chain performance objectives

You’ll have –

  • Sound knowledge and experience working within a purchasing function or similar experience
  • Experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain operations
  • Experience sourcing and procuring aircraft components or technical materials (desirable)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience managing supplier relationships, contracts and performance
  • Advanced Excel and reporting capabilities
  • Experience working with procurement systems and buying processes (desirable)
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities
  • A customer-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day one with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.

Superloop provides connectivity and services to customers in three segments of the market: Consumer, Business and Wholesale. Our offerings leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets that include fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop and Exetel every day for their connectivity needs.

Visit to learn more.


Business Unit Overview

The Consumer unit is the face of our retail brand that is committed to delivering on our customer promise; Super fast, Super reliable and Super easy internet access for all Australian homes. As a part of the Consumer unit, you will bring together systems, processes and people that deliver this experience across the customer touchpoints and customer lifecycle.

The Superloop Home Broadband team is the face of our retail connectivity brand. Our contact centre is committed to creating a positive customer experience through the availability and continuity of our services, and with the engagements we have with our customers. The team is the engine room of our residential brand, enabling growth through team development, continuous process improvement, and industry-leading customer service. As a customer focused team, we deliver solutions to our customers through rigorous technical understanding of our products, and exemplifying superior customer service skills in every interaction.

Role Purpose

The Head of Transformation Enablement (Consumer) sets and leads the Consumer AI and automation agenda. Working horizontally across Sales, Marketing, Customer Value Management, Product, Operations and Compliance to enable business leaders to achieve growth, customer, productivity and risk outcomes by embedding AI and automation into how work is designed and delivered.

The role builds and governs a prioritised portfolio of opportunities, establishes the operating model and reusable capabilities required to scale them, and ensures adoption and value realisation. As an embedded strategic partner to the Consumer Leadership Team, the role connects business priorities with data, technology and delivery capability to turn experimentation into sustainable business practice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and portfolio leadership: Define and maintain the Consumer AI and automation strategy, multi-year roadmap and investment portfolio, aligned to the Consumer business strategy and enterprise technology direction.

  • Cross-functional opportunity shaping: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Value Management, Product, Operations and Compliance to identify material problems and opportunities, redesign journeys and workflows, and translate them into prioritised initiatives with clear owners, business cases and success measures.

  • Targeted retail capability: Partner with Marketing to use data and AI to improve audience targeting, proposition relevance and conversion across retail channels.

  • Delivery enablement and scale: Establish the ways of working, reusable patterns and cross-functional delivery mechanisms needed to move initiatives from discovery and experimentation to scaled, business-as-usual capability; remove barriers and manage dependencies across teams.

  • Value realisation: Own portfolio-level performance and benefits tracking across revenue growth, conversion, retention, customer experience, productivity, cost to serve and risk; provide transparent reporting and recommend where to start, stop, accelerate or scale investment.

  • Governance and responsible AI: Establish decision rights, guardrails and assurance for AI and automation, ensuring privacy, security, data, regulatory, model risk and customer fairness requirements are built into the full lifecycle.

  • Adoption and operating model: Lead the organisational change required to embed new capabilities, including workflow and role redesign, communications, training, leadership routines and measures that drive sustained adoption.

  • Team and ecosystem leadership: Build and lead a high-performing enablement team and partner ecosystem; develop internal capability, source specialist expertise where required, and maintain an informed view of emerging technologies and market practice.


Qualifications and Experience

Required

  • Significant senior leadership experience in business enablement, digital change, AI and automation, or an adjacent discipline within a complex, customer-centred organisation.

  • A track record of defining and executing a cross-functional AI and automation strategy or large-scale change portfolio, taking capabilities from idea or pilot through to adoption at scale.

  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable commercial, customer, operational and risk outcomes.

  • Strong commercial and portfolio acumen, including opportunity sizing, business cases, prioritisation, investment trade-offs and benefits realisation.

  • Exceptional influencing and partnership skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity across executives and functions without relying on direct authority.

  • Sound understanding of AI and automation capabilities and limitations, responsible AI principles, and associated data, privacy, security and regulatory considerations.

  • Proven people leadership and change leadership experience, including building teams, developing capability and driving sustained adoption.

  • A relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent practical experience.

Desired

  • Experience in telecommunications, internet or broadband, or a comparable consumer subscription services industry.

  • Experience operating in a challenger and/or multi-brand environment.

  • Practical exposure to generative AI, AI agents, intelligent automation, workflow orchestration, conversational AI or related technologies.

  • Experience in customer journey design, service design, process redesign or product-led operating models.

  • A postgraduate qualification in business, technology or a related discipline.

On Offer

  • Free Home Broadband

  • Free Mobile SIM plan

  • Flexibility – 3 days/week in the office

  • Lunch on Wednesdays, snacks, donuts and more!

  • Diverse and inclusive culture

  • Gain skills and build relationships to succeed in the telco and tech industries, at Superloop and beyond.


At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. We’re committed to ensuring that our hiring processes are accessible and inclusive for everyone interested in joining Superloop.

title: Warehouse Assistant
description:
Purpose

The Warehouse Assistant plays a critical role in supporting the manufacturing and distribution processes. This position ensures efficient operations by handling inventory, processing orders, maintaining accurate stock records, and ensuring timely dispatch of goods. The role is essential in ensuring a smooth flow of materials and products within the warehouse, contributing to the overall production and delivery timeline.

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform daily operations such as receiving, handling, issuing, picking, packing, and shipping of materials and finished goods.
  • Ensure all work orders are processed and materials issued to production lines within defined deadlines.
  • Ensure accurate storage of materials, especially controlled items (e.g., items with shelf life or requiring special storage conditions).
  • Regularly update inventory records and bin cards to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Conduct weekly cycle counts and participate in the Annual Physical Stock Count to achieve stock accuracy.
  • Coordinate with the order fulfillment team and logistics providers for timely dispatch and delivery of customer orders.
  • Cross-check material part numbers and quantities with Goods Receipt (GR) slips to ensure accuracy in inventory data.
  • Maintain the safety and security of the store and shipping area, ensuring compliance with safety guidelines and protocols.
  • Uphold good housekeeping practices and adherence to 5S standards (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain) to maintain a clean, organized, and efficient working environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum SPM/GCE “O” level or equivalent qualifications.
  • At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in warehouse/store operations within a manufacturing or related industry.
  • Familiarity with inventory management systems such as SAP or equivalent ERP systems is advantageous.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) for basic reporting and record keeping.
  • Physically fit to handle manual warehouse tasks, including operating pallet jacks and stackers.
  • Willingness to work overtime when required, based on production needs.
  • Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external vendors/logistics partners.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Ensure accuracy in all aspects of inventory handling and documentation.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet tight deadlines, especially when dealing with time-sensitive production and shipping orders.
  • Capable of troubleshooting issues in inventory discrepancies, material shortages, or shipping delays.
  • Interpersonal skills to work effectively within a team and coordinate with various departments (production, logistics, quality assurance, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt to changing warehouse environments, workflows, and priorities.

title: Electro-Mechanical Assembler
description:
We have an immediate opportunity for an Electro-Mechanical Assembler to build electrical and mechanical subassemblies and integrate them into higher level assemblies used in Semiconductor testing equipment.


Job Description

In this position, you will work with electrical or electronic components, such as modules, circuit boards, wiring harnesses, machined parts, and commercial fasteners, etc. This role involves following repetitive production standards so we will consider any applicant with manual dexterity and electro-mechanical aptitude. Successful Electro-Mechanical Assembler candidates need to have the ability to use electrical assembly hand tools such as crimpers, cutters, drivers, soldering tools as well as mechanical assembly tools, i.e. hand drills, wrenches, drivers is required.


Duties and Responsibilities include:

  • Ability to read and interpret BOM’s, Work Instructions, Travelers, Blueprints, Routers, and Engineering Change Notices to include Engineering modifications and designs.
  • Mechanical Assembly of complex components with the ability to follow engineering blueprints and assembly sequences with care and accuracy.
  • Fitment and inspection of assembly is necessary to ensure product has met desired requirements.
  • Electrical Assembly of complex components where a high degree of problem-solving with care and accuracy.
  • Routes, wires, assembles, and installs electrical and electronic components in cabinets, electronics enclosures and on assembled machines to complete functionality of integrated components according to specifications.
  • Cuts wire to specified lengths, using wire cutters using soldering gun and hand tools.
  • Crimps terminal eyelets and lugs to wire ends, using hand or machine crimping devices.
  • Routes, combs, twists, wraps, ties, and attaches wire to terminal points, according to layout, using soldering gun and hand tools.
  • Conducts functional and continuity tests of electrical assemblies, components, wire harness, and plugs, using ohmmeter, test lights, and other electrical testing instruments.
  • Perform electrical and mechanical tests on finished products before packaging.
  • Ability to follow written and oral instructions.
  • Maintain a clean and safe workspace.
  • Complete other tasks as necessary.

title: Lead RF Systems Engineer
description:
About Chartis Federal

Chartis Federal is a premier systems engineering and integration firm specializing in mission-critical IT and communications solutions for law enforcement, homeland security, and defense. As a trusted prime contractor with over $160 million in task order awards, we operate across 22 states and support essential government missions worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has fueled our year-over-year growth, earning us recognition twice as a Washington Technology FAST 50 company and securing a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years. At Chartis Federal, our mission is clear: keeping heroes safe and connected—on the battlefield, on the border, and in our backyards.


Position Overview

The Lead RF Systems Engineer will serve as the primary RF engineering execution lead for the eCOMM VI P-25 Digital Trunked Land Mobile Radio (LMR) modernization across St. Croix, St. Thomas, and St. John


This role is responsible for RF design implementation, coverage modeling, drive testing, antenna configuration, and system optimization to ensure reliable, interoperable public safety communications across the U.S. Virgin Islands.

The Lead RF Systems Engineer works under the technical direction of the Chief Systems Engineer and in coordination with the Program Manager and Deputy PM.


This position is contingent upon contract award.


Responsibilities

RF Design & Coverage Modeling

  • Develop RF propagation models and coverage maps for P-25 Digital LMR system deployment.
  • Conduct and analyze RF coverage drive testing.
  • Perform carrier frequency analysis and interference mitigation planning.
  • Support FCC licensing data preparation.

Site Surveys & Field Engineering

  • Conduct on-site technical surveys for tower and antenna placement.
  • Support site acquisition technical evaluations.
  • Validate antenna height, azimuth, tilt, and waveguide/coaxial configurations.
  • Participate in geotechnical and structural coordination meetings as needed.

Installation Support & Validation

  • Provide technical guidance during installation of:
    • Antennas and waveguide systems
    • Microwave radio terminals
    • DC power systems
    • MPLS network components
  • Validate antenna sweep results.
  • Ensure RF configurations meet engineered specifications.

Optimization & Performance Testing

  • Lead RF optimization following installation.
  • Analyze signal strength, coverage gaps, and reliability metrics.
  • Conduct interoperability testing between islands.
  • Support parallel operations during migration from legacy analog LMR to P-25 digital system
  • Provide technical certification input prior to system cutover.

Documentation & Technical Reporting

  • Develop coverage reports, drive test reports, and performance validation documentation.
  • Provide technical updates to Chief Systems Engineer and Program Manager.
  • Contribute to final technical documentation and handover package.

description:

  • Escalate complex ownership issues, legal concerns, and customer disputes to management when appropriate.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, department procedures, and applicable legal requirements.
  • Maintain detailed transaction records and documentation throughout all stages of the transfer process.
  • Monitor processing timelines and service-level expectations to ensure timely completion of ownership transfers.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives, special projects, and departmental support activities.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish required, with the ability to speak, read, and write fluently in both languages.

title: Personliga assistenter deltid 50-75 % sökes till 10-årig flicka i Huddinge
description:
På Bonzi arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

Bonzi söker nu 3 engagerade och trygga personliga assistenter till en 10-årig flicka som bor med sin familj i Flemingsberg, Huddinge. Bostaden ligger nära goda kommunikationer, vilket gör det enkelt att ta sig till och från arbetet.

Flickan har en hjärnskada och epilepsi och har inget tal. Flickan är icke-verbal och kommunicerar därför på andra sätt än genom tal. Som personlig assistent är det viktigt att vara lyhörd och uppmärksam på hennes signaler, kroppsspråk och uttryck för att kunna förstå henne. Assistans ges inte under skoltid, utan personlig assistans finns efter skoldagens slut och under övrig tid

Som personlig assistent kommer du att ge stöd i hennes vardag och hjälpa till med personlig omvårdnad Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat förflyttningar, dusch, blöjbyten samt på- och avklädning. I arbetet används hjälpmedel som duschstol, elrullstol och lift.

Tjänsterna är på deltid med varierande tjänstgöringsgrader. Du behöver kunna arbeta både vardagar och helger. Vi söker även vikarier vid behov som vikarie vid behov arbetar du vid ordinarie assistenters frånvaro vid semester eller annan ledighet

Vidare så önskar anhöriga endast kvinnliga assistenter

Arbetstider:

  • Vardagar: kl. 13.30–22.30

  • Helger: kl. 12.00–22.30

Krav:

  • Erfarenhet som personlig assistent eller liknande arbete inom vård och omsorg

  • Du är rökfri/icke-rökare

Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet av epilepsi

  • Erfarenhet av arbete med barn med omfattande hjälpbehov

Vi söker dig som är lugn, trygg och ansvarsfull och som tycker om att arbeta med barn. Du behöver vara lyhörd för flickans behov och kunna skapa en trygg och stabil miljö omkring henne.

Det viktigaste är att du är engagerad, omtänksam och har ett genuint intresse av att göra vardagen trygg och bra för flickan. Introduktion och upplärning ges utifrån hennes individuella behov.

Omfattning: 3 tjänster varierande tjänstgöringsgrader 50-75% vi söker även dig som vill arbeta som vikarie vid behov , 1 tjänst

Tillträde: Intervjuer sker löpande och kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal

Att tänka på inför din ansökan:

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos på Bonzi är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned från Skatteverkets webbplats.

För att arbeta som personlig assistent, ledsagare eller avlösare hos oss måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Ålderskravet följer av reglerna om personlig assistans, ledsagning och avlösning i LSS och socialförsäkringsbalken.

För att arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdragen beställs via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Du beställer enkelt utdragen med Bank-ID via denna länk:

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

För dig med anställningsstöd: Bonzi är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Om rekryteringsprocessen: Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia.

En del av Team Olivia

Bonzi ingår i koncernen Team Olivia. Team Olivia har utvecklats till ett ledande omsorgsföretag med att etablerade bolag under lokala varumärken.

title: Systems Technologist
description:
About Chartis Federal

Chartis Federal is a premier systems engineering and integration firm specializing in mission-critical IT and communications solutions for law enforcement, homeland security, and defense. As a trusted prime contractor with over $160 million in task order awards, we operate across 22 states and support essential government missions worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has fueled our year-over-year growth, earning us recognition twice as a Washington Technology FAST 50 company and securing a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years. At Chartis Federal, our mission is clear: keeping heroes safe and connected on the battlefield, on the border, and in our backyards.


Position Summary

Chartis Federal is seeking an experienced Systems Technologist to support secure tactical communications operations within U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Tactical Communications (TACCOM) environments.


This role supports the full lifecycle of Over-The-Air Rekeying (OTAR) operations and cryptographic key management, ensuring the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of mission-critical Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems. The OTAR Specialist operates in a 24x7x365 mission environment, supporting provisioning, secure communications continuity, system integrity, and operational readiness in accordance with DHS and CBP standards.


Responsibilities

  • Support the full lifecycle of OTAR and cryptographic key management, including controlled key generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, validation, and tracking
  • Issue and manage Radio Service Identifications (RSIs), IP addressing, and associated communications provisioning data
  • Configure, update, and maintain OTAR provisioning data in accordance with CBP operational requirements
  • Operate and maintain Key Management Facility (KMF) systems and associated tools
  • Utilize Key Variable Loaders (KVLs) to securely load, manage, and maintain encryption keys
  • Support OTAR-enabled P25 Land Mobile Radio (LMR) communications systems across mission environments
  • Perform validation and verification of provisioning data and cryptographic key loads to ensure accuracy and system alignment
  • Track OTAR activities, incidents, and operational requests using enterprise systems such as Remedy, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms
  • Generate and maintain operational reports related to secure voice Push-to-Talk (PTT) activity, OTAR performance, and system readiness
  • Analyze operational data and reporting outputs to identify trends, improve processes, and support mission decision-making
  • Provide first-echelon and escalated support for OTAR provisioning, secure communications issues, and subscriber support requests
  • Diagnose and resolve key synchronization, provisioning discrepancies, and secure communications failures
  • Maintain accurate documentation, audit records, and traceability of OTAR activities to ensure compliance with DHS and CBP accountability standards
  • Support inventory accountability processes, including Local Property Officer (LPO) or asset tracking functions as required
  • Coordinate with internal teams, government stakeholders, and vendors to support ongoing TACCOM operations
  • Support ad hoc mission requirements, surge activities, and technical initiative
  • Ensure compliance with federal cybersecurity, communications security (COMSEC), and CBP/DHS operational policies

DEPARTMENTSUMMARY: The Critical Care RN positions include bedside RNs on various units throughout St. Charles Health System. These departments include all Intensive Care Units, the Intermediate Care Unit, Progressive Care Unit and Critical Care Floats. These departments provide 24/7 specialized care to patients throughout their hospitalization and discharge.

POSITION OVERVIEW: The RN provides quality patient and family centered care as a member of the health care team in accordance with St. Charles Health System mission, philosophy, policies, and procedures. Applies standards for professional nursing practice and focuses clinical care to enhance the experience for patients, families, and all others. As a nurse, this position will oversee the work of other caregivers, providing specific care to assigned patient(s) throughout the shift, as required under the scope of the RN licensure.

Maintains and demonstrates an in-depth knowledge of nursing principles, practices, standards, and techniques and applies this knowledge in accordance with St. Charles Health System policies and procedures and within laws and regulations governing nursing practice in the State of Oregon.

Assesses the patient’s condition and needs using critical thinking and clinical judgment: sets outcomes; implements appropriate nursing actions and collaborates with other disciplines to meet the patient’s/family’s physical, emotional, spiritual, social, and intellectual needs; and evaluates patient’s progress.

Calculates dosages and administers medications accurately in accordance with St. Charles Health System policies and procedures for medication administration.

Documents all patient care with proficiency in compliance with hospital policies, procedures and regulatory agencies.

Strong teamwork and collaborative skills.

Strong analytical, problem solving and decision making skills.

title: NEA Teen Intern
description:
The Worcester Art Museum invites curious, creative teens from across Worcester and surrounding communities to join our Learning & Engagement Division as NEA Teen Interns in the Studio Classes Department. This paid, part-time internship is designed for teens ages 14-19 who want to spend time in a creative environment, learn how a museum works from the inside, and explore possible futures in the arts, education, museums, or cultural fields. The internship begins on September 25, 2026, and runs primarily on Fridays (with opportunities for additional hours during vacation weeks and special programs), through the end of August 2027. Interns will form a cohort of 15 teens, learning together while building confidence, community, and creative momentum.


As an NEA Teen Intern, you’ll be welcomed into the day-to-day life of the Museum through guided experiences with staff and teaching artists. Each week, you’ll have opportunities to collaborate with professionals, ask questions, and explore different parts of arts education work, including education and public programs, creative planning, classroom support, communication, teamwork, and problem-solving. After an introductory period, interns will be able to assist with youth studio classes, observe and support teaching, contribute ideas to ongoing projects, and take part in conversations about creative careers and professional pathways. No two weeks will look exactly the same, and that variety is intentional: this internship is meant to help you discover what excites you, where your strengths lie, and how your creative voice fits into a larger community.


We’re looking for teens who are curious, open-minded, and eager to learn in a shared environment. You don’t need to know exactly what you want to do in the future, and you do not need prior museum, teaching, or formal art experience to apply. This internship is an opportunity to explore, build confidence, and learn alongside others. We especially encourage applications from teens who may be new to museums, who are exploring their interests, or who bring perspectives and experiences that are not always centered in arts and cultural spaces. Interest in creativity, community, working with others, or learning how programs come together is just as valuable as experience making art.

Salary Range: $15.50 per hour

title: Software Engineer IV
description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

What You Will Do

Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Embed within product teams to deliver end-to-end AI/ML integrations — API orchestration, workflow management, and error handling — directly inside the host team's codebase and release processes.
  • Produce structured handover artefacts for every engagement: merged PRs, architecture notes, runbooks, observability dashboards, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Integration & Pipeline Engineering

  • Implement and extend Cognition's integration patterns — coordinator/extractor/mailbox services, Kafka pipeline patterns, and RESTful API contracts.
  • Own and scale the Cognition v3 architecture — data pre-processing, post-processing, the audit sub-system, and the Conduct integration pipeline — handling high message volumes with reliable throughput.
  • Instrument services with Prometheus and Grafana; maintain observability across Logic's owned components.

Key Initiatives (2026)

  • OCRaaS at scale — deliver the OCR-as-a-Service integration for eDiscovery and Conduct.
  • Mature as-a-Service patterns to simplify access to Cognition AI/ML capabilities across the product estate.
  • Enhanced attachment processing — extend the Cognition ingestion pipeline to handle larger attachments at higher throughput, removing current size and volume constraints for customers.
  • Cognition v3 reliability — harden the pre/post-processing communication surveillance pipeline for production resilience, operational visibility, and zero-surprise deployments.

AI Enablement & Engineering Standards

  • Champion and actively use AI productivity tooling (Windsurf, Claude Code) and embed these practices in the teams you work with.
  • Write clean, well-tested Kotlin (or Java); contribute to architecture and design reviews across Logic and host teams.

What We Offer

Smarsh exists to protect the truth — preserving the integrity of communications across the world's most regulated industries. The AI you build here does not power recommendation feeds or ad targeting. It runs inside the compliance workflows of Tier 1 banks, global asset managers, and regulated enterprises where auditability, accuracy, and trust are non-negotiable.

You will work at the frontier of that mission — integrating AI and moving into agentic AI to solve problems that have no off-the-shelf answer. The constraints of highly regulated environments make the engineering harder and the outcomes more durable. That combination is rare.

  • Scope — your work spans Conduct, eDiscovery, and Enterprise Archive, with direct impact on the capabilities Smarsh brings to its most strategic customers.
  • Visibility — sustained interaction with senior engineering and product leadership, and a seat at decisions that shape platform direction.
  • Progression — a clear path toward Lead Engineer, Architect, or Engineering Manager within Cognition Engineering, in an organisation that treats engineering craft seriously.
About our culture

title: Senior Research Scientist - Toxicology - Camurus (Lund)
description:
Camurus is an international, science-led biopharmaceutical company committed to developing and commercializing innovative, long-acting medicines for improving the lives of patients with severe and chronic diseases. New drug products with best-in-class potential are conceived based on the company’s proprietary FluidCrystal® technology and its extensive R&D expertise. The R&D pipeline includes products for the treatment of dependence, pain, cancer, and endocrine diseases. Camurus has operations across Europe, the US, and Australia, with headquarters in Lund Sweden. The company’s shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker CAMX. For more information, visit and LinkedIn.

In this role, you will join the Non-Clinical Development team in Lund and contribute to the development of innovative medicines in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will play a central role in the toxicological strategy for Camurus' products, working closely with colleagues across multiple disciplines as well as external partners.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Research Scientist, Toxicology to join our Non-Clinical Development team.

This is a strategic and cross-functional role where you will be responsible for developing non-clinical plans, designing toxicology programs and coordinating outsourced non-GLP and GLP toxicology studies performed by Contract Research Organizations (CROs). Acting as Sponsor Monitor, you will oversee study design, study conduct, data review and final reports, ensuring scientific quality, regulatory compliance and timely delivery. You will also contribute to regulatory submissions by preparing and reviewing non-clinical documentation and representing Non-Clinical Development in product development teams.

Main responsibility
Among others, your responsibilities will include:

· Develop toxicology strategies and non-clinical development plans.

· Design and monitor outsourced GLP studies.

· Select, manage and collaborate with international CRO partners.

· Prepare and review toxicology reports and regulatory documentation.

· Represent Non-Clinical Development in cross-functional development teams.

· Ensure compliance with GLP and international regulatory requirements (ICH, FDA, EMA and OECD).

Candidate profile
You hold a PhD or MSc in Toxicology, Pharmacology or another relevant Life Science discipline.

You have several years of experience from non-clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO industry. Experience of planning, monitoring or conducting GLP toxicology studies is essential, and you are familiar with outsourced development and regulatory requirements. Experience as a Sponsor Monitor or Study Director is highly valued.

You are an experienced scientific writer with solid knowledge of regulatory documentation. You are able to author the full range of non-clinical documentation, e.g non-clinical overviews and summaries for regulatory submissions, and the non-clinical parts of the Investigator’s Brochure (IB). Experience of regulatory submissions is an advantage.

As a person, you are collaborative, structured and proactive. You enjoy coordinating complex projects, building strong relationships and working in a cross-functional, international and deadline-driven environment. Fluency in spoken and written English is required.

Camurus offers

This a great opportunity to join a highly dynamic company during a very exciting phase of growth. Camurus has been very successful in bringing pharmaceutical products to the market – and the ambitions are not to be lowered. With a diversified project portfolio in different stages, the commercial potential is considerable. The position offers an international work environment and corporate culture, with the possibility for individual development and growth. You will have great opportunities to influence, and you will work together with highly competent colleagues, caring for each other.

You will have a broad area of responsibility and drive multiple non-clinical programs, working closely with leading international CROs and cross-functional development teams. With your toxicology background you will have a crucial role in R&D related activities.

Camurus has almost 300 employees with the head office located in Lund. The corporate culture is driven by our core values of innovation, collaboration, ownership, quality, and passion for realizing our patient-centric commitment.

title: Product Manager
description:
What you’ll be doing

You'll own discovery and roadmap delivery end to end for one or more of Fuse's product areas in and around our auction core, including tooling, workflows, and platform capabilities that publishers and our internal teams rely on every day. That might mean the interfaces publishers use to understand and control their setup, data visualisation and automation for user and customer decision making, or core integrations into our platform to improve monetisation and ad serving.

This is a genuine ownership role. You'll own initiatives outright, including its roadmap, its backlog, user and customer conversations and will be accountable for outcomes. Fuse is a technical product and to make your mark here, you'll need to develop real fluency with the system and ecosystem we operate in. You do not need Adtech experience to apply, but you do need curiosity, strong product fundamentals, and the instinct to tie every piece of work back to what it does for customers and the business.

  • Own discovery, prioritisation, and roadmap delivery for your product area, building a coherent, evidence-based roadmap from customer, user, and business needs.
  • Turn publisher feedback, internal signals, and support patterns into a scored, prioritised backlog, and make your trade-offs legible to stakeholders.
  • Write clear problem statements and specifications that engineers can build from directly, making ambiguous problems unambiguous for the team.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial team through delivery: surface risks early, make pragmatic scope trade-offs, and take shipped work through measurement and iteration.
  • Talk to customer and internal users regularly and let what you hear visibly shape the roadmap.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in a product management role with end-to-end ownership of technical products or features.
  • A track record of shipping in a technical domain, working closely with engineering.
  • Fluent in writing specs, PRDs, or equivalent artefacts that others build from directly.
  • Strong product fundamentals: discovery, prioritisation, and roadmap ownership.
  • Experience managing products with different levels of customers and users.
  • You measure yourself on outcomes, not shipped features - and you instinctively translate ideas into revenue, adoption, retention, or efficiency terms.
  • You're energised rather than intimidated by unfamiliar technical systems, and you're comfortable in detailed conversations with Engineers and Data Scientists
  • You write sharply, and others have built directly from your specs, PRDs, or equivalent artefacts.
  • You're comfortable owning a broad, ambiguous space and creating clarity in it rather than waiting for it.
  • You treat AI tooling as leverage in your day-to-day work. Our product workflows are agent-assisted, and you'll extend them rather than resist them.
  • Comfort working with data directly, for example in SQL or spreadsheet-level analysis to support your own decisions.
  • Experience with operational or internal-facing products, where the user is an expert and the workflows are complex.

We know not everyone will meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

A few other things we want you to know...

  • As an equal opportunity employer, Publift welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and life experiences. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported
  • If you have a disability or require adjustments to participate fully in the recruitment process, please let us know - we’re here to support you.
  • We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, including part-time options. If you’d like to explore this, just ask during the process.
  • We’re also a proud Circle Back Initiative employer, which means we commit to responding to every applicant.
  • Successful candidates joining the team will need to complete a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights.

So come and join us - because every role contributes something meaningful as we embark on this exciting journey of growth and innovation.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on jatkuvan kehittämisen asenne ja halu viedä asioita eteenpäin. Tehtävässä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri toimintojen ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Menestyäksesi tässä roolissa osaat johtaa omaa työskentelyäsi tehokkaasti ja ottaa vastuuta tavoitteidesi saavuttamisesta.

Pääset tutustumaan laajasti koko Oras Groupin toimintaan. Organisaatiomme toimintakulttuurille ovat ominaisia matala hierarkia, joustavat toimintatavat sekä nopea päätöksenteko. Energinen ja avoin työyhteisömme arvostaa jokaista työntekijää yksilönä, ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi tuetaan monin eri tavoin.

Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon, tuetun lounasedun, puhelinedun sekä vapaa-ajan etuja, kuten ePassin.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Plant Service Manager Janne Nieminen p. +358408496912.

Hakemukset tehtävään tulisi lähettää 2.9.2026 mennessä kotisivujemme kautta.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja etenemme potentiaalisten kandidaattien kanssa jo hakuaikana, joten lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, jos tehtävä herätti kiinnostuksesi.

Yrityksestä

Oras Group on monen brändin kokonaisvaltainen kylpyhuonetuotteiden toimittaja, jolla on vahva asema Pohjoismaissa ja merkittävä läsnäolo Keski-Euroopassa. Neljän brändimme – Oras, HANSA, Gustavsberg ja Vatette – kautta yhdistämme palkitun muotoilun, luotettavan teknologian ja kestävät ratkaisut, jotka rikastuttavat arjen kylpyhuone- ja keittiökokemuksia.

Yhtiön pääkonttori sijaitsee Raumalla, ja sillä on toimipisteitä ympäri Eurooppaa. Tuotantolaitokset sijaitsevat Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Puolassa. Oras Groupin omistaa Oras Invest, suomalainen perheyritys ja pitkäjänteinen teollinen omistaja.

title: Brisbane 2026/27 Clerkship Program
description:
About Allens

Allens is a leading international law firm trusted on some of Australia’s most complex and defining matters. We work at the intersection of business, law and change—helping clients navigate new challenges, emerging risks and first‑of‑their‑kind issues.

What sets us apart is how we work. We bring together curious, driven people who are deeply invested in delivering outcomes that matter for clients, our communities and each other. Through our alliance with Linklaters, our teams are connected to a global network spanning 40 offices across 25 countries, creating opportunities to learn, collaborate and build international careers.

At Allens, shaping the future is a shared effort—one that values initiative, thoughtful challenge and a willingness to stretch.

Our clerkship program

For a head start in your legal career, apply for a clerkship in our Brisbane office. You’ll work alongside some of the most experienced lawyers in Australia and gain first-hand insight into the type of work you could do as a lawyer at Allens.

You’ll get to be part of a team, contributing to real matters and be supported by a partner, senior lawyer and a junior lawyer, who will ensure you get the most out of your clerkship, get to know our people, and thrive.

We believe we stand out as an employer because of our high-quality technical training, strong learning culture and focus on building capability that makes a real impact for our clients. We’ll work with you to develop your understanding of commercial law and build the skills you need to thrive as a lawyer, while being involved in some of the market's most complex domestic and global transactions.

We offer clerkship programs across two periods—one over summer and one over winter—to coincide with university holidays. During your clerkship, you’ll work in one practice group for four weeks, giving you a consistent experience and invaluable insight into our work and the clients we support:

  • Summer - 16th November - 11th December 2026
  • Winter - 14th June - 9th July 2027

Our clerkship program is a stepping stone to bigger things—for many, it’s the first step toward building a long‑term career with us. Many clerks go on to become graduates at Allens. Here’s what you can look forward to:

  • a personalised induction program that introduces you to our people and the work we do;
  • on-the-job training with support from a partner, senior lawyer and a junior lawyer, who will act as your performance coach, development lawyer and buddy—providing guidance, feedback and coaching as you learn;
  • learning opportunities across practice areas and partners, as we don't work in silos;
  • the chance to work on real matters with many of Australia's and the world's top 100 companies;
  • opportunities to get involved in community and pro bono work, and learn about our committees and interest groups;
  • exposure to our alliance with Linklaters and insight into international and client secondment opportunities;
  • seminars that build future-focused skills to help you become an excellent lawyer and thrive in an ever‑changing business environment;
  • social events, where you will really get to know us; and
  • the opportunity to network with some of the best in the profession.

At Allens, our culture shaped by unique backgrounds and varied life experiences. We celebrate our people's differences across gender and gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, cultural background, First Nations communities, and family and caring arrangements. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds. If you require adjustments to fully participate in our program, please contact us at Student.Careers@allens.com.au.

If you would like to find out more about our approach to diversity and inclusion please visit our website, visit "This is Allens" or listen to our Allens Confidential podcast to hear real stories from real people about life at Allens.

Applications are open to students who are in their penultimate and final year of their law degree. To be considered, both your application and the required online strengths-based assessment must be completed by 5pm (AEST) on Friday, 7 August 2026. Please address your application to Amelia Webber, Early Careers Consultant.

The Program Coordinator is responsible for pre-planning through the delivery of Executive Education programs, coordinating all logistics, both on-site and virtual delivery, facilitation of remote sessions, and day-to-day operations for the team's assigned portfolio of programs.

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with faculty to confirm session details, coordinate program material, arrange IT and AV needs, and provide classroom support when programs are in session
  • Be the primary contact for faculty and participants for all pre, during, and post program-related support
  • Work closely with other HBS support departments to include operations, media services, housekeeping, catering, and other constituents to ensure appropriate operational support
  • Coordinate and administer program schedules for domestic and international programs
  • Build and maintain participant websites for each program
  • Coordinate experiential learning exercises and team-building activities
  • Maintain records to document faculty material, participant feedback, schedules, vendors, and evaluations associated with program delivery
  • Coordinate program logistics for on-campus programs, to include meals, housing, and special events, both on campus and at local venues
  • Coordinate and host online sessions to include sharing documents and videos, administering polls, coordinating breakout rooms, monitoring attendance, and facilitating communication with faculty, participants, and the technology team, delivered primarily via Zoom or the HBS Online Classroom
  • Use Salesforce to track and manage participant enrollment and cancellations, and other program-related data
  • Coordinate, process, and track program purchases and other expenses
  • Staff the program office when programs are in session
  • Facilitate online Zoom sessions
  • Coordinate online live sessions, working closely with the HBS Live Online Classroom team
  • Collaborate with other Exec Ed teams, including Program Directors, Enrollment and Admission Services, Finance, Client Services, Resource Allocation Associate Director, Coaching Directors, etc.
  • Support the larger program delivery team in “all hands-on deck” activities, including program assignments and coverage across teams
  • Support other projects, department-wide initiatives, and other responsibilities at the discretion of the program manager and program delivery directors
  • Ability to work extended overtime hours (including some evenings and weekends) is a must.
  • This position may also include domestic or international travel depending on program needs.
  • First 90 days of employment fully in person, on-campus (hybrid option following)
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • Responsible for other duties as assigned

Working Conditions:

  • First 90 days of employment fully in person, on-campus (hybrid option following)
  • Ability to work extended overtime hours (including some evenings and weekends) is a must based on program needs.
  • This position may also include domestic or international travel depending on program needs.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • 3+ years of experience in customer service-oriented and/or administrative support role(s) or related experience is required.
  • Education beyond high school may count toward experience.
  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) experience is a must.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • This position requires a team player with a willingness and ability to work with multiple groups within Executive Education and across campus in a fast-paced, customer-oriented, high-energy environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to think quickly, manage multiple priorities and generate solutions when unexpected problems arise.
  • Candidates must show strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service and organizational skills, as well administrative coordination experience.
  • Candidates must be highly motivated, solution driven, take initiative and work well both independently and in a team approach.
  • Must be flexible, energetic, diplomatic and detail oriented
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 40 hours per week, overtime eligible
  • Compensation Range: $66,000 to $69,000 annually commensurate with experience
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity check
  • Other Information:
    • This is a hybrid position which we consider to be a combination of onsite and remote work at our Boston, MA based campus. Please note that for the first 90 days of employment, you will be expected to be onsite 5 days/week. This role is required to be onsite for the entire duration of assigned programs when in-session. When not in session, Executive Education expects Program Delivery staff to be onsite a minimum of 2 days per week and departments to provide onsite coverage Monday – Friday. Specific hours and days onsite will be determined by business needs and are subject to change with appropriate advanced notice.
    • A cover letter is required to be considered for this opportunity.
    • Interviews may be conducted virtually (via Zoom) or in person.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 053. Please visit Harvard's Salary Ranges to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous paid time off including parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
  • Retirement plans with university contributions

Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.

EEO/Non-Discrimination Commitment Statement

Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

title: Program Manager, Communications
description:
Program Manager, Communications

ABM is seeking a forward-thinking, creative, and curious communicator to join our Communications team, supporting ABM's Technology, Transformation, and Procurement functions — with primary focus on the Technology organization. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Executive and Strategic Communications, this role will work closely with technology leaders and project teams to shape and deliver communications that engage, align, and inspire team members.

Embedded within the Technology organization, this role is expected to integrate with teams and work closely with project leaders to “fly alongside” them as they develop and deploy new technologies, offerings, and transformation initiatives. A key function is to maintain clear, timely, and actionable communication across various channels related to changes, downtime, interruptions, and deployments. By being deeply familiar with technology initiatives, this role will anticipate communications needs and proactively support adoption, alignment, and engagement across ABM.

This is a critical role during an enterprise-wide digital transformation designed to elevate technology, streamline processes, and drive digital adoption. As part of ABM's talented and experienced Communications team, you'll collaborate with colleagues to share progress, growth, and new offerings from Technology, Innovation, and Transformation.

This is more than a communications role — it's a chance to bring fresh ideas and creative approaches to communications that accelerate adoption and build excitement. You'll help connect leaders with thousands of team members, highlight innovation in areas like AI, robotics, and data, and showcase how ABM is redefining what's possible in industries not traditionally seen as tech-forward. You'll also be a champion for AI and emerging technology within the Communications team itself — bringing back new tools, workflows, and ideas that help the whole team work smarter.

What You'll Do

Communications Support & Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted communications partner for Technology, Procurement, and Transformation leaders and their project teams.
  • Act as a thought partner to technology and project leaders, contributing new ideas and strategies to elevate communication impact.
  • Develop and execute communications strategies that clarify technology priorities, enable transformation initiatives, and drive adoption of enterprise platforms.
  • Translate complex technical topics — including IT roadmaps, cybersecurity, applications, and process modernization — into clear, actionable messaging for diverse audiences.
  • Build productive relationships across the Technology organization, operations and other functions to strengthen alignment and engagement.
  • Provide issues management, business continuity, and crisis communications support in partnership with IT leadership, including availability for urgent communications needs outside of standard business hours.

Campaigns, Messaging & Content Packaging

  • Lead or support internal campaigns around system implementations, application upgrades, digital adoption, and enterprise change initiatives.
  • Ensure complex topics are simplified and packaged for ease of use across a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Create content such as FAQs, playbooks, intranet articles, leadership messages, Town Hall decks, and email communications.
  • Bring creative storytelling and bold ideas to make technology and transformation communications more engaging and accessible.

Channel & Platform Enablement

  • Optimize and expand communication channels to reach distributed audiences, from technical specialists to frontline team members.
  • Partner with IT to ensure communication platforms support adoption, clarity, and accessibility.
  • Maintain governance and editorial calendars for streamlined effective communications.

Special Projects & Transformation Initiatives

  • Support special projects related to technology and transformation initiatives, working directly with project leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Provide project-based communication support for strategic priorities, pilots, and enterprise-wide rollouts.

Insights & Continuous Improvement

  • Measure communications effectiveness and adoption rates using data and feedback; refine strategies for greater impact.
  • Stay current on best practices in technology change management, enterprise IT communications, digital workplace engagement, and emerging AI tools.
  • Bring new ideas to the Communications team on how to better use technology and AI to improve the team's own work — from content creation to workflow efficiency.

Who You Are

  • A forward-thinking, bold, and creative communicator who thrives in the technology space.
  • A strategic thinker who aligns communication with larger business objectives.
  • A trusted partner who brings new ideas and collaborates closely with technology and transformation leaders to shape narratives.
  • Skilled at simplifying complex IT and technical concepts into clear, engaging stories.
  • A connector who establishes productive relationships across teams, functions, and levels.
  • Collaborative by nature and energized by working with a high-performing Communications team.
  • Curious and agile, able to balance strategy with execution while managing multiple priorities.
  • Genuinely interested in AI and emerging technology, and excited to bring new tools and ideas back to the Communications team.
  • Experienced in packaging change communications and repurposing complex information for broad use cases, including business development.
  • Calm under pressure, able to respond quickly and thoughtfully during issues or disruptions.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in communications, ideally within a large corporate environment. Equivalent experience in related fields will also be considered.
  • A Bachelor's in Communications, Marketing.
  • Experience using a communications platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Constant Contact, Poppulo, etc.) to plan, publish, and manage content.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar, for tasks like drafting, editing, summarizing, or workflow efficiency.
  • Proven success supporting technology leaders and project teams, and driving adoption of enterprise systems and digital tools.
  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, particularly in explaining technology to broad audiences.
  • Familiarity with IT processes, digital workplace tools, applications, and change adoption strategies.
  • Strong ability to package and translate technical and transformation progress into materials for multiple audiences — internal and external.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting issues management, business continuity communications, and crisis response, with flexibility to work off-hours when needed.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SharePoint.
  • Experience with enterprise collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Yammer/Viva Engage, Slack, or similar.
  • Familiarity with intranet content management systems and digital publishing tools.
  • Ability to use measurement and analytics platforms to track engagement and adoption.
  • Enthusiasm for AI-enabled tools for content development, workflow efficiency, and analytics — with an interest in championing new tools across the team.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and align across multiple stakeholders.

Benefit Information:

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit

ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

title: Maintenance Foreman
description:
Purpose of Job Position

The primary purpose of your job position is to, under the supervision of the Executive Director, maintain the interior and exterior of the building, equipment, and grounds, in accordance with current applicable federal, and state and local regulations, established standards, and with company policies and procedures to ensure that such is kept clean, in good repair, and reasonably attractive.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Plans, oversees the implementation of and performs routine maintenance and repair on the facility and equipment including basic plumbing, plastering, electrical, carpentry, mechanical, etc. as necessary and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Monitors and directs the day to day operations of the maintenance department, including but not limited to compliance with preventive maintenance schedules.
  • Performs routine maintenance on grounds, parking areas, driveways, etc. including cutting, mowing, watering, trimming, policing, sweeping, snow removal etc., as necessary and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Cleans indoor and outdoor windows/screens as necessary and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Replaces burned out light bulbs, including exit lights, overhead lights, fluorescent lights, room call lights, outdoor lights, etc. as necessary and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Services heating and cooling units/systems, as specified by the manufacturer, as needed and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Performs janitorial duties to include floor/carpet cleaning, refuse disposal, etc. as needed and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Conducts routine inspection of company vehicles and schedules all general repairs, routine service and preventive maintenance.
  • Conducts and documents monitoring activities for facility fire safety systems and equipment as necessary and as directed by Administrator/Supervisor and/or company maintenance schedule.
  • Participates in the evaluation of maintenance technicians as directed by the Executive Director.
  • Participates in safety and other committees as directed by the Executive Director.
  • Organizes workload to accommodate resident needs and to ensure that all assigned tasks are completed.
  • Performs services in recognition of each resident’s rights.
  • Maintains confidentiality of each resident’s protected health information.
  • Respects each resident’s right to refuse all care.
  • Respects each resident’s right to be treated with dignity and respect at all times.
  • Respects each resident’s right to be free from abuse, neglect or exploitation.
  • Respects each resident’s right to privacy, consideration and respect.
  • Respects each resident’s right to communicate privately with person of his/her choice and to privacy when visiting or talking on the telephone.
  • Respects each resident’s right to be free from discrimination.
  • Immediately reports all complaints, grievances or allegations of resident rights violations observed or made by residents/legal representatives, family members, visitors or other employees to the Administrator/Supervisor/Person in Charge.
  • Conducts orientation and/or training as directed by the Administrator/Program Coordinator.
  • Attends required continuing education programs (in-services) to ensure that knowledge of issues affecting the elderly, and facility policies and procedures is maintained.
  • Follows all established safety and infection control policies and procedures in carrying out duties.
  • Uses appropriate personal protective/safety equipment and procedures.
  • Stores items appropriately (e.g. heavy items on lower shelves) and utilizes proper body mechanics to prevent strains.
  • Uses only that equipment for which she/he has received specific training. When using equipment, follows manufacturer’s recommendations for use.
  • Follows manufacturer recommendations in preparing, using, storing and disposing of chemicals.
  • Reports any occupational exposures to the person in charge and/or the Administrator/Program Coordinator.
  • Immediately reports all accidents/incidents and injuries to the Administrator/Supervisor/Person in Charge and completes required incident reports.
  • Monitors for and immediately reports unsafe/hazardous conditions/equipment in accordance with established facility policies and procedures.
  • Uses company equipment in a manner that promotes cost-savings and ongoing operation of equipment.
  • Uses equipment in accordance with manufacturer’s recommendations and only after training is provided.
  • Cleans and /or stores equipment/supplies properly after each use.
  • Maintains order, safety and security of all storage area(s).
  • Monitors and reports need for replacement of equipment/supplies in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Behaves and communicates in a manner that promotes a positive work atmosphere.
  • Performs all other related duties as assigned by the person in charge or the Administrator/Program Coordinator.

Working Conditions

  • Frequent standing and walking on carpeted and/or concrete floors.
  • May be subject to frequent interruptions, emotionally upset persons, injury from falls, burns, dust, odors, chemicals and exposure to infectious wastes and diseases, including, but not limited to AIDS and Hepatitis –B.
  • Works beyond normal duty hours, on weekends and in other positions when assigned or necessary. Participates in maintenance on-call rotation as designated by Administrator/Supervisor.
  • Is subject to callback during emergency conditions (i.e., severe weather, evacuations, post-disasters, etc.).
