About UNSW:

UNSW isn’t like other places you’ve worked. We’re a large organization with a diverse and talented community; a community doing extraordinary things. Together, we are driven to be thoughtful, practical, and purposeful in all we do. Taking this combined approach is what makes our work matter. It’s the reason we’re one of the top 50 universities in the world and a member of Australia’s prestigious Group of Eight. If you want a career where you can thrive, be challenged and do meaningful work, you’re in the right place.

UNSW IT is part of UNSW’s Operations Division and provides high quality, sustainable, flexible products and state of the art technology services to UNSW. Our priorities are to drive innovative architectures that enable UNSW’s digital future and be a trusted partner of the University. he Test Analyst is an integral role of their respective domain solutions' teams, collaborating with business analysts, functional analysts, technical developers and IT testing practice CoE. The role is responsible for executing multiple types testing that are required, manual and automated, including the preparation of test cases and test reports. The role is expected to stay updated with and apply UNSW IT testing standards and guidelines and to learn and be proficient with the tools UNSW IT choose for testing. The Test Analyst reports to the Head of Testing with a dotted line into the Technology Manager and Project Manager.

Specific accountabilities for this role include:

  • Conduct analysis of project requirements and design test cases for thorough coverage.
  • Perform manual testing within waterfall or agile sprints, covering system integration, functional and user interface.
  • Ensure product releases consistently exceed predefined quality standards, emphasizing commitment to excellence.
  • Thoroughly document test cases, results, and defects while maintaining a focus on analysing testing efforts for completeness.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including retrospectives, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Foster close collaboration with Business teams, developers and SMEs to ensure alignment with customer and business requirements, promoting a cohesive approach to project success.
  • Contribute and be an advocate to the wider development and engineering community through participation in development guilds for knowledge sharing and learning.
  • Establish, maintain and execute a common set of test cases that can be used repeatedly for both BAU testing and project testing, including the test case writing using UNSW IT testing framework, process and tools, such as TestRay or Zephyr.
  • Analyse and report test activities and results with the aim to identify and implement continuous improvements to testing and QA process, methods, tools and standards.
  • Take responsibility for escalating test issues and ensuring they are driven through to resolution.
  • Provide advice and guidance to the business to promote operational effectiveness and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Align with and actively demonstrate the Code of Conduct and Values
  • Cooperate with all health and safety policies and procedures of the university and take all reasonable care to ensure that your actions or omissions do not impact on the psychosocial or physical health and safety of yourself or others.

Skills and Experience

  • Tertiary qualifications in IT or related discipline.
  • Understanding of various testing phases, such as System Testing, System Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing, Performance testing etc
  • Strong presentation skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to structure and articulate messages to different audiences at all levels.
  • Ability to advocate the value of software testing processes and methods to stakeholders including Project Managers, Business Analysts and Developers.
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly absorb information and utilise it to analyse, interpret and integrate complex information.
  • Good organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to respond to changing priorities, work independently with effectiveness, manage multiple tasks and meet competing deadlines by using judgement and initiative and resolve complex problems as they arise.
  • An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
  • Knowledge of health & safety (psychosocial and physical) responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Get to Know the Team

Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a team of engineers, designers, product managers, and operations. We innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems: ensuring accurate settlement to large numbers of merchants. Get to Know the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you'll design, build, and operate backend services that power critical business applications at scale. You'll work collaboratively with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features while driving operational excellence and mentoring fellow engineers. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by architecting innovative solutions in a supportive environment.

You will report to the Engineering Manager II based in Singapore and work onsite and CMC Creative Space office, HCMC.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Design and implement scalable, reliable backend services using modern programming languages and frameworks, with a focus on performance, cost-efficiency, and maintainability
  • Own delivery of features and projects, including requirements clarification, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Lead and participate in technical discussions and design reviews, making thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, latency, throughput, and cost
  • Instrumenting services with comprehensive metrics, logs, and traces; define SLIs/SLOs; improve alerting strategies; and perform capacity planning and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with other teams to design end-to-end workflows that are secure, scalable, and user-centric
  • Contribute to engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, documentation standards, and design practices within the team
  • Mentor other engineers through constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and best practice guidance in design, coding, and operational excellence
  • Participate in on-call rotations and handle production incidents
  • Support hiring initiatives by conducting technical interviews and helping refine interview processes and guidelines

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an advanced degree. Good Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in backend software development.
  • Proficiency in Golang, with an understanding of its syntax, semantics, standard libraries, concurrency features, and experience optimizing applications.
  • Experience with RDBMS technologies like MySQL and PostgreSQL, including expertise in database performance, query tuning, and reliability.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, with knowledge in designing scalable, internet-scale microservices.
  • Fluent in English both verbally and written.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, along with experience automating infrastructure.
  • Skills in development practices such as TDD, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery, using tools like GIT, Jenkins, and unit testing frameworks.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity across coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and code review.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve production engineering workflows, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and system design.

Life at Grab

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

title: WAREHOUSE OPERATOR
description:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu, Sidoarjo)

Job Summary:

As a Warehouse Operator at PT Japfa Food Indonesia, you will be responsible for the efficient and accurate handling of goods within our warehouse facilities, ensuring smooth operations and supporting our production and distribution processes.

Job Responsibilities:

* Receive, unload, and inspect incoming goods, verifying quantities and quality against purchase orders and delivery notes.
* Accurately store goods in designated warehouse locations, utilizing appropriate equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and hand trucks.
* Pick, pack, and prepare outgoing orders for shipment, ensuring correct item selection, quantity, and packaging integrity.
* Operate and maintain warehouse equipment safely and efficiently, performing daily checks and reporting any malfunctions.
* Maintain accurate inventory records through manual and/or automated systems, conducting regular stock counts and resolving discrepancies.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies, including those related to food safety and hygiene.
* Keep the warehouse clean, organized, and free of hazards.
* Assist with other warehouse duties as required, including loading and unloading trucks, and general facility maintenance.

Job Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience working in a warehouse or logistics environment, preferably within the food industry.
* Ability to operate forklifts and other warehouse equipment (certification is a plus).
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling goods and maintaining records.
* Good physical stamina and ability to lift heavy objects and stand for extended periods.
* Basic computer literacy for inventory management systems.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of safety procedures and willingness to follow company regulations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.





Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Sebagai Operator Gudang (Warehouse Operator) di PT Japfa Food Indonesia, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas penanganan barang di fasilitas gudang secara efisien dan akurat. Posisi ini berperan penting dalam memastikan kelancaran operasional gudang serta mendukung proses produksi dan distribusi perusahaan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

  • Menerima, membongkar, dan memeriksa barang yang masuk, serta memastikan jumlah dan kualitas barang sesuai dengan pesanan pembelian (purchase order) dan surat jalan.
  • Menyimpan barang secara tepat pada lokasi gudang yang telah ditentukan dengan menggunakan peralatan yang sesuai, seperti forklift, hand pallet, dan troli.
  • Mengambil, mengemas, dan menyiapkan pesanan untuk pengiriman, dengan memastikan jenis barang, jumlah, dan kondisi kemasan sesuai standar.
  • Mengoperasikan dan merawat peralatan gudang dengan aman dan efisien, melakukan pemeriksaan harian, serta melaporkan setiap kerusakan atau gangguan yang ditemukan.
  • Memelihara catatan persediaan yang akurat melalui sistem manual maupun otomatis, melakukan penghitungan stok secara berkala, serta menindaklanjuti setiap selisih data persediaan.
  • Mematuhi seluruh peraturan keselamatan kerja dan kebijakan perusahaan, termasuk yang berkaitan dengan keamanan pangan dan kebersihan.
  • Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan, dan keamanan area gudang dari potensi bahaya.
  • Membantu tugas-tugas gudang lainnya sesuai kebutuhan, termasuk memuat dan membongkar barang dari kendaraan serta melakukan pemeliharaan fasilitas secara umum.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

  • Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang pergudangan atau logistik, lebih disukai di industri makanan.
  • Mampu mengoperasikan forklift dan peralatan gudang lainnya (memiliki sertifikat operator menjadi nilai tambah).
  • Memiliki ketelitian dan ketepatan yang tinggi dalam menangani barang serta mengelola pencatatan.
  • Memiliki kondisi fisik yang baik, mampu mengangkat beban berat, dan sanggup berdiri dalam waktu yang lama.
  • Memiliki kemampuan dasar dalam pengoperasian komputer, khususnya untuk penggunaan sistem manajemen persediaan.
  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim di lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan cepat.
  • Memahami prosedur keselamatan kerja serta bersedia mematuhi seluruh peraturan perusahaan.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang baik.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Growth, your way

  • Structured mentoring and leadership programs
  • Ongoing opportunities to build your experience, including Fly In Fly Out (FIFO) work supporting children in remote areas
  • National and global career pathways through the APM Group

Who we are:

Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

title: Staff AMS Verification Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Staff AMS Verification Engineer to lead and execute verification of complex Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) PMIC (Power Management IC) designs. The role involves developing verification strategies, testbenches, methodologies, and automation for block-level and top-level PMIC verification.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in analog/mixed-signal verification, SystemVerilog/UVM, real-number modeling (RNM), SPICE simulations, and power-management circuits, with the ability to work closely with analog design, digital design, modeling, and product engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own the AMS verification strategy for PMIC blocks and full-chip/top-level designs.

Define verification plans, coverage goals, test scenarios, and verification methodologies.

Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification environments for mixed-signal designs.

Develop and use Real Number Models (RNM), behavioral models, and mixed-signal abstractions for efficient verification.

Perform AMS/DMS simulations for functional and corner-case verification.

Verify PMIC functionality including:

LDOs and voltage regulators, Buck/boost converters, Bandgap references,Oscillators, Charge pumps, Power-on-reset (POR), Brownout detection, Voltage/current monitoring, ADC/DAC interfaces, Power sequencing and state machines ,Protection features(OVP, UVP, OCP, OTP, and short-circuit protection)

Develop verification models for analog blocks and their interaction with digital control logic.

Debug failures across analog, digital, RTL, behavioral models, and testbench environments.

Collaborate closely with analog designers and digital designers, review design specifications and identify verification gaps, corner cases, and potential risks.

Mentor junior and senior verification engineers and provide technical leadership.

Drive improvements in verification methodology, simulation efficiency, automation, and coverage closure.

Contribute to project schedules, technical reviews, sign-off criteria, and verification documentation.

  • Required Qualifications

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.

    Typically 8+ years of experience in semiconductor verification, with significant experience in AMS verification.

    Strong understanding of analog and mixed-signal circuit fundamentals.

    Hands-on experience with PMIC architecture and power-management circuits.

    Strong programming/scripting skills in one or more of:

    SystemVerilog

    Python

    Perl

    Tcl

    C/C++

    Strong experience with SystemVerilog/UVM and constrained-random verification.

    Experience with AMS simulation and SPICE-based verification.

    Experience with Real Number Modeling (RNM) and/or behavioral modeling.

    Experience with industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA simulation and verification environments.

    Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

    Experience defining verification plans and driving coverage closure and sign-off.

    Preferred Qualifications

    Experience verifying automotive, consumer, mobile, industrial, or server PMICs.

    Knowledge of power-management architectures, including switching regulators and linear regulators.

    Experience with AMS assertions, SVA, and functional safety concepts.

    Knowledge of formal verification or hybrid analog/digital verification methodologies.

    Experience developing reusable AMS verification IP and verification frameworks.

    Experience with silicon bring-up, characterization, or correlation between simulation and silicon measurements.

    Leadership Expectations – Staff Level

    Act as a technical owner for AMS verification methodology and execution.

    Influence architecture and design decisions by identifying verification risks early.

    Establish reusable verification frameworks and best practices across projects.

    Lead complex debug involving interactions between analog and digital domains.

    Mentor engineers and raise the overall technical capability of the verification team.

    Drive technical decisions across cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with senior engineering leadership.

    Proactively identify opportunities to improve verification quality, simulation performance, and project execution.

    Key Skills

    AMS Verification | PMIC | Analog/Mixed-Signal | SystemVerilog | UVM | RNM | SPICE | Verilog-AMS | Python | Assertions | Functional Coverage | Monte Carlo | PVT | Power Management | AMS Simulation | Mixed-Signal Debug | Verification Automation

description:
Jula i Avesta söker varuhusmedarbetare

Älskar du att möta människor och leverera goda kundmöten. I så fall har du nu möjligheten att bli medarbetare i vårt team och delaktig i vår ostoppbara resa. Jula i Avesta söker nu två medarbetare till vikariat på 12,5%.

En typisk dag innebär många skratt tillsammans med dina kollegor och kunder. Din fingertoppskänsla för kundservice kommer att locka fram leenden på kundernas läppar då du med din expertis hjälper dem i butiken. Det är du tillsammans med dina kollegor som sköter allt från att bemanna kassan till att fylla på hyllorna. Du hjälper kunderna med returer eller att hitta rätt vara.

Eftersom vi är på en resa kan du räkna med att vi även vill att din personliga resa ska påbörjas. Oavsett om du jobbar extra eller om du väljer att arbeta hos oss till pension vill vi att du ska utvecklas. Bli inte förvånad om du får möjligheten att bygga upp exponeringar av kampanj- och säsongsprodukter, ta ansvar och lära nytt. Vi vet att kundernas behov ändras snabbt – och nu har du alla möjligheter att bli en del av vårt fantastiska team och hjälpa oss att anpassa oss ännu snabbare.

Vad finns i ditt CV?

Du har erfarenhet av detaljhandeln tidigare. Du skriver och talar bra svenska (engelska är ett plus) och har god datorvana, särskilt i Microsoft Office.

Om du har ett truckkort är det ett plus men inte ett krav.

Vem är du?

Framför allt är du en nyfiken person som trivs med att arbeta i team. Du lockas av att vara en del av ett entreprenöriellt och internationellt företag. Vi är prisfighters som älskar att göra bra affärer och att få våra kunder att känna att de får bra värde för pengarna när de handlar hos oss. Det triggar dig också.

Du älskar att sälja, är serviceinriktad och trivs när du kan hjälpa kunden att hitta precis det de behöver. Du är nyfiken och vill lära dig. Att växa och få utmaningar är som ljuv musik för dig. Du är en fena på att prioritera, vilket gör att du kan hantera hektiska perioder. Du tar dig tid att lyssna på kunden för att alltid kunna leverera ett gott kundbemötande med ett leende på läpparna. Du är engagerad, positiv och älskar att Jula är ett större team- vilket gör det möjligt för dig att alltid vara dig själv.

Bra att veta

Vi söker två medarbetare som kan arbeta 12,5%. Tjänsterna är vikariat med start omgående fram till årsskiftet med möjlighet till förlängning. Som varuhusmedarbetare arbetar du morgon, kvällar och helger. Om du känner att du skulle passa för denna roll så tveka inte att söka direkt! Vi håller intervjuer löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Sista ansökningsdag är den 13 september.

Frågor?

Frågor om tjänsten besvaras av Varuhuschef Malin Arvidsson via mailto:malin.arvidsson@jula.se.

title: Senior Data Architect Oracle Health Federal
description:

title: Senior Software Engineer – Networking (C/C++, DPDK/VPP)
description:
We're looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer – Networking (C/C++, DPDK/VPP) with strong expertise in developing networking software across the data path, control plane, and related infrastructure. You'll design and build forwarding, protocol, and packet-processing components that run in virtualized and containerized environments, integrating hardware and software-based data paths into production systems.

This is a highly technical individual contributor role focused on building high-performance networking solutions. You'll work across networking, security, data-path technologies, and cloud-native infrastructure while collaborating with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Design and develop networking software across the data path, control plane, forwarding, and protocol layers.
  • Build packet processing pipelines and integrate them with hardware-based data paths such as Network ASICs and software-based data paths such as VPP and DPDK.
  • Develop and enhance SD-WAN data-path features, including IPsec, firewall, WAN selection, secure web gateway, zone-based firewall, and stateful firewall capabilities.
  • Work on DPI, VPN, QoS, and other data-path technologies, with a strong focus on performance and optimized packet processing.
  • Develop and integrate networking components in cloud-native environments using Kubernetes, Docker, distributed systems, message buses, and gRPC.
  • Integrate and enhance open-source and third-party networking and infrastructure components while independently troubleshooting and improving production systems.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience developing networking software, particularly data-path, forwarding, or packet-processing components.
  • Strong understanding of data center networking and networking stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with C/C++, with the ability to write optimized, performance-sensitive code.
  • Experience with DPDK, VPP, or similar data-path technologies.
  • Experience with networking and security technologies such as IPsec, VPN, DPI, QoS, firewalls, and SD-WAN.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix system programming, Kubernetes, and Docker.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, message buses, and gRPC.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Golang and microservices architecture.
  • Experience with programmable packet-processing pipelines and CNF/VNF technologies.
  • Experience working with Broadcom or other Network ASICs.
  • Experience with CNCF technologies and cloud-native networking.
  • Experience integrating networking solutions with security providers such as Zscaler or Palo Alto Cloud NGFW.

title: Email + SMS Project Manager
description:
About the role

As an Email + SMS Project Manager at Homestead, you are the operational backbone of our lifecycle marketing team, but your role goes far beyond simple task management. You are an autonomous, agile, and highly proactive leader who drives exceptional results through flexible strategies and precise execution. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of multiple client projects (email campaigns, automated flows, and SMS programs), taking true ownership of project outcomes.


You'll sit at the intersection of strategy, copy, design, and direct client communication. As a primary client-facing representative, your job is to understand client goals, communicate priorities, and ensure alignment. You will be the glue that keeps everything together—making sure deliverables ship on time, approvals don't stall, resources are aligned, and clients are consistently engaged at every stage.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Project Ownership: Own the production timeline for monthly email/SMS campaigns across a portfolio of DTC clients. Take full ownership of project outcomes, shifting focus from strict task management to overall strategic project management to ensure nothing ships late or half-baked.
  • Direct Client Communication: Act as a primary, proactive liaison. Confidently lead direct communications with clients to gather assets, drive approvals, provide regular updates on priorities/wins, and take actionable meeting notes—without relying solely on Account Managers or Strategists.
  • Proactive Account Health Monitoring: Monitor project momentum to identify early warning signs of client churn (e.g., stagnant activity or sudden nitpicking). Flag risks and blockers early and collaborate with the team to course-correct immediately.
  • Agile Execution & Flexibility: Adopt an agile mindset to maintain flexibility, focusing on continuous customer collaboration, rapid iterations, and responding to change over rigidly following initial plans.
  • Streamlined Internal Collaboration: Facilitate efficient, targeted communication with strategists, copywriters, and designers. Ensure the delivery team is involved in planning stages to secure creative buy-in, reduce silos, and keep tasks moving through each stage of production.
  • Workflow Management & AI Utilization: Utilize Asana to orchestrate project progress, keeping boards clean and stakeholders informed. Use AI tools (like Claude) to streamline your workflow—drafting follow-ups, organizing meeting notes, building status updates, and optimizing recurring processes.
  • Autonomous Problem Solving: Identify potential roadblocks in project execution, make autonomous decisions on shifting priorities when necessary, and come to the table with proposed paths forward.
  • Quality & Alignment Assurance: Verify that all deliverables not only meet Homestead's quality standards but directly align with the client's current expectations and goals before final delivery.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in project management in an agency or client-facing environment, with a strong track record of direct client communication.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of decisions, and manage multiple concurrent projects with overlapping deadlines without dropping balls.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to lead client calls, anchor expectations, and follow up firmly without burning relationships (your Slack messages are clear, not novels).
  • An adaptable, agile mindset with the ability to pivot when necessary and prioritize client value over strict adherence to initial plans.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a highly proactive approach to addressing challenges before they escalate.
  • Proficiency in project management tools (Asana strongly preferred) and comfort navigating Slack, Google Workspace, and Figma at a basic level.
  • Excellent organizational instincts and high attention to detail—you build systems and checklists, and you catch the missing link in a message or a task marked "done" that wasn't.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing email and/or SMS campaign production specifically.
  • Familiarity with Agile project management principles and how to apply them in a digital marketing/agency setting.
  • Familiarity with the DTC/eCommerce ecosystem and how lifecycle marketing fits into the growth picture.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to support project management workflows.
  • Experience working with or alongside email strategists, copywriters, and designers in a collaborative production environment.
  • Knowledge of tools like Asana or Google Workspace.

Additional Information

This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be able to work standard business hours (9:00am–5:00pm) in ET, CT, MT, or PT time zones.

Bounteous is seeking a CDP Engineer specializing in Adobe Real-Time CDP (RTCDP) and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) to support data ingestion, identity resolution, and profile creation for a large-scale consumer telecommunications client. This hands-on technical role focuses on configuring data flows, mapping datasets to XDM schemas, ensuring high-quality Profile-enabled datasets, and supporting segmentation and activation accuracy across channels.

The CDP Engineer will work closely with the CDP Architect, data engineering teams, consultants, and marketing activation teams to ensure that AEP and the RTCDP instance is properly configured, performant, and governed.   • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Configure and manage AEP sandboxes for development, testing, and production environments.

  • Integrate RTCDP with downstream systems for activation across marketing, analytics, and personalization platforms.

  • Assist marketing activation teams in ensuring proper data availability for audiences and personalization.

  • Support CDP Architect in designing scalable, governed data models and ingestion frameworks.

  • Contribute to continuous improvements in CDP automation, process efficiency, and operational best practices.

title: Engineering Manager II, Data Platform
description:
Get to Know the Team

The Streaming Data team (a.k.a. Coban) ensures seamless and secure real-time access to continuous events or streams, serving as Grab's unified access pattern for real-time data. We build the infrastructure and platform for writing and consuming real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, managed NoOps service for product and data teams across Grab. We partner closely with sister teams in DataTech to provide integrated data platforms that unlock big data innovation every day.

Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:

  • Building a self-serve streaming platform for Kafka topics, Flink, CDC pipelines, Kafka Connect, and notebooks (An elegant platform).
  • Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns (Safer deployment of streaming applications).
  • Enabling FlinkSQL exploration and productionisation so users can move faster from streaming ideas to running pipelines (The complete stream processing journey on FlinkSQL).
  • Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing (Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing).
  • Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts (Real-time data quality monitoring).

These are examples of the platform thinking this role will continue to advance: taking complex real-time infrastructure problems and turning them into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.

Grab needs a manager to scale real-time data platforms

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

The team turns streaming complexity into self-service platforms

The Streaming Data team, also known as Coban, owns Grab's real-time data platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that helps Grab teams write, process, govern, and consume continuous event streams safely at scale. Our platform brings together Kafka, Apache Flink, change data capture, Kafka Connect, notebooks, deployment guardrails, observability, and data quality capabilities so product and data teams can ship real-time pipelines with confidence.

The team partners closely with Kafka, data lake, metrics, governance, experimentation, and business-facing data teams across Data Engineering Platforms. We care deeply about platform leverage: making complex distributed systems reliable, efficient, secure, and easy enough for many internal users to adopt without creating operational toil.

The role owns people, platform direction, and production outcomes

As Engineering Manager II, Flink Platform, you will build, grow, and lead a Vietnam-based engineering team responsible for the evolution and operation of Grab's stream processing platform. You will guide the team roadmap, coach engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with stakeholders across Grab to make Apache Flink a safer and more productive compute layer for real-time data.

You will work onsite at Grab Vietnam office in HCMC and report into Data Engineering Platforms leadership. This is a hands-on engineering management role. You are expected to stay close to technical design, reliability trade-offs, incident learning, and platform execution while scaling impact through your team.

This platform unlocks the real-time signals Grab needs next

  • Apache Flink is a critical compute layer for real-time signals, automation, data products, and decision-making across Grab.
  • A stronger Flink platform helps internal teams move from streaming ideas to production pipelines faster, with better guardrails and less operational risk.
  • A small platform team must support many production workloads, so the manager will multiply impact through self-service workflows, reusable abstractions, and clear ownership models.
  • As Grab accelerates AI-assisted and agentic engineering, high-quality real-time data becomes an even more important foundation for reliable automation.

You will lead delivery, reliability, and team growth

  • Lead a team of Flink platform engineers in Vietnam, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Own quarterly planning, team objectives, prioritization, and delivery of the Flink platform roadmap in partnership with Data Engineering Platforms leaders and internal users.
  • Set high engineering standards across system design, code quality, testing, documentation, operational readiness, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide technical design for self-service Flink capabilities, deployment safety, production guardrails, observability, platform automation, and reusable libraries or modules.
  • Drive operational excellence through on-call readiness, incident response, post-incident learning, service level objectives, capacity planning, and continuous reliability improvement.
  • Partner with Kafka, data lake, metrics, governance, SRE, security, and product engineering teams to make real-time pipelines reliable across Grab's broader data ecosystem.
  • Represent the team with clear communication to technical and non-technical stakeholders, turning ambiguous platform needs into practical execution plans.

Strong candidates combine platform depth with management craft

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineers or leading engineering teams.
  • Experience building, operating, or managing distributed systems, data platforms, stream processing platforms, or other high-scale backend infrastructure in production.

title: Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead based in United States.

This is a senior pharmacovigilance leadership role responsible for shaping and executing global safety operations across late-stage clinical development and commercialization activities.
You’ll own the operational safety model, ensuring it remains lean, agile, compliant, and capable of supporting complex global programs.
The role combines strategic oversight with hands-on execution, including vendor management, safety documentation, signal management, and regulatory readiness.
You’ll work closely with medical safety, regulatory, quality, biostatistics, medical writing, and external partners to maintain high standards of patient safety and compliance.
The position offers significant influence over safety processes, governance, systems, and operational strategy within a fast-moving biotechnology environment.
You’ll collaborate across North America, Europe, and Israel, working with distributed teams and external vendors in a highly flexible setting.
This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to global drug development while helping build scalable safety capabilities for future commercialization.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide strategic direction for global safety and pharmacovigilance operations, ensuring an effective, compliant, and cost-efficient operating model.
  • Develop, maintain, and oversee safety operational documents and agreements with external partners, including Joint Operating Guides, Safety Management Plans, and Safety Data Exchange Agreements.
  • Coordinate the development of core safety documents, including DSURs, Reference Safety Information within Investigator’s Brochures, CCSI, and RMP/REMS materials, in collaboration with Regulatory Affairs.
  • Coordinate high-quality safety outputs with Biostatistics, Quality Assurance, medical writing, and external vendors.
  • Support ongoing safety surveillance, including signal management, risk assessment, and periodic safety reporting.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for safety vendors and CROs, managing work orders, budgets, deliverables, administrative requirements, and overall performance.
  • Monitor vendor safety KPIs, ensure adherence to Safety Management Plans, and oversee implementation of required risk mitigation measures.
  • Establish and maintain safety procedures, governance models, and SOPs appropriate to the stage of product development and future commercialization.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure appropriate safety training is implemented, completed, and documented.
  • Work closely with global medical safety leadership and represent safety operations in governance and decision-making forums.
  • Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, PV Quality Assurance, medical writing, and other internal functions to align safety expectations and maintain regulatory compliance.
  • Represent safety operations in interactions with development and commercialization partners.
  • Participate in clinical trial teams and expanded-access or compassionate-use programs as required.

    • Requirements:

    • Advanced degree such as a PhD, PharmD, MSc, or equivalent in a life-science or medical discipline.
    • At least 5 years of experience in a comparable pharmacovigilance or safety operations leadership role, with experience across both small biotechnology and larger pharmaceutical organizations.
    • Demonstrated experience supporting late-stage clinical development, initial commercialization, and compassionate-use or expanded-access programs.
    • In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and safety requirements, including GVP and 21 CFR Part 11.
    • Strong understanding of pre- and post-marketing safety requirements and global regulatory expectations.
    • Experience creating and maintaining CCSI and initial RMP/REMS documentation.
    • Experience interacting with regulatory authorities such as the FDA, Health Canada, and EMA/PRAC regarding risk management and risk minimization activities.
    • Practical experience with safety systems and tools, including Argus, Veeva, and MedDRA.
    • Proven ability to manage CROs, vendors, and other external partners while maintaining quality, timelines, budgets, and compliance.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, clinical, regulatory, and operational audiences.
    • Hands-on, solution-oriented approach with the willingness to take ownership and drive critical documentation and processes to completion.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a distributed, cross-functional organization.
    • Willingness to travel occasionally for face-to-face meetings and collaborate across North American, European, and Israeli time zones.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time, remote position with a flexible working environment.
      • Opportunity to work across international teams spanning Europe, North America, and Israel.
      • Flexible schedule designed to support collaboration across multiple time zones.
      • Opportunity to contribute to late-stage clinical development and future commercialization programs.
      • Significant ownership and strategic influence over global safety and pharmacovigilance operations.
      • Occasional travel for in-person meetings and team collaboration.
      • Inclusive and collaborative environment focused on meaningful patient impact.
      • Equal opportunity workplace committed to diversity, inclusion, and a welcoming culture.

title: Lead, AI Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior AI Data Scientist to design, build, and operationalize agentic AI systems for our customers marketing analytics practice. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building production-grade LLM agents, tools, and pipelines — not a research or architecture-strategy role. You'll work as a data scientist to turn LLM/agentic capabilities into deployed, monitored, and reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build agentic AI systems — multi-step, tool-using agents that automate marketing analytics workflows (segmentation narratives, campaign insight generation, reporting, data QA).
  • Develop and deploy Claude Skills, custom tools, and function-calling workflows to extend agent capabilities within defined guardrails.
  • Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines — chunking, embedding, vector store design, retrieval tuning, and grounding strategies for internal marketing/media data.
  • Implement LLM-as-judge and other automated evaluation frameworks to score agent/model outputs for accuracy, hallucination, and consistency at scale.
  • Own LLMOps/AIOps practices: prompt versioning, model/version rollout strategy, cost and latency monitoring, output drift detection, and automated regression testing for LLM pipelines.
  • Apply MLOps discipline to AI systems — CI/CD for ML/LLM pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), and reproducible deployment across cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) into production pipelines, including structured output handling, function/tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Build evaluation harnesses and guardrails for agentic systems — output validation, safety checks, fallback logic, and human-in-the-loop review points.
  • Write clean, production-quality Python and SQL to support data extraction, pipeline development, and agent tooling.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to embed agentic/LLM components into existing marketing mix, segmentation, and targeting workflows.
  • Document architecture, prompt design decisions, and evaluation methodology for reproducibility and team knowledge-sharing.
  • Stay current with the fast-moving agentic AI ecosystem and proactively bring in relevant tools, frameworks, and techniques.
  • Atleast 4 years of overall AI/ML experience out if which at least 2 years of Generative AI solutions.
  • Strong background in applied ML, data science, LLM and Agentic AI Engineering Systems with demonstrated delivery and client facing experience.
  • Deep expertise in evaluation design, metrics, and dataset curation for LLM systems.
  • Proven experience in model selection and prompt engineering, including structured output and tool-use prompting.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and major ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
  • Strong experience in LLM fine-tuning, RAG Context Engineering, Claude Code, Open AI Codex, Agentic Workflows.
  • Strong RAG design choices (chunking, embeddings, retrieval strategies, reranking) and how to evaluate them.
  • Must have implemented Agentic AI SDLC
  • Working with GenAI on Azure, AWS, or Snowflake involves leveraging cloud-native AI tools—such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Snowflake Cortex—to build or consume intelligent solutions directly on governed data.
  • Experience on vibe coding - such as AntiGravity, Cursor, and VS Code is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to build end-to-end GenAI MVPs in Python (RAG/agents + evaluation harness) and prepare them for production handoff.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with a strategic mindset.

Thrive & Grow with Us

  • Competitive Salary: Your skills and contributions are highly valued here, and we make sure your salary reflects that, rewarding you fairly for the knowledge and experience you bring to the table.
  • Dynamic Career Growth: Our vibrant environment offers you the opportunity to grow rapidly, providing the right tools, mentorship, and experiences to fast-track your career.
  • Idea Tanks: Innovation lives here. Our "Idea Tanks" are your playground to pitch, experiment, and collaborate on ideas that can shape the future.
  • Growth Chats: Dive into our casual "Growth Chats" where you can learn from the best—whether it's over lunch or during a laid-back session with peers, it's the perfect space to grow your skills.
  • Snack Zone: Stay fuelled and inspired! In our Snack Zone, you'll find a variety of snacks to keep your energy high and ideas flowing.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We believe great work deserves to be recognized. Expect regular Hive-Fives, shoutouts, and the chance to see your ideas come to life as part of our reward program.
  • Fuel Your Growth Journey with Certifications: We're all about your growth! Enhance your expertise with company-sponsored certifications in AI, Data Science, Cloud, and Analytics technologies.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
The Quality Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the dimensional accuracy, performance, and reliability of aerospace-grade ball screws and associated precision-machined components. This role requires strong hands-on inspection capability, including the ability to perform in-machine measurements while parts remain fixtured in CNC machining centers. The engineer will develop and execute inspection plans, validate machining processes, analyze nonconformances, and collaborate closely with manufacturing, engineering, and suppliers to maintain compliance with aerospace quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep metrology expertise with practical shop-floor experience and a strong understanding of precision mechanical components used in flight-critical actuation systems.


Major Responsibilities:

  • Perform precision dimensional inspections of ball screws, nuts, and related components using CMMs, optical systems, micrometers, profilometers, thread measurement tools and similar equipment.
  • Conduct in-machine inspection and measurement of parts while fixtured in CNC machining centers to validate tool offsets, critical features, and machining accuracy.
  • Develop and maintain inspection plans, control plans, and first article inspection (FAI) documentation.
  • Verify lead accuracy, pitch variation, straightness, runout, surface finish, and other ball screw specific characteristics.
  • Collaborate with machinists and manufacturing engineers to ensure machining processes meet tolerances.
  • Validate and monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk) for critical features.
  • Support root cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions (RCCA/8D) for nonconforming parts.
  • Review and approve work instructions, inspection methods, and process changes.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO9001/AS9100, customer specifications, and internal quality standards.
  • Prepare and maintain FAI packages, inspection reports, deviation requests, and quality records.
  • Participate in internal and external audits, supplier assessments, and customer reviews.
  • Work closely with design engineering to interpret GD&T, drawings, and tolerance stack-ups.
  • Partner with manufacturing to optimize fixturing, machining strategies, and inspection workflows.
  • Support supplier quality activities, including incoming inspection and supplier corrective actions.

title: Tuotannonsuunnittelu-insinööri - Hybridityö
description:
Asiakasyrityksemme on metalliteollisuuden sopimusvalmistaja, jonka toiminnan ytimessä yhdistyvät perinteinen konepajateollisuus ja nykyaikaiset tuotantoteknologiat. Tuotantovaihtoehtoja räätälöidään asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan, mikä mahdollistaa monipuolisten ja joustavien palvelukokonaisuuksien tarjoamisen.

Yritys toimii neljällä paikkakunnalla ympäri Suomen ja tekee yhteistyötä sekä kotimaisten että kansainvälisten yritysten kanssa. Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus päästä osaksi kasvavaa ja kansainvälistä toimintaympäristöä.

Etsimme heille nyt henkilöä nimikkeellä

Tuotannonsuunnittelu-insinööri

Tehtävänkuva

Tehtävässä vastaat tuotannonsuunnittelusta ja koordinoinnista neljän toimipisteen välillä: Virrat, Seinäjoki, Akaa ja Pirkkala.

Toimit työnjohdon tukena ja tuotannon koordinaattorina. Tärkein tavoitteesi on varmistaa, että tilaukset, työjonot ja tuotannon aikataulut pysyvät ajan tasalla ja että tuotanto etenee suunnitellusti.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • tuotannon suunnittelu, ylläpito ja järjestely

  • tilausten käsittelyn ja tuotannon tilanteen koordinointi

  • ERP-järjestelmän hyödyntäminen tuotannonsuunnittelussa ja tilausten hallinnassa

  • aikataulujen ylläpito ja seuranta

  • tuotannon uudelleenjärjestely tarvittaessa

  • organisaation sisäinen raportointi

  • työnjohdon päivittäinen tukeminen erilaisissa järjestely- ja suunnittelutehtävissä.

Millaista henkilöä etsimme?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on jo jonkin verran työelämän kokemusta tuotanto- ja konepajaympäristöstä. Aikaisempi suora kokemus tuotannonsuunnittelusta ei ole välttämätöntä – voit olla kartuttanut alalta esimerkiksi työnjohdollista kokemusta.

Tehtävässä menestymistä tukevat muun muassa:

  • kokemus ERP-järjestelmistä

  • tarkka ja järjestelmällinen työote

  • kokemus konepajaympäristöstä

  • koneistuksen tuntemus tai käytännön kokemus koneistuksen parissa

  • tekninen koulutus, esimerkiksi konetekniikan insinöörin tutkinto.

Olet luonteeltasi sosiaalinen ja yhteistyökykyinen. Toimit järjestelmällisesti ja pystyt hahmottamaan samanaikaisesti useita kokonaisuuksia.

Mitä sinulle tarjotaan?

  • palkkaus 3 200–3 700 €/kk kokemuksesta ja osaamisesta riippuen

  • uusi ja merkittävä rooli konepajayrityksen työnjohdon tukena

  • kattava perehdytys

  • monipuolinen työnkuva

  • liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, sopimusruokailumahdollisuus

Tehtävässä on mahdollista työskennellä hybridimallilla. Toivomme kuitenkin, että olet valmis työskentelemään toisinaan paikan päällä eri toimipisteillä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tehtävänkuva herätti mielenkiintosi tai tunnet sopivan henkilön, lue lisää HR Sataman urasivuilta (rekry.hrsatama.fi/jobs) ja lähetä hakemuksesi! Käymme saapuneita hakemuksia läpi jo työpaikkailmoituksen aukioloaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä, joten älä jää aikailemaan! Mahdolliset lisäkysymykset ja tiedustelut voit välittää Suorahakutiimille sähköpostitse (suorahakutiimi@hrsatama.fi) tai hakua hoitavalle tiimin jäsenelle, jonka tiedot näet ilmoituksen lopusta urasivuiltamme.

Muuta

  • Kesto: Toistaiseksi voimassaoleva

  • Sijainti: Seinäjoki, Pirkanmaan alueella. Hybridi

Meille voit rekisteröityä vaikka Facebook tai LinkedIn tunnuksilla - teemme asioista yksinkertaista ja helppoa! -

Voit jättää hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta, niin pääsemme käsittelemään sen tietoturvallisesti. Huomaathan, että emme vastaanota tai käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

title: Salesforce Technician
description:
General Role Responsibilities

To provide proactive and effective technical support across Indevor Group, ensuring employees have access to reliable systems, technology and support to enable them to perform their roles effectively

To work collaboratively with the Group IT Manager, Management Teams and wider business to understand system requirements and deliver practical, effective technology solutions.

To maintain high standards of system security, data integrity and confidentiality when managing business systems, user access and commercially sensitive information.

To provide a professional, responsive and solutions-focused service to employees across the Group, taking ownership of technical issues through to effective resolution.

To proactively identify opportunities to improve systems, processes and ways of working through the effective use of technology, automation and system development.

To contribute towards the continuous improvement of the Group’s IT infrastructure and business systems, supporting the ongoing growth, efficiency and development of Indevor Group.

Role Specific Responsibilities:

Overview

The Salesforce Technician will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, support and continuous improvement of Indevor Group’s Salesforce platform, ensuring the system is effectively configured, maintained and developed to meet the evolving requirements of the business.

The role will provide hands-on Salesforce expertise alongside wider IT and systems support, working closely with the Group IT Manager and departments across the Group to resolve technical issues, improve system functionality, maintain data quality and identify opportunities to enhance and automate business processes.

Role Specific Tasks

A. To administer, maintain and support the Group’s Salesforce platform, taking ownership of day-to-day system requirements, user queries and technical issues.

B. To configure and maintain Salesforce functionality including users, profiles, roles, permissions, objects, fields, page layouts, record types and validation rules.

C. To create, maintain and enhance Salesforce reports and dashboards, providing accurate and meaningful information to support operational and management requirements.

D. To develop and maintain Salesforce automation, including flows and automated processes, to improve efficiency, reduce manual activity and support consistent ways of working.

E. To work with departments across the Group to understand business requirements and translate these into appropriate Salesforce configurations, enhancements and solutions.

F. To maintain high standards of Salesforce data quality and integrity, including data cleansing, imports, exports, validation, duplicate management and ongoing data maintenance.

G. To support integrations between Salesforce and other business systems, including monitoring data flows, troubleshooting integration issues and working with APIs where required.

H. To investigate and resolve Salesforce errors, system issues and user queries, identifying root causes and implementing effective and sustainable solutions.

I. To support the testing, implementation and deployment of Salesforce enhancements, releases, updates and new functionality, ensuring changes are appropriately tested prior to implementation.

J. To manage Salesforce user access and security requirements, ensuring permissions and system access remain appropriate and effectively controlled.

K. To provide guidance, support and training to Salesforce users across the Group, promoting effective system adoption, consistency and best practice.

L. To maintain accurate technical documentation covering Salesforce configuration, processes, integrations, system changes and troubleshooting procedures.

M. To provide wider IT support across the Group, assisting with hardware, software, Microsoft 365, user accounts, systems access and general technical issues as required.

N. To support the administration and maintenance of wider business systems and applications, including the onboarding and offboarding of users and management of appropriate system access.

O. To liaise with external IT providers, software suppliers and technical support teams where specialist assistance or escalation is required, ensuring issues are progressed through to resolution.

P. To proactively review existing systems and processes to identify opportunities for improvement, automation and greater utilisation of Salesforce and wider technology.

Q. To remain up to date with Salesforce releases, functionality and relevant technology developments, identifying opportunities to introduce improvements that support the Group’s ongoing growth and operational efficiency.

The responsibilities outlined are representative of the principal duties associated with the role. All colleagues are expected to adopt a flexible approach, undertaking additional duties commensurate with the role and contributing to the wider success of the business where required.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will already be operating within an IT support, systems administration, CRM or Salesforce-focused position, with approximately 2–3 years’ professional experience and demonstrable hands-on experience administering and supporting Salesforce within a business environment.

They will possess strong technical and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to investigate and resolve system issues independently. They will be confident managing multiple priorities simultaneously and able to communicate technical information clearly and effectively to users with varying levels of technical knowledge.

The successful candidate will enjoy working in an ambitious, fast-paced environment where technology and systems play an important role in supporting business performance. They will be comfortable taking ownership of Salesforce day-to-day, whilst also contributing to wider IT support, system integrations, data management and technology projects across the Group.

They will be proactive and forward-thinking, with a genuine process improvement mindset and an interest in understanding how the business operates. Rather than simply maintaining existing systems, they will naturally identify opportunities to improve functionality, automate processes, enhance the user experience and ensure Salesforce continues to develop alongside the ongoing growth of Indevor Group.

Additional Desirable Attributes

Previous experience administering and supporting Salesforce within a commercial business environment.

Salesforce Administrator certification, or a strong interest in working towards relevant Salesforce certifications.

Good working knowledge of Salesforce configuration, including users, permissions, objects, fields, reports, dashboards and automation.

Knowledge of Salesforce Flow, system integrations and APIs, with an understanding of how different business systems interact.

Strong understanding of data management principles, with excellent attention to detail and an appreciation of data quality, integrity and security.

Strong technical and analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions.

Naturally proactive, identifying potential issues and opportunities for improvement before they arise.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical users.

Comfortable working within a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and evolving business.

Strong commercial awareness with an interest in understanding business processes and how technology can improve operational performance.

Highly trustworthy with unquestionable integrity and discretion when managing system access, business data and confidential information.

Confident working independently, taking ownership of technical issues and seeing them through to resolution.

Excellent knowledge of Microsoft 365 and confidence supporting wider business systems and technology.

Strong interest in continuous personal development, emerging technology and improving business processes through systems and automation.

Able to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities effectively whilst maintaining high standards of accuracy.

Calm, resilient and capable of remaining composed when managing technical issues or competing business requirements.

Forward-thinking and solutions-focused, with a willingness to challenge existing processes and recommend more effective ways of working.

Takes pride in maintaining exceptionally high standards and contributing to a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and service excellence.

Indevor Group Introduction

Indevor Group is the UK’s leading provider of Infrastructure Support Services to the Housebuilding and Built Environment Sectors. Indevor prides itself on providing innovative solutions to serve our clientele with an underlying, paramount focus on delivering vital ancillary services to assist housebuilders addressing the shortfall of new homes completions in the United Kingdom.

Our clients include some of the UK’s leading FTSE 100 companies and leading New Homes Warranty Providers including the National House Building Council, where we take pride in delivering solutions that drive real impact.

We’ve built a culture that balances ambition with support. Indevor is a place where people are challenged to achieve their best while being part of a team that celebrates success together. Our commitment to our people has earned us Gold accreditation from Investors in People, Construction News Best Place to Work 2026 Nomination and recognition in The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), underlining our belief that high performance and a fantastic workplace go hand in hand.

Indevor is not a place for someone simply looking to pick up a pay cheque or even just build a reasonable career. We are looking for people who want to become part of our evolving story and huge ambitions, want to work hard, embrace challenges, and help us deliver on our mission.

title: Chair, Department of Ophthalmology
description:
Mayo Clinic is seeking an accomplished, collaborative, and visionary ophthalmologist to serve as Chair of the Department of Ophthalmology at Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, Florida.

This is a premier leadership opportunity within one of the world's leading academic medical centers. The Chair will provide strategic, academic, clinical, and operational leadership for a highly respected department, advancing Mayo Clinic's integrated model of care while championing excellence across clinical practice, education, research, innovation, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

The successful candidate will lead with a strong commitment to Mayo Clinic's core value that the needs of the patient come first and will foster a culture of professionalism, teamwork, inclusion, innovation, and academic achievement. The Chair will advance the three Mayo Clinic shields of clinical practice, education, and research while helping define the future direction of ophthalmology in Florida and across the Mayo Clinic enterprise.

About the Department

The Department of Ophthalmology at Mayo Clinic Florida is a multidisciplinary academic practice that delivers comprehensive medical and surgical eye care across a broad range of subspecialties. The department serves as a tertiary and quaternary referral center and collaborates extensively with colleagues across Mayo Clinic to care for patients with complex ocular and systemic diseases.

Clinical expertise includes:

  • Cataract and refractive surgery
  • Cornea and external disease
  • Glaucoma
  • Retina and vitreoretinal surgery
  • Neuro-ophthalmology
  • Ocular oncology
  • Oculoplastic and orbital surgery
  • Comprehensive ophthalmology
  • Complex anterior segment surgery

Faculty work closely with specialists in neurology, neurosurgery, oncology, endocrinology, rheumatology, transplant medicine, and other disciplines within Mayo Clinic's integrated practice model. The department also supports nationally recognized fellowship programs and is deeply committed to training future leaders in ophthalmology.

Position Responsibilities

Reporting to Mayo Clinic Florida leadership and working closely with enterprise leaders, the Chair will:

  • Provide strategic leadership and vision for the Department of Ophthalmology.
  • Advance clinical excellence, quality, patient experience, access, and growth.
  • Recruit, retain, mentor, and develop exceptional faculty and staff.
  • Foster a culture of professionalism, accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Strengthen and expand multidisciplinary partnerships across Mayo Clinic.
  • Support and enhance educational programs, faculty development, and learner experiences.
  • Advance clinical, translational, and outcomes research initiatives.
  • Promote scholarly activity and national visibility for the department.
  • Ensure responsible stewardship of departmental resources and operational effectiveness.

  • Serve as a key institutional leader within Mayo Clinic Florida and across the Mayo Clinic enterprise.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Board certification in Ophthalmology.
  • Eligibility for medical licensure in Florida.
  • A distinguished record of clinical excellence.
  • Significant leadership experience within an academic medical center, integrated health system, or large physician organization.
  • Demonstrated success in faculty recruitment, development, and mentorship.
  • A strong record of scholarly achievement and academic productivity.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and fostering collaboration.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Academic credentials consistent with appointment at the rank of Associate Professor or Professor

title: First Officer to M/S Eckerö Link
description:
Jobs on the Horizon - Welcome to Eckerö Link!

Eckerö Group has recently expanded its fleet with a new vessel, M/S Eckerö Link (formerly Nautica). The vessel is scheduled to enter service in September/October 2026.

We are currently seeking a First Officer to join us on M/S Eckerö Link. This is a permanent position starting immediately or as agreed.

M/S Eckerö Link sails under the Swedish flag and operates daily between Långnäs (Åland) and Naantali (Finland). The work rotation follows a 2:3 schedule.

The official working and safety language onboard is English, while skills in Finnish and Swedish are considered an advantage.

About the Role

The First Officer is responsible for safe navigation and watchkeeping, as well as supporting the safe and efficient operation of the vessel. Duties include monitoring safety and bridge equipment, assisting with deck and cargo operations, and following established safety procedures.

Who Are You?

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • Relevant professional experience and qualifications
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • A positive attitude and commitment to high safety and environmental standards

Requirements:

  • A valid Deck Officer Certificate (STCW II/1) - Higher certifications are considered an advantage.

What We Offer

As a member of the Eckerö Link team, you will enjoy:

  • Interesting and versatile duties in a dynamic and evolving company. We support learning, development, and career progression.
  • A friendly, fair, and committed work community—both ashore in Mariehamn and onboard.
  • Comprehensive occupational health care, as well as accident insurance covering both work and leisure time.


Interested?

Please submit your application and CV by 17 September 2026

For security reasons, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the deadline.

Please note that drug testing is part of our recruitment process for all new employees.

For more information, please contact:

Gabriella Andersson, HR Specialist

gabriella.andersson@rederiabeckero.ax

Welcome aboard!


About Eckerö Group

Our ambition is to be the natural choice for both travel and transport across our destinations.

We aim to offer a pleasant, smart, and responsible way to travel and move goods — always going the extra mile to create a positive experience for our customers and passengers. Meeting one of us should feel like meeting a friend — we provide simple, reliable, and thoughtful solutions.

The Eckerö Group comprises three companies: Eckerö Line, Eckerö Linjen and Eckerö Link. Together, we operate a wide range of services, including passenger and vehicle ferry connections across the Sea of Åland, combined passenger and freight services on the Gulf of Finland, and dedicated freight operations between Långnäs and Naantali. We employ around 850 professionals.

title: Defense - Senior Information Systems Security Officer- Cloud
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Defense - Senior Information Systems Security Officer- Cloud based in United States.

This is a fully remote opportunity supporting mission-critical U.S. Marine Corps cloud modernization initiatives.
The role focuses on securing cloud-native and containerized workloads while enabling successful Authority to Operate (ATO) outcomes.
You will lead Risk Management Framework activities and translate federal and defense security requirements into practical deliverables.
The position combines cloud security engineering, compliance, risk assessment, and hands-on security architecture.
You will work closely with architects, developers, DevSecOps teams, assessors, and other technical stakeholders.
The role also addresses emerging security considerations around generative AI, LLMs, and AI/ML workloads.
It offers the opportunity to influence the security of modern government systems while working in a highly specialized cybersecurity environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and support Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities across categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.
  • Translate NIST SP 800-53, DoD security policies, CNSS requirements, Cloud Computing SRG guidance, and AI-related security requirements into actionable security practices.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews and security engineering assessments for cloud-native and containerized workloads, particularly within Azure environments.
  • Evaluate security controls for Kubernetes, Docker, and other container orchestration technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen cloud security.
  • Assess risks associated with generative AI, large language models, and AI/ML workloads, supporting secure and responsible adoption of these technologies.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage RMF documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and related artifacts.
  • Perform threat modeling, vulnerability assessments, and risk analyses tailored to cloud and emerging AI technologies.
  • Partner with system architects, developers, and DevSecOps teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Support security control assessments and coordinate with third-party assessors and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor, track, and communicate security compliance through continuous monitoring processes and provide clear visibility into the security posture.
  • Provide expert guidance to technical and non-technical stakeholders while supporting secure modernization initiatives.
  • Perform minimal travel as required by program needs.

    • Requirements

    • Active Secret security clearance is required.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with 8+ years of cybersecurity experience, including hands-on RMF experience supporting defense systems.
    • Current CISSP or CISM certification is required.
    • Practical experience securing at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including IAM, networking, Kubernetes, and cloud security services.
    • Strong knowledge of containerized environments, including Docker and Kubernetes, and associated security best practices.
    • Familiarity with generative AI technologies, LLMs, and security considerations for AI/ML workloads.
    • Deep understanding of NIST SP 800-53, DoD RMF, FedRAMP, and other relevant cybersecurity frameworks.
    • Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining RMF artifacts such as SSPs, POA&Ms, and SARs.
    • Experience conducting security risk assessments in Department of War environments.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, leadership, assessors, and other stakeholders.
    • Ability to translate complex security, compliance, and risk requirements into clear and actionable recommendations.
    • Preferred: advanced cloud security certifications, such as Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CCSP, or an Azure equivalent.
    • Preferred: experience integrating DevSecOps pipelines with RMF compliance processes.
    • Preferred: familiarity with RMF automation and compliance tools such as Xacta, eMASS, or OpenRMF.
    • U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent resident status is required due to applicable federal government employment restrictions.

      • Benefits

      • Salary: Anticipated base salary range of $130,000–$160,000, with final compensation based on experience, education, skills, location, internal equity, market data, and applicable contract requirements.
      • Work arrangement: Fully remote position within the United States.
      • Mission-driven work: Opportunity to support mission-critical U.S. Marine Corps programs and modern cloud security initiatives.
      • Career development: Exposure to cloud modernization, DevSecOps, RMF, container security, and emerging AI/ML security challenges.
      • Professional impact: Opportunity to influence security architecture, compliance, and risk management for complex government systems.
      • Travel: Minimal travel requirements.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
The primary role of the Quality Engineer is to ensure compliance throughout the organization on assigned programs or customers from product design through manufacturing and product support.
