description:
Working at Transurban is different; it’s a place where you can see the benefits of your work play out in real life, every day. We create city-sized solutions—building and operating safer, smarter, and more sustainable roads—to solve pressing transport challenges that are slowing cities down.

About the role

Transurban (TU) continues to grow in scale and complexity. It is critical that we continue this journey safely and with appropriate levels of governance and risk management while retaining the ability to execute our strategy, business objectives and value proposition. Within this context, there is a clear focus on lawful, ethical and responsible workforce conduct and culture, which is a key People and Culture (P&C) strategic priority.

The Senior Workplace Relations Consultant will contribute to the success of Transurban by providing high-level and specialist advice on strategic and operational workplace relations matters. As an WR professional they will thrive in complex environments, bring sound judgement, and enjoy partnering with leaders to deliver practical, lawful and people‑centred outcomes.

The role will also contribute to P&C and enterprise priorities and initiatives, including but not limited to enterprise bargaining, complex case management, employee conduct, and contributing to Transurban’s delivery of it’s strategic priorities, including investing in our culture to enable our strategy and performance edge.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Provide specialist advice on complex workplace relations matters including disputes, grievances, misconduct, performance management and capacity matters

  • Interpret and apply industrial instruments, contracts, legislation, policies, and procedures

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of P&C and WR related policies, procedures, and guidelines

  • Coach and educate leaders and People & Culture colleagues on workplace relations risk, policy and compliance

  • Lead the resolution of complex case management and employee conduct issues

  • Contribute to projects and initiatives that strengthen workplace governance, compliance and culture

  • Support enterprise bargaining processes

This role will suit someone with a curious mind and transferrable skills and experiences, including:

  • At least 5+ years of senior level Workplace Relations experience in large and complex workplace settings

  • Tertiary qualifications in HR, Industrial Relations, Law, Business, Psychology or a related discipline (legal qualifications welcome but not essential)

  • Strong working knowledge of employment legislation, Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards and common law contracts

  • Experience managing complex case work and investigations end‑to‑end

  • Highly developed written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills

  • Ability to empathise and deal sensitively with issues impacting employee wellbeing, with an innate ability to navigate doing the right thing by the business and its people

  • Proven ability to establish priorities and work to strict timelines, both autonomously and as part of a team

If you meet some of these requirements, but not all, we encourage you to submit your application.

  • Learning and development opportunities to support your career interests

  • Health and wellbeing support—access to Headspace and our EAP program, wellness facilities, and more

  • Share offers and insurance benefits

  • Social activities, community give-back programs and paid volunteer days

We offer a range of flexible working and leave options, so you can balance your work and life commitments and interests. Have a conversation with us about how this could work for you.

title: Partnership Facilitator II
description:
MYANMAR COUNCIL OF CHURCHES' Holistic Child Development Project, funded by Compassion International Incorporated

Partnership Facilitator II

Myanmar Council of Churches' Holistic Child Development Project (HCDP)

The incumbent will be employed by and report to the Myanmar Council of Churches' Holistic Child Development Project (Yangon, Myanmar).

The Myanmar Council of Churches' Holistic Child Development Project (HCDP) is seeking a committed Christian professional to serve as a Partnership Facilitator. The position is responsible for strengthening relationships with church partners, building church capacity, facilitating child and youth development initiatives, and supporting sustainable ministry impact within local communities.

The Church Partnership Facilitator will work closely with pastors, church leaders, project committees, parents, and community stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of church-owned programs that contribute to the holistic development of children and youth. The role will also support child protection efforts, partnership management, and continuous improvement of ministry effectiveness across assigned partner churches.

Key Responsibilities

Church Partnership and Capacity Development

  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with partner churches.
  • Facilitate church ownership, leadership development, and organizational capacity strengthening.
  • Support church partners in identifying ministry priorities and developing strategies that address the needs of children and youth.
  • Encourage participation of children, youth, parents, caregivers, and community stakeholders in ministry planning and implementation.
  • Assist churches in identifying, mobilizing, and utilizing local resources to strengthen ministry sustainability.

Program Planning and Implementation

  • Facilitate needs assessments and community engagement processes to identify priority needs of children and youth.
  • Support church partners in developing annual ministry plans, budgets, and program activities.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support during program implementation.
  • Monitor progress against planned objectives and assist churches in identifying solutions to implementation challenges.
  • Facilitate learning, reflection, and evaluation processes to strengthen ministry effectiveness and improve future planning.

Partnership Management and Coordination

  • Coordinate support provided by Church Facing Team (CFT) members to partner churches.
  • Develop and implement church-specific Facilitation Workplans based on church capacity, priorities, and local context.
  • Review church reports, monitoring data, and partner feedback to identify support needs and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure timely documentation, reporting, and follow-up of partnership commitments and action plans.
  • Support the renewal and management of partnership agreements between HCDP and church partners.

Cluster and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support and oversee an assigned cluster of partner churches.
  • Facilitate collaboration, peer learning, and resource sharing among churches.
  • Strengthen relationships with pastors, church leaders, denominational representatives, community leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Promote partnerships and initiatives that enhance ministry impact and community engagement.

Child Protection

  • Promote and support the implementation of child protection policies, standards, and practices across all partner churches.
  • Build awareness and understanding of child safeguarding responsibilities among church leaders and stakeholders.
  • Ensure child protection concerns, allegations, or incidents are reported and addressed according to established procedures.
  • Support the creation of safe, healthy, and nurturing environments for children and youth.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Community Development, Social Work, Theology, Education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or a related field.
  • Experience
  • Minimum three (3) years of relevant professional experience in community development, child-focused programming, church partnership management, or a related field.
  • Experience working with churches, faith-based organizations, NGOs, or community development initiatives.
  • Experience facilitating training, workshops, community meetings, and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Experience in program planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting is an advantage.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and relationship-management skills.
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and interpersonal abilities.
  • Strong planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Proficiency in report writing and documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse church denominations and community stakeholders.

Language

  • Strong Burmese language skills, both written and spoken.
  • Working knowledge of English is an advantage.

Faith Requirement

  • Demonstrates a personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a commitment to Christian values.
  • Supports and promotes the mission, vision, and ministry values of the Myanmar Council of Churches' Holistic Child Development Project.

Working Environment

  • Based in Yangon with a home-office arrangement and regular travel to partner churches as required.
  • Combination of home-based work, virtual coordination, and field engagement.
  • Ability to work effectively within diverse cultural, denominational, and community settings.
  • Willingness to travel and adapt to varying local contexts to support partnership and program objectives.

Travel Requirements

  • Regular travel within Myanmar may be required, representing up to 50% of working time.

Why Join Us?

This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the strengthening of local churches and the holistic development of children and youth across Myanmar. The successful candidate will play a meaningful role in building sustainable church partnerships, supporting community transformation, and advancing child-focused ministry impact.

Qualified Christian professionals with a passion for church partnership, child development, and community transformation are encouraged to apply.

title: Secretaresse Samenleving (30-32 uur)
description:
Welke uitdaging bieden we?

Ben jij een organisatietalent dat graag ontzorgt, snel schakelt en energie krijgt van samenwerken? Ben je optimistisch, betrokken en proactief? Dan ben jij misschien de nieuwe secretaresse voor ons domein Samenleving.

Wat deze functie zo leuk maakt? De afwisseling! Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je beheert agenda's, plant afspraken en bent het eerste aanspreekpunt als het gaat om organisatorische en agenda technische vragen. Dankzij jouw overzicht verlopen interne processen soepel. Zo geef je teammanagers en collega's de ruimte om zich te richten op hun maatschappelijke opgaven en de dienstverlening aan onze inwoners. Je werkt samen met collega's uit het hele domein Samenleving, waardoor je een breed netwerk opbouwt en een belangrijke verbindende rol vervult.

Welke verantwoordelijkheden krijg je

Als secretaresse Samenleving maak je deel uit van het domeinsecretariaat: de spil van het domein Samenleving . Dit domein telt in totaal negen teams. Samen met drie collega-secretaresses zorg jij ervoor dat alles achter de schermen op rolletjes loopt en collega's optimaal worden ondersteund. Jouw voornaamste taken zijn als volgt:

  • Je beheert de agenda’s van twee teammanagers en bent hun eerste aanspreekpunt;

  • Je organiseert vergaderingen, bijeenkomsten en -in overleg- sociale activiteiten en zorgt voor een goede voorbereiding en communicatie;

  • Je stelt opdrachtbrieven op (op basis van input) en verzorgt de verzending;

  • Je codeert inkomende facturen en zorgt voor een juiste verwerking;

  • Je bent, samen met je collega's, verantwoordelijk voor de gezamenlijke mailbox van het domeinsecretariaat en zorgt voor een tijdige en zorgvuldige afhandeling van binnenkomende vragen.

In deze functie spring je ook bij wanneer je collega-secretaresses afwezig zijn of wanneer extra hulp nodig is.

Waar ben je goed in

Je bent nauwkeurig, zelfstandig, positief en houdt altijd overzicht – ook als het druk is. Je denkt mee, signaleert knelpunten en komt in actie wanneer nodig. Vertrouwelijke informatie behandel je uiteraard met de grootste zorg. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit, bent dienstverlenend ingesteld en zorgt voor een correcte afhandeling van je werkzaamheden. Tot slot is het heel belangrijk dat je goed en graag samenwerkt met anderen en dat je van nature collegiaal bent. Een goede dosis humor wordt daarbij zeker gewaardeerd!

Op welke ervaring bouw je verder

Om deze functie goed te kunnen vervullen, vragen we van jou het volgende:

  • Een relevante afgeronde opleiding op minimaal mbo 4-niveau;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als secretaresse;

  • Ervaring met het werken met diverse systemen om informatie te verzamelen en te verwerken;

  • Beschikbaarheid op vrijdag (in verband met de voorbereiding van het portefeuillehoudersoverleg).

Wat bieden wij nog meer?

Naast een informele werksfeer, leuke collega’s en een mooi onboardingsprogramma, bieden wij jou de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 4.065,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week conform schaal 7 (inschaling is afhankelijk van jouw kennis/ervaring);

  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 17,05 % IKB (maandelijks opneembaar), dat je in kunt zetten voor extra salaris, vakantiedagen, een sportabonnement etc.

  • Een ruim aanbod in cursus- en opleidingsmogelijkheden, gericht op jouw ontplooiing en ontwikkeling;

  • Een duurzaam pensioen via het pensioenfonds ABP, waarvan 70% vergoed door gemeente Lansingerland;

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 1 jaar (30-32 uur per week), met zicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

Interesse?

Maatwerk, uitdaging en ontwikkeling zijn kernwoorden in ons personeelsbeleid. Past deze nieuwe uitdaging bij jou als persoon en zie jij raakvlakken met jouw eigen achtergrond en hetgeen wij vragen? Solliciteer dan zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk 18 augustus 2026. Eerst nog wat vragen? Neem dan even contact op met:

-Nadja Staverman (06- 43 48 47 84) Corporate Recruiter;

-Patricia Barkmeijer (06 – 51 25 03 27) Teammanager Jeugd gezin & Schuldhulp.

title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
The Lead Principal Technical Program Manager for data center server operations partners with senior management, engineering, product, operations, analytics, and cross-functional stakeholders to lead complex, high-impact technical programs that improve how OCI supports global data center infrastructure.

This role establishes program scope, milestones, execution plans, governance mechanisms, and success metrics for programs that improve server operations, hardware support workflows, technician productivity, operational visibility, automation, and service reliability. The TPM will help drive the modernization of operational platforms that support task execution, inventory coordination, guided procedures, analytics, workflow automation, cross-team collaboration, and continuous improvement.

As a senior individual contributor, this role operates independently across large, ambiguous, and strategically important initiatives. The TPM will translate broad organizational priorities into structured programs, align stakeholders across multiple teams, identify and mitigate risks, manage dependencies, drive execution, and ensure successful delivery of products and services that support OCI’s continued growth.

The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to engineering and operational leaders, bringing structure to ambiguity and clarity to complex cross-functional work. They will drive disciplined execution, improve program mechanisms, communicate effectively with senior leadership, and ensure programs deliver measurable outcomes for customers, users, and the business.

This role is ideal for a senior TPM with experience leading cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, internal platforms, data center operations, workflow automation, analytics, or large-scale technical programs. The ideal candidate combines technical depth, strong judgment, written communication, operational rigor, and the ability to influence across teams without

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs supporting data center server operations, software platforms, workflow automation, analytics, and operational tooling.

Define program scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, risks, launch plans, and success criteria aligned with organizational priorities.

Partner with engineering, product management, operations, analytics, infrastructure teams, support organizations, security, compliance, and senior leadership to align priorities and deliver high-impact programs.

Drive execution across programs that improve task management, guided workflows, technician experiences, inventory coordination, operational analytics, automation, and service readiness.

Establish program governance, delivery mechanisms, operating cadences, KPIs, service level expectations, roadmap reviews, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.

Serve as the primary escalation point for critical program, operational, integration, security, and delivery issues, coordinating cross-functional teams to drive timely resolution.

Identify risks, dependencies, ownership gaps, and execution blockers early; develop mitigation plans and drive clear accountability across teams.

Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to ensure solutions are designed for scalability, reliability, security, observability, supportability, and long-term maintainability.

Lead launch readiness for pilot, phased rollout, and general availability milestones, including test planning, dependency readiness, operational reviews, adoption planning, and post-launch measurement.

Use data, metrics, dashboards, reporting, and stakeholder feedback to assess program health, identify trends, support decision-making, and improve outcomes.

Drive continuous improvement in program execution, operational processes, planning mechanisms, communication practices, and cross-team collaboration.

Develop written narratives, executive updates, roadmap reviews, decision documents, risk summaries, and program plans that clearly communicate status, trade-offs, asks, and recommendations.

Support adoption and change management for new platforms, workflows, analytics capabilities, operating mechanisms, and process improvements.

Mentor program managers and cross-functional partners by raising the bar for planning, execution discipline, stakeholder management, written communication, and operational excellence.

Operate as a trusted advisor to senior leadership by bringing structure to ambiguity, surfacing decisions needed, and driving alignment across complex technical and operational programs.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

12+ years of experience in technical program management, business program management, project management, engineering program leadership, infrastructure operations, or a related role leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, cross-organizational technical programs from strategy and planning through execution, launch, adoption, and measurement.
Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations, analytics, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, resolve dependencies, and deliver strategic outcomes.

Experience managing program risks, dependencies, executive escalations, competing priorities, resource constraints, and ambiguous requirements in a fast-paced technical environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using metrics, dashboards, reporting, and operational data to guide decisions and measure success.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting program status, risks, decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive results without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading technical programs supporting cloud infrastructure, data center operations, enterprise software, internal platforms, workflow automation, operational tooling, or large-scale distributed systems.

Experience with hardware operations, server lifecycle management, inventory systems, guided workflows, operational analytics, or infrastructure support platforms.

Experience establishing program governance, execution mechanisms, operational cadences, KPIs, SLAs, launch readiness frameworks, and executive reporting.
Experience driving operational excellence, process optimization, automation, and organizational change across multiple teams or business functions.

Experience managing programs that integrate with ticketing systems, inventory systems, knowledge bases, telemetry platforms, analytics pipelines, or enterprise systems of record.
Experience using data analysis, forecasting, dashboards, or reporting tools to improve program visibility, operational decision-making, and business outcomes.

Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with senior leaders, influence strategic business and technical decisions, and communicate effectively across engineering and operations organizations.

Standard Setter: Sets standards and infrastructure tor the enterprise (policies, processes, systems, tools) and evaluates effectiveness

Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to attract high-quality candidates from external markets, focusing on both active and passive talent pools.
Builder: Researches, designs and develops leading practice HR programs and solutions that enhance our culture
Streamline recruitment processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness, utilizing the latest tools and technologies.
Champion diversity and inclusion in recruitment practices, aiming to build a diverse and talented workforce.
Curator: Curates HR solutions driving and supporting implementations and improvements
Utilize recruitment metrics and data analytics to guide decisions and improve recruitment outcomes.

Competencies:External Talent Sourcing - Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.

Candidate Assessment and Selection - Defines qualification requirements and selection criteria for open positions using Cummins tools; employs objective selection processes that meet compliance requirements; assesses, evaluates and selects candidates against pre-determined job specifics and "Select for Cummins" competencies, and communicates openly with candidate and stakeholders to ensure timely hiring outcomes.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.
Education, Licenses, Certifications:College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.
Professional certifications in recruitment or human resources (such as AIRS CIR, SHRM-CP, or similar) are highly desirable.
Experience:Solid experience in recruitment or HR, with a proven track record and industry knowledge of sourcing and selecting candidates, and leading operational teams.

Lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for Cummins while managing key stakeholder relationships across business units. Drive exceptional candidate experience and build high-performing recruitment teams to achieve hiring targets. Leverage market intelligence and AI-powered recruiting technologies to optimize talent sourcing, screening, and selection processes. Ensure consistent, data-driven hiring outcomes that align with workforce planning and business growth objectives.

title: Expeditor
description:
Job Summary

The Expeditor supports daily manufacturing operations by ensuring jobs, materials, and documentation move efficiently throughout the facility. This position works closely with Production, Materials, Quality, and Shipping to keep orders on schedule, expedite priority work, and provide warehouse support as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced precision manufacturing environment.


Major Responsibilities:

  • Monitor production schedules and expedite jobs to meet customer delivery commitments.
  • Track work orders through each manufacturing operation and identify potential delays.
  • Coordinate with supervisors to prioritize hot jobs and customer expedites.
  • Stage and move materials between departments to support production flow.
  • Update ERP system with work order status, completions, and inventory transactions.
  • Verify materials, routers, and travelers accompany each job.
  • Communicate schedule changes and production status to Operations and Customer Service.
  • Support cycle counts and inventory accuracy initiatives.
  • Assist Receiving, Shipping, and Warehouse during peak periods.
  • Safely operate forklifts and material handling equipment (or obtain certification).
  • Maintain an organized warehouse and production staging areas.
  • Perform other production control and warehouse duties as assigned. Coordinate daily production schedules based on customer demand and manufacturing priorities.
  • Release and manage production work orders within the ERP system.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives focused on scheduling efficiency and workflow.
  • Maintain documentation in accordance with quality system requirements.
  • Provide administrative support for production planning activities as required

description:
Are you a Level 1 Med Aide looking for an exciting full-time opportunity? Look no further, as The Timbers Assisted Living has the perfect position for you! We are currently seeking a dedicated and compassionate L1MA to join our team at our Holts Summit Missouri location. As a L1MA at The Timbers you will play a vital role in ensuring the safety and well-being of our residents by administering medications accurately and efficiently.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with our nursing team and build meaningful relationships with our residents. Joining our team means being part of a company that values empathy, customer-centricity, and excellence. We pride ourselves on providing a high level of care and support to our residents, and we encourage a culture of teamwork, innovation, and professional growth. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of others and want to work in a dynamic and rewarding environment, apply now!

With a competitive pay rate of $16.00-$19.50per hour, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. You will be given great benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Competitive Salary, Paid Time Off, Simple IRA, On Demand Pay, and Tuition Reimbursement.

WHAT WOULD YOU DO AS A L1MA

As a L1MA at The Timbers, you will have a diverse and impactful role in our team. You will be responsible for administering medications to our residents, ensuring that they receive their prescribed treatments accurately and on time. Additionally, you will provide assistance to our PCAs in providing personalized care to our residents. Your expertise and attention to detail in medication administration will contribute to the overall well-being and comfort of our residents. Through your daily interactions, you will have the opportunity to form meaningful connections with our residents and make a positive impact on their lives.

Join us at Jefferson City Manor and be a part of our dedicated team committed to providing exceptional care.

ARE YOU A GOOD FIT FOR THIS Level 1 Med Aide JOB?

To be successful as a Level 1 Med Aide at The Timbers, there are several key skills and qualifications that are necessary. Firstly, you must have a current L1MA certification, ensuring that you have the necessary knowledge and training to administer medications safely and effectively. Attention to detail is crucial, as you will be responsible for accurately documenting medication administration and ensuring that residents receive the correct dosage at the appropriate times. Strong communication skills are also essential, as you will be collaborating with the nursing team and working closely with residents to understand their individual needs and preferences. Additionally, the ability to prioritize and multitask is important, as you will be assisting PCAs with resident care as needed.

Your commitment to providing compassionate and empathetic care will contribute to the overall well-being and comfort of our residents. Join our team at The Timbers where your skills and expertise can make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

Knowledge and skills required for the position are:

  • Current L1MA certification
  • #HP

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Team Lead / Manager - Onsite Operations to own the end-to-end execution of corporate health camps for our clients. This role requires someone who can independently plan, coordinate, and govern large-scale onsite health camps - managing multiple vendors, ensuring smooth on-ground execution, and owning reporting and escalations. This is a high-ownership role suited to someone who is sharp, decisive, and comfortable solving problems in real time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Vendor Coordination: Mobilize and coordinate multiple vendors (paramedics/manpower, diagnostics, equipment, transport/logistics) for each camp - for large camps, this may mean managing 5+ vendors in parallel.
• Planning & Briefing: Define camp requirements upfront - manpower, equipment, test panels, and reporting formats - and brief/train vendor teams accordingly.
• On-Ground Governance: Be present and active during camp execution - govern and monitor operations live, and troubleshoot issues on the spot.
• Diagnostics/Testing Oversight: Ensure test panels and sample logistics are executed accurately as per client scope.
• Reporting & Escalation: Own camp reports and vendor invoice reconciliation; escalate last-minute issues to leadership promptly and clearly.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as the single point of contact for client-side coordination during camp execution.


Requirements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 5-8 years of experience in on-ground event, camp, or field operations - ideally with exposure to health camps, corporate wellness, or diagnostic camp execution.
• Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple vendors simultaneously for large-scale onsite/field events.
• Strong sense of ownership - able to govern and monitor independently without heavy oversight.
• Sharp problem-solving ability with a track record of making sound decisions under pressure, on the ground.
• Experience with reporting discipline, including vendor invoice reconciliation and camp MIS.
• Prior experience at TL/Manager level, having led a team or owned vendor coordination independently.
• Prior experience at a health-tech, corporate wellness, diagnostics, or event management company running large-scale onsite camps is an advantage.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Running Camps smoothly with minimal escalations, and any issues are resolved on the spot without disrupting the client experience.
• Vendor coordination should be seamless, with clear briefing and accountability across all vendor partners.
• Reporting and invoicing should be accurate, timely, and audit-ready.
• Ensuring Client & stakeholders should view this role as a reliable, single point of ownership for onsite execution.


Benefits

About ekincare
Join the fastest growing health benefits platform in India. ekincare is a Series B funded startup, operating in one of the few industries with strong tailwinds from the evolving healthcare and insurance ecosystem.
We are at the intersection of HealthTech and InsurTech, serving South East Asia's multi-billion-dollar corporate health benefits market. Trusted by 1000+ companies including LinkedIn, Nike, Netflix, Air-bnb, S&P Global, D-mart, and many more, our predictive and personalized platform helps employers administer health benefits efficiently, reduce healthcare costs, and improve employee engagement.
Recognized for innovation by NASSCOM as one of India's most innovative startups and by Google for Startups.
Why Join Us?
• Be part of a successful, high-growth Series B-funded startup with patented technology.
• Work at the forefront of health-tech innovation and digital healthcare transformation.
• Trusted by 1000+ organizations across industries.
• Dynamic startup culture with a flat hierarchy and a "fast fail, fast learn" mindset.
• Attractive compensation with lucrative performance-based incentives.
• ESOPs and accelerated career growth opportunities.
• 360-degree appraisal process for holistic performance feedback.
• Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
• Comprehensive medical benefits and wellness perks, including Gym, Yoga, Zumba, and more.

Job Description:

The Actuarial Specialist, Par Management and Risk Modelling is responsible for supporting participating (Par) business management activities and risk modelling initiatives within the Actuarial Valuation function. The role plays a key part in dividend studies, Par reporting, financial condition testing, and risk sensitivity analysis, providing valuable insights to support strategic decision-making and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

Dividend Study:

  • Conduct comprehensive annual dividend studies for traditional participating (par) products
  • Analyze experience and financial results to determine appropriate dividend recommendations.
  • Prepare and present well-supported dividend recommendations to the Chief Actuary and senior management.

Par Reporting:

  • Prepare quarterly valuation deliverables related to traditional participating products, including: Time Value of Guarantees (TVOG) and Unallocated Dividend Liability (UDL)
  • Perform stochastic asset modelling using actuarial software.
  • Support the preparation of regulatory and management reports related to the participating business.
  • Prepare reports required for OSFI and other regulatory reporting requirements.

Financial Condition Testing (FCT):

  • Contribute to the completion of the annual FCT process
  • Perform scenario analysis and assess the financial impact of adverse events.
  • Analyze results and prepare reports and presentations for senior management review.

Risk Sensitivity Analysis:

  • Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of risk sensitivity models for market and insurance risks.
  • Produce and analyze quarterly market and insurance risk sensitivity results.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on observed trends and risk exposures.

Ad-hoc projects depending on business needs such as but not limited to:

  • Support semi-annual business planning and projection exercises.
  • Contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives within the Actuarial function.
  • Participate in strategic and ad hoc actuarial projects as required by the business.

Qualifications

  • University degree with a strong mathematical or statistical background
  • Associate or near-associate of the Actuarial Society of the Philippines (ASP)
  • Minimum of 7 years of actuarial experience, preferably within life insurance
  • Strong knowledge of actuarial modelling and valuation concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with actuarial modelling software, preferably AXIS.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with automation and data analytics tools is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • High attention to detail and strong sense of ownership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management skills.

title: Demand Planner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Demand Planner based in United States.

This role will own demand planning across a growing omnichannel consumer business, translating commercial activity into accurate and actionable forecasts.
You’ll work across DTC, retail, and marketplace channels, managing SKU-level demand across weekly and monthly planning horizons.
The position sits at the intersection of Sales, Growth, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations, giving you broad business exposure.
You’ll lead demand consensus, challenge assumptions, and create a shared view of expected demand, risks, and opportunities.
Your analysis will directly influence inventory efficiency, product availability, supply requirements, and financial planning.
The environment is fast-moving and data-driven, requiring someone who can adapt quickly as demand signals, channels, and priorities evolve.
This is an ideal opportunity for an analytical, proactive planner who enjoys turning complex data into decisions that support sustainable growth.

Accountabilities:

  • Own and maintain SKU-level demand forecasts across DTC, retail, and marketplace channels, incorporating historical demand, trends, seasonality, promotions, marketing activity, customer plans, and product launches.
  • Develop forecasts for new products and channels using relevant assumptions, analogs, and early performance signals where historical data is limited.
  • Continuously monitor changes in demand patterns and update forecasts as new commercial and market information becomes available.
  • Maintain clear visibility between baseline demand and incremental demand generated by promotions, launches, distribution changes, marketing campaigns, and other commercial activities.
  • Lead the recurring demand consensus process by bringing channel leaders and cross-functional stakeholders together around a single, aligned forecast.
  • Prepare forecast materials highlighting changes, assumptions, risks, opportunities, and decisions required from business stakeholders.
  • Constructively challenge forecasts and business assumptions by reconciling statistical projections, channel expectations, and commercial targets.
  • Establish and monitor demand planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy and forecast bias across appropriate SKU, channel, and category levels.
  • Conduct forecast-versus-actual analysis to identify variance drivers, systematic bias, and opportunities to improve forecasting methodologies and processes.
  • Distinguish underlying consumer demand from factors such as stockouts, inventory constraints, retailer ordering behavior, and other distortions in historical sales data.
  • Maintain accurate SKU attributes, product hierarchies, channel mappings, lifecycle statuses, launch dates, forecast versions, and other planning inputs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning systems, reporting, automation, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Supply Planning and Operations to translate forecasts into inventory and supply requirements and identify potential availability risks.
  • Collaborate with DTC, Growth, and Marketing teams to incorporate acquisition plans, promotional calendars, subscriptions, campaigns, and other demand drivers.
  • Partner with Finance during budgeting and planning cycles, translating SKU- and channel-level demand assumptions into revenue and unit planning inputs.
  • Reconcile operational demand plans with financial targets and clearly communicate gaps, risks, and opportunities.
  • Provide forecasts, assumptions, variance analysis, and scenario insights for monthly consensus and planning meetings, helping leadership maintain a clear view of expected demand.
  • Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to evaluate the inventory and supply implications of changing demand assumptions.

    • Requirements:

    • 7+ years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain planning, inventory planning, or a related analytical discipline, preferably within a consumer products or omnichannel environment.
    • Demonstrated experience forecasting across multiple channels, including DTC/e-commerce, marketplaces such as Amazon, and wholesale or retail.
    • Strong understanding of demand planning fundamentals, including forecasting methodologies, seasonality, promotional impacts, new product forecasting, forecast accuracy, and bias.
    • Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate complex, large-scale SKU-level datasets into clear business insights and recommendations.
    • Experience maintaining high levels of data accuracy, planning discipline, and data integrity across complex product and channel structures.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to facilitate consensus among teams with differing priorities and perspectives.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where demand signals, business priorities, and channel dynamics can change rapidly.
    • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify risks and opportunities and recommend actions rather than simply report findings.
    • Experience in CPG, beauty, personal care, household products, or another high-growth consumer brand is a plus.
    • Experience with integrated business planning or S&OP processes is preferred.
    • Experience working with retail customer forecasts, POS data, purchase orders, or retailer inventory dynamics is advantageous.
    • Experience supporting subscription or replenishment-based DTC businesses is a plus.
    • Marketplace forecasting and inventory experience, particularly with Amazon or similar platforms, is beneficial.

title: Data Licensing Lead
description:
Data Licensing Lead

<br>

Job Description

<br>

About the Role

As Data Licensing Lead, you will play a key role in managing Domain’s compliance obligations across its data licensing arrangements - especially across our key partnerships with government entities.

This role will suit someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working with contracts, audit requirements, compliance controls and operational processes. You will help ensure that key obligations are understood, tracked and delivered on time.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Legal, Product, Technology, Research, Data Partnerships and external government licensors, but will be expected to take day-to-day ownership of the compliance operating rhythm. From engaging on current Government data partnerships, to supporting new data licensing arrangements, and responding to audits and client or supplier requests, your detail-oriented approach will keep things running smoothly and efficiently. This is a hands-on role with meaningful responsibility.

If you enjoy working with technical documents and thrive on precision and process improvement, this is a unique opportunity to work on meaningful projects across the business, in a supportive team that values independence and trust - all while opening doors to future opportunities across the business during a period of huge growth.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage contracts and obligations – Monitor key contractual requirements and help ensure ongoing compliance obligations are met.

  • Drive compliance activities – Partner with key business stakeholders to implement and improve processes, controls and governance practices.

  • Coordinate audits and reviews – Support audit responses, information requests and follow-up actions across the business.

  • Support commercial initiatives – Assist with new data partnerships, licensing arrangements and related governance requirements.

  • Monitor risks and actions – Track commitments, compliance activities and remediation actions to completion.

  • Keep things organised – Maintain accurate records, registers, schedules and compliance documentation.

Our Ideal Person:

ESSENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent from an accredited university.

  • Experience working in highly regulated environments with emphasis on contractual/legal/regulatory compliance.

  • Experience analysing and managing contracts, licenses and/or regulatory/legislative documents.

  • Strong attention to detail – you double-check your work and make sure everything is accurate.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Confidence in communicating with different teams and internal/external stakeholders.

  • Strong professional and technical writing skills.

  • A proactive and solutions-focused mindset – you see challenges as opportunities to improve.


NICE TO HAVES:

  • Experience with procurement processes (tenders, EOI’s, RFPs, RFT’s etc) or audits.

  • A background in legal, banking, compliance, or governance frameworks is a big plus!

  • Experience interpreting and managing contracts.

What’s In It for You

We're the right-sized business for you to make a real impact, with a workplace culture where you can be you. There’s so many perks! Here’s some of the favourites…

  • Up to 20 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers.

  • Wellbeing Leave, and the opportunity to buy additional leave days.

  • Leadership development programs, LinkedIn Learning and more.

  • Regular social events including our famous Innovation Days and annual BBQ!

About Domain and CoStar Group


Domain is a leading property technology and services marketplace that is home to one of the largest portfolios of property brands in Australia, including the Domain, Allhomes and Commercial Real Estate (CRE) platforms. In 2025, Domain became part of CoStar Group - a global leader in commercial real estate information, analytics, online marketplaces and 3D digital twin technology. We are dedicated to digitising the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights, and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

What’s Next?

We’ll give your application the thoughtful attention it deserves and get back to you as soon as possible. If there’s a match, one of our recruitment consultants will reach out—so keep your phone handy! We’re genuinely excited about the chance to work together and make a meaningful impact.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

Domain is enthusiastically and unapologetically committed to fostering an equitable, inclusive work culture which reflects our customers and communities. We are proactively looking for candidates from all lived experiences, including people with disability, and people of all ages, ethnicities, cultures (including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples), faiths, sexual orientations, and gender identities (including trans and non-binary people).

We are committed to providing an equitable recruitment process for people with disability. If you require adjustments during the process we’re here to support. If you wish to receive this job advertisement in an accessible format, or have a confidential chat about workplace adjustments, please contact our Equity, Diversity and Inclusion team at edi@domain.com.au or leave a message on 1300 858 356 and we will get back to you.

title: Lärare årskurs 4-6 till Lillestadskolan
description:
Ingen arbetsdag är den andra lik hos oss på Växjö kommun. Ibland tar vi hand om de små sakerna och ibland om de riktigt stora. Oavsett vilket innebär det en arbetsdag som betyder något på riktigt. Vi är drygt 7 000 medarbetare som tillsammans jobbar för att skapa en bra dag, varje dag. 

Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra skillnad och samtidigt växa och utvecklas. Här finns en stor bredd av yrken och karriärmöjligheter, gemensamt för dem alla är att de bygger och skapar vårt framtida Växjö. Vill du dela vår arbetsdag?

Jobba för en bra dag. Varje dag.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Välkommen till utbildningsförvaltningen!

Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra skillnad för våra barn och elever. Vi ansvarar för cirka 

18 000 barn och elever och jobbar varje dag för att de ska utvecklas och nå en ökad måluppfyllelse. Vi vill att barn kommer in i vår verksamhet som nyfikna kreativa ettåringar och lämnar oss som engagerade, kunniga och självständiga 19-20-åringar. 

Lillestadskolan är en F-6 skola belägen på norr i Växjö.  Skolan har lite över 300 elever med ett elevunderlag som väl speglar det samhälle vi lever i. Vi har stort fokus på att arbeta med elevhälsa och elevernas sociala situation. På Lillestadskolan tar alla ansvar för sin kunskapsutveckling, för varandra och för vår gemensamma miljö. Vi arbetar för goda relationer och trygghet som utgör grunden för att uppnå hög måluppfyllelse. 

Som arbetstagare hos oss är du viktig! Oavsett vilken roll du har i vår förvaltning kommer du, tillsammans med oss, arbeta för att bidra till en positiv utveckling för våra barn och elever. 

På Lillestadskolan har vi valt att satsa på trelärarskap vilket innebär att vi utökar vår organisation på mellanstadiet för att i högre utsträckning möta eleverna där de befinner sig och samtidigt värna om en god arbetsmiljö för våra lärare. Som lärare hos oss ingår du i arbetslag åk 4-6. Du arbetar med att planera och genomföra undervisning enligt gällande läroplan. Du kommer att undervisa i åk 5 tillsammans med två andra klasslärare.

På Lillestadskolan arbetar vi i team. Samarbetet mellan arbetslag och lärare gör att lärarna ser och möter eleverna i olika situationer och på så sätt får ett helhetsperspektiv kring eleven. All personal har ett gemensamt ansvar för elevernas lärande och utveckling. Du har ett stort stöd av skolans Elevhälsoteam som består av specialpedagog, speciallärare, skolsköterska och kurator.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa mot årskurserna 4-6 och behörighet i minst svenska, matematik och engelska samt antingen SO eller NO. 

Du har en medveten tanke kring din roll som pedagog och är en tydlig ledare som arbetar strukturerat utifrån gällande styrdokument och har ett positivt förhållningssätt. 

Du har förmåga att skapa ett gott arbetsklimat med engagemang, nyfikenhet och trygghet i gruppen och har goda kunskaper i att möta elevers olika behov utifrån deras förutsättningar. 

Du är flexibel, ansvarsfull och lyhörd för elevernas behov, men samtidigt tydlig, kan sätta gränser och har ett stort tålamod. Du har ett professionellt förhållningssätt, en god initiativförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med andra samt att du kommunicerar med både barn och vuxna på ett okomplicerat sätt.  

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde 2026-11-01 eller enligt överenskommelse, omfattning 80 - 100 %, upphör: 2027-06-12  .

Växjö kommuns anställda ska spegla den mångfald som finns i kommunen. Vi välkomnar sökande oberoende av till exempel ålder, kön och etnicitet.

Som tillsvidareanställd blir du som regel krigsplacerad i vår organisation.

Det kan bli aktuellt med löpande intervjuer så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Ansökan sker enbart via Offentliga jobbs rekryteringsverktyg (www.offentligajobb.se). 

Medtag utbildningsbevis och eventuell yrkeslegitimation vid intervju. För att bli aktuell för anställning behöver du visa två utdrag från belastningsregistret innan du anställs. Beställning av utdrag ur belastningsregistret kan göras på https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/ och du ska använda dels det som heter Arbete inom skola eller förskola (442.5) samt Kontroll av egna uppgifter i belastningsregistret (442.3).

title: Inżynier Systemów Hydraulicznych (współpraca z GE Vernova)
description:
Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Lotnictwa należy do najnowocześniejszych placówek badawczych w Europie, o tradycjach sięgających 1926 roku. Instytut ściśle współpracuje ze światowymi potentatami przemysłu lotniczego, takimi jak: GE Aerospace, Boeing, ST Engineering (MRAS), Airbus, Pratt & Whitney, a także energetycznego: GE Vernova oraz Baker Hughes. Współdziała również z instytucjami z branży kosmicznej, w tym z Europejską Agencją Kosmiczną. Strategicznymi obszarami badawczymi Instytutu są technologie lotnicze, kosmiczne oraz bezzałogowe. Prowadzone są tutaj badania i usługi dla przemysłu krajowego oraz zagranicznego w zakresie technologii materiałowych i kompozytowych, przyrostowych, teledetekcyjnych, energetycznych i wydobywczych.


Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Lotnictwa współpracuje z GE Vernova (portfel spółek energetycznych GE: Power, Digital i Renewable Energy) świadcząc usługi badawczo-rozwojowe dla klientów korporacyjnych związanych z branżą energetyczną i ekologią. Oferujemy pracę w innowacyjnym, międzynarodowym środowisku, gdzie współpracownicy posiadają realny wpływ na zaawansowane technologicznie projekty, w których na co dzień uczestniczą.

Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Lotnictwa poszukuje Osoby/Osób na stanowisko:

Inżynier Systemów Hydraulicznych będzie uczestniczyć w opracowywaniu koncepcji, projektowaniu inżynierskim oraz wsparciu technicznym systemów olejowych i paliwowych dla turbin gazowych oraz generatorów energii elektrycznej. Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie stopniowo przejmować odpowiedzialność za zadania projektowe, a wraz z rozwojem kompetencji – pełnić wiodącą rolę w projektach nowych jednostek, realizując priorytety SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost). Praca wymaga ścisłej współpracy z zespołami interdyscyplinarnymi oraz przygotowywania wysokiej jakości dokumentacji inżynierskiej.

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Opracowywanie koncepcji oraz realizacja projektowania inżynierskiego systemów paliwowych, olejowych i pomocniczych dla turbin gazowych i generatorów
  • Rozwój specyfikacji systemowych i komponentowych, dokumentacji „build‑to‑print” oraz „build-to-spec”
  • Tworzenie schematów aparatury kontrolno‑pomiarowej, schematów hydraulicznych F&ID oraz zestawień materiałowych (BOM)
  • Dobór i specyfikacja kluczowych komponentów systemów płynowych, w tym: pomp, zaworów regulacji temperatury i ciśnienia, filtrów, chłodnic, grzałek oraz czujników temperatury i ciśnienia
  • Wykonywanie obliczeń i analiz, w tym obliczeń hydraulicznych (hand calculations) układów paliwowych i olejowych, w celu dostarczenia płynu w wymaganej klasie czystości, ciśnieniu i w zakresie temperatur
  • Odpowiedzialność end‑to‑end za realizację projektów nowych jednostek, w tym: definiowanie wymagań operacyjnych, rozwój projektu technicznego, ocena urządzeń dostawców, wsparcie uruchomień i rozruchów, rozwiązywanie problemów jakościowych produktu.
  • Przegląd, ocena oraz udział w zatwierdzaniu rozwiązań technicznych i dokumentacji dostawców, realizowane we współpracy z działem zakupów oraz liderami technicznymi.
  • Zapewnienie wsparcia technicznego w przypadku problemów eksploatacyjnych
  • Aktywna współpraca z zespołami wewnętrznymi (m.in. sourcing, projektowanie, inżynieria systemowa, zarządzanie projektami) oraz z klientami i dostawcami
  • Udział w ciągłym doskonaleniu procesów, procedur oraz standardów projektowych

Nasze wymagania:

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne (mechanika, energetyka, inżynieria procesowa, automatyka lub pokrewne)
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu systemów płynowych, paliwowych lub olejowych (mile widziane w branży energetycznej / turbinowej)
  • Praktyczna znajomość doboru komponentów hydraulicznych i olejowych, takich jak pompy, zawory, filtry, chłodnice oraz aparatura pomiarowa
  • Umiejętność wykonywania obliczeń hydraulicznych oraz analiz inżynierskich potwierdzających poprawność działania układów olejowych
  • Znajomość norm, przepisów i dyrektyw krajowych oraz międzynarodowych, takich jak: PED. Mile widziane: IEC, CE, UL/CSA, ATEX, NEMA.
  • Doświadczenie we współpracy z dostawcami i weryfikacji dokumentacji technicznej, w tym obliczeniowej
  • Umiejętność pracy w środowisku projektowym, zorientowanym na terminy, jakość i koszty
  • Silne umiejętności analityczne, rozwiązywania problemów oraz podejmowania decyzji
  • Zdolności komunikacyjne i umiejętność pracy w zespołach interdyscyplinarnych
  • Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (praca w środowisku międzynarodowym)

Pracując z nami

otrzymujesz

  • Prywatna opieka medyczna
  • 100% wynagrodzenia chorobowego
  • Grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie
  • Bezpłatne ładowanie samochodów elektrycznych
  • Dofinansowanie do wypoczynku
  • Świadczenie świąteczne
  • Dofinansowanie do zakupu okularów
  • Pożyczki mieszkaniowe i zapomogi
  • Dopłata do III filaru
  • Nagrody za polecenia pracowników
  • Nagroda za staż pracy
  • Karta sportowa
  • Elastyczne godziny rozpoczęcia pracy

title: GRC Engineer (NIST)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GRC Engineer (NIST) based in United States.

This role is an opportunity to contribute to cybersecurity and compliance programs supporting defense contractors and federal organizations.
You will help clients navigate NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and Risk Management Framework requirements throughout the authorization lifecycle.
The position combines technical analysis, compliance documentation, assessment readiness, and direct client collaboration.
You will play a hands-on role in developing SSPs, POA&Ms, gap assessments, and other critical authorization artifacts.
The environment is fast-paced, remote-first, and highly collaborative, with exposure to government cloud environments.
You will work alongside technical teams, assessors, and client stakeholders to turn complex requirements into practical security outcomes.
This is a strong opportunity for a detail-oriented GRC professional looking to deepen their federal compliance expertise and grow within an expanding consulting environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Execute NIST SP 800-53 control mappings and apply applicable security and privacy baselines to client architectures and environments.
  • Create, update, and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), security narratives, and other authorization documentation.
  • Conduct technical gap assessments, readiness reviews, and compliance analyses to prepare clients for federal ATO and FedRAMP authorization activities.
  • Support continuous monitoring activities, including vulnerability tracking, POA&M maintenance, monthly reporting, and change management.
  • Coordinate Assessment and Authorization activities with clients, third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs), and independent assessors.
  • Partner with technical teams to identify and remediate control deficiencies across Low, Moderate, and High security baselines.
  • Assist with documenting authorization boundaries, system interconnections, shared-responsibility models, and cloud security architectures.
  • Monitor updates to NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP requirements, and other federal cybersecurity policies, translating changes into actionable client guidance.
  • Manage multiple compliance workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, documentation quality, deadlines, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team culture through knowledge sharing, mentoring, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of assigned deliverables.

    • Requirements:

    • 2+ years of direct experience delivering GRC activities involving NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), or comparable federal compliance programs.
    • Hands-on experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining SSPs, POA&Ms, technical security narratives, and related authorization artifacts.
    • Foundational knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 controls and FedRAMP Moderate and High baselines.
    • Experience supporting ATO processes, 3PAO assessments, or federal authorization activities is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with government cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud or Azure Government and their security configurations.
    • Understanding of continuous monitoring processes, including vulnerability management, POA&M updates, and compliance reporting.
    • Exposure to CMMC 2.0 or NIST SP 800-171 and defense-industry compliance requirements is an advantage.
    • Relevant certifications such as CGRC, CAP, CISSP, or CompTIA Security+ are preferred.
    • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex compliance requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities without compromising quality.
    • Comfortable working independently in a dynamic consulting or startup environment, taking initiative and ownership while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
    • Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.
    • Able to work a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time, with occasional flexibility when business priorities require it.
    • Requires a reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home-office environment suitable for confidential client discussions and uninterrupted remote collaboration.
    • Willingness to travel locally on occasion for onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive base salary with regular performance reviews and merit-based compensation opportunities.
      • Bonus opportunities tied to performance.
      • Remote-first work culture with flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States.
      • Career development opportunities with mentorship and professional growth pathways.
      • Reimbursement for approved role-related training and certification courses.
      • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage company and take on increasing responsibility.
      • Collaborative environment with exposure to federal cybersecurity, compliance, cloud security, and authorization programs.

About the Role:

The Senior Power Platform Administrator is responsible for the administration, governance, and day-to-day operations of the Power Platform environment, including Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Pages. She/he ensures the reliability, availability, security, and compliance of Power Platform solutions in production, including monitoring platform health, capacity, and licensing, and troubleshooting or escalating incidents as needed.   • Configure and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, environment security roles, and access controls.

  • Monitor and manage licensing, capacity add-ons, and connector usage across the tenant.

  • Perform other related duties assigned by supervisor.

Incident and Problem Management:

  • Monitor production systems and respond to incidents, outages, and performance degradations; troubleshoot and resolve or escalate issues as needed.

  • Maintain and update operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and support documentation.

Governance and Compliance:

  • Conduct periodic security and compliance reviews of environments, connections, and solutions to ensure alignment with client's security framework.

  • Support audit, risk, and compliance reporting requirements related to Power Platform usage.

Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Management:

  • Provide guidance and mentoring to junior administrators and support staff.

  • Ensure post-deployment support and monitoring services are provided, at least for 12 months

  • 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Mon–Fri)

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
Number of Positions Available:

ABOUT US

The Salvation Army is a Christian movement and one of Australia's largest and most-loved charities. We believe in doing good that transforms lives and futures for the better. It is this belief which drives us to find new ways and places where we can make a difference. From times of personal crisis to moments of national grief, we are always here — providing support, safety, community, and opportunity.

Why this role matters
The Salvation Army (Salvos) Youth Services encompasses a range of programs for vulnerable young people, their families, and the community. Our services have a strong focus on prevention and early intervention and enable access to safe accommodation options, Holistic case management, community outreach programs and programs that teach vital independent living skills. Our centres are safe and supportive environments creating an ideal environment for growth, where participants feel believed in, valued, listened to, and respected.

About the role

As the Client Services Coordinator, you will lead a dedicated team of case managers delivering high-quality support to young people aged 16-25 who are experiencing or at risk of homelessness, ensuring services are aligned with the Journey to Independence Model and Psychologically Informed Environment (PIE) framework. Working across our refuge in St Kilda and supporting case managers in their outreach support across the Inner and Middle South regions of Melbourne, you will drive service excellence through strong leadership, operational oversight, stakeholder collaboration, and a commitment to achieving positive outcomes for young people.

Reporting to the Program Manager, this is a permanent full-time position, based on-site in St Kilda, VIC.

Conditions
Compensation is in accordance with the SCHADS Award Level 6.

How you will make an impact

  • Lead and provide supervision to a team of 6 case managers to deliver high-quality, client-centred services for young people experiencing or at risk of homelessness both in our refuge and through outreach support in the community
  • Be responsible for providing daily leadership, management and coordination of services delivered across the Upton Rd refuge site and ensure continuity of support across 24/7 service delivery in conjunction with the after-hours coordinator and after-hours support worker roles
  • Monitor client outcomes, service performance, and case management practice, providing guidance and support on case planning, supporting PIE-informed engagement with supporting young people towards their goals
  • Support and role-model proactive risk management and support ongoing quality and improvement actions across the service in conjunction with the leadership team
  • Foster strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to enhance service coordination, support pathways, and outcomes for young people
  • Drive continuous improvement through staff development, reflective practice, quality assurance, compliance monitoring, and the analysis of service data and emerging sector trends

What you will bring

  • Tertiary qualification in Social Work, Social Science or related field required
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to support and supervise staff to achieve high-quality service outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience delivering case management services within homelessness, youth, or community services settings
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with clients, colleagues, and stakeholders
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and respond effectively within a fast-paced crisis accommodation environment
  • A current Employee Working with Children Check
  • A current valid Driver's Licence


What we offer
The Salvos offer eligible employee's a well-balanced package of meaningful benefits including:

  • Salary packaging up to $15,900 tax free + $2,650 meal entertainment benefit
  • Generous Paid Parental leave for primary (12 weeks) & secondary carers, Purchased Leave Scheme (up to 8 weeks) and 5 days paid leave per year to experience working in other TSA programs or activities
  • Access to EAP and health & wellness initiatives incl Fitness Passport
  • Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander supports such as: Burra Burra Network (pastoral care network), Cultural Events, Sorry Business and Ceremonial Leave (up to 10 days)
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities that enhance on the job skills and proficiency
  • Rewarding and fulfilling purpose driven careers that have positive and sustainable / social impacts

How to apply

If you’re passionate about making a difference and ready to join a team dedicated to creating positive change, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your alignment with the requirements of the role. Together we can build a brighter future.

Applications will close as soon as a suitable candidate is secured.

The Salvation Army is an Equal Opportunity Employer who provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people. We value people of all cultures, languages, capacities, sexual orientations, gender identities and/or expressions. We are committed to achieving a diverse workforce and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal people and Torres Strait Islander people.

The Salvation Army is a child safe organisation and is committed to protecting children and young people from harm. All child facing roles will require the successful completion of a Working with Children Check. Applicants for all roles require a mandatory Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.

We value Integrity, Compassion, Respect, Diversity, and Collaboration

POSITION OVERVIEW: The Monitor Technician provides patient and family focused care as part of the health care team in accordance with the St. Charles Health System mission, philosophy, policies and procedures. Monitors ECG rhythms and reports observations to the RN. This position does not directly manage any other caregivers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES:

Recognizes and reports observation to RN.

Records observation and order summary in multiple areas of electronic medical record.

Follows delegation in the delivery of care.

Respects privacy, and maintains patients’ rights to decide about care.

Provides and maintains a safe environment for caregivers, patients and guests.

Documents with proficiency in compliance with hospital policies and regulatory agencies.

Demonstrates awareness of and supports St. Charles Health System’s departmental and operating unit goals through participation in continuous quality improvement and departmental activities.

Demonstrates knowledge of use and maintenance of equipment needed for assigned area. Demonstrates ability to set up equipment for use.

Demonstrates an awareness of cost containment and economical use of supplies and equipment.

Makes daily patient charges, as appropriate.

Recognizes ECG dysrhythmias and communicates changes in rhythm to RN and to charge nurse.

Supports the vision, mission and values of the organization in all respects.

Supports Value Improvement Practice (VIP- Lean) principles of continuous improvement with energy and enthusiasm, functioning as a champion of change.

Delivers customer service and/or patient care in a manner that promotes goodwill, is timely, efficient and accurate.

Conducts all activities with the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality. Complies with all applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures, supporting the organization’s corporate integrity efforts by acting in an ethical and appropriate manner, reporting known or suspected violation of applicable rules, and cooperating fully with all organizational investigations and proceedings.

May perform additional duties of similar complexity within the organization, as required or assigned.

EDUCATION

Required: High school diploma or GED.

Basic EKG class required within 6 months of hire.

Must be willing to take courses as requested to maintain competency.

Preferred: N/A

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION/REGISTRATION

Required: AHA Basic Life Support for Healthcare Provider certification.

Preferred: NTA Telemetry Certification (National Telemetry Association).

EXPERIENCE

Required: N/A

Preferred: Acute health care experience.

EKG, Monitor tech experience.

PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT

Must be able to wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required to perform the job safely.

ADDITIONAL POSITION INFORMATION:

Ability to effectively interact and communicate with all levels within St. Charles Health System and external customers/clients/potential employees.

Strong team working and collaborative skills.

Attention to detail.

Excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills.

Demonstrated ability and experience in computer applications, use of electronic medical record keeping systems and MS Office.

Ability to follow verbal and written communications in order to complete duties and assignments.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Continually (75% or more): Sitting, keyboard operation, use of clear and audible speaking voice and the ability to hear normal speech level.

Frequently (50%): Standing, lifting 1-10 pounds, grasping/squeezing.

Occasionally (25%): Bending, reaching overhead, carrying/pushing or pulling 1-10 pounds.

Rarely (10%): Walking, stooping/kneeling/crouching, climbing stairs.

Never (0%): Climbing ladder/step-stool, lifting/carrying/pushing or pulling 11-50 pounds, operation of a motor vehicle, ability to hear whispered speech level.

Exposure to Elemental Factors

Never (0%): Heat, cold, wet/slippery area, noise, dust, vibration, chemical solution, uneven surface.

No Risk for Exposure to BBP

description:

  • Competitive salary
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development
