Director – The Little Gym

Location: Wilmington, NC

Reports to: District Manager


About The Little Gym

The Little Gym began 50 years ago as a place where children could learn and grow through movement, fun, and imagination. Over time, it’s grown into a global community built on our unique Three-Dimensional Learning philosophy—Get Moving, Brain Boost, and Citizen Kid—helping children ages 4 months to 12 years build the confidence, skills, and life-readiness for life’s biggest adventures.


About the Role

As Program Director, you'll do more than lead classes—you'll shape the experience of hundreds of children and families each week while developing the next generation of coaches and leaders. If you love mentoring others, creating unforgettable customer experiences, and making a lasting impact on your community, this role offers a meaningful career with clear pathways for growth.


What You’ll Do:

  • Teaching:
    • Teach amazing, high-energy classes using our proven curriculum and method (don’t worry, we’ll train you!). It’s your biggest priority, so you have to love it.
    • Set the standard - you don’t just teach, you model what “best” looks like for the rest of the team.
    • Keep growing your own skills and understanding of the program and child development.
  • Leadership:
    • Be the face of your gym, leading with enthusiasm, care, and ownership.
    • Inspire, coach, and develop a team of instructors into confident, engaging educators who create magical experiences every day.
    • Create a fun, professional, growth-minded culture that encourages your team to strive for excellence.
    • Communicate often with your team and district manager (Slack, email, and in person), and share wins and ideas in weekly leadership meetings.
  • Sales and Operations:
    • Drive monthly enrollment and retention through strong relationships, service, and an understanding of key business metrics.
    • Connect with families on their first visit and convert them into raving fans and members.
    • Create a clean, safe, organized gym that delivers an exceptional family experience.
    • Build schedules that balance team needs, staffing, and labor goals.


What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
You'll know you're succeeding when:

  • Your classes consistently earn outstanding parent feedback.
  • Your instructor team continues advancing through certification levels.
  • Enrollment and retention are growing.
  • Families know your name.
  • Your gym is known for delivering exceptional experiences every day.
  • Your team loves coming to work.

You’d Fit in at The Little Gym if…

  • You love high-fives, laughter, and seeing kids light up when they learn something new.
  • You live to serve, and kids adore you, parents trust you, and your team looks up to you.
  • You love to have fun, but know when to buckle down and get to work.
  • You have a growth mindset—every instructor and every class can always get a little better.
  • You have a background in child development, physical education, leadership or gymnastics is strongly recommended but not required.
  • This role is a five-day work week, including one weekend day, and may flex to meet the needs of the gym.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with future bonus opportunities
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Long-term disability and 401(k)
  • Paid time off, sick time, and company holidays
  • Ongoing training and leadership development
  • Opportunities for career growth within Somersault
  • Employee discounts and a seriously fun work environment


Who We Are – Somersault Operating Inc.

Somersault Operating Inc. is the largest franchisee of The Little Gym, operating 30 locations across 8 states. We develop exceptional leaders through training, mentorship, and career growth while creating magical experiences that help children build confidence through movement and play.

To learn more about Somersault Operating Inc., please visit our website at www.somersaultco.com

title: Radio Frequency Engineer
description:
Job Title: RF Engineer

Location: Ashburn, VA

Terms: Fulltime, onsite position.

About Chartis Federal

Chartis Federal is a premier systems engineering and integration firm specializing in mission-critical IT and communications solutions for law enforcement, homeland security, and defense. As a trusted prime contractor with over $160 million in task order awards, we operate across 22 states and support essential government missions worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has fueled our year-over-year growth, earning us recognition twice as a Washington Technology FAST 50 company and securing a place on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years. At Chartis Federal, our mission is clear: keeping heroes safe and connected—on the battlefield, on the border, and in our backyards.


Position Overview

The RF Engineer will be responsible for the design, integration, and modernization of wireless communication systems, including point-to-point, mesh, and mobile networks. This role requires expertise in radio frequency (RF) engineering, wireless communication technologies, and IP networking, along with the ability to analyze system performance, conduct field testing, and optimize wireless networks. The ideal candidate will possess strong problem-solving skills and hands-on experience with link budgets, microwave path analysis, and power system design.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, integration and modernization of wireless communications systems (point to point, mesh and mobile)
  • Understand wireless communications technologies and concepts
  • Gather customer requirements, determine requirements, develop solutions; provide preliminary designs, cost estimates; support procurement and implementation of wireless communications systems
  • Compare wireless communications systems specifications to requirements and perform system performance validation including field testing.
  • Understand link budgets, microwave path analysis, mobile coverage analysis, interference analysis using computer simulation and data analysis tools.
  • Evaluate and design power systems supporting wireless communications systems including solar power
  • Experience planning transport and routing of IP data through gateways, switches and routers, document in network diagrams
  • Deploy and support wireless communications systems in the field, ability to troubleshoot and resolve connectivity issues.

title: Director, AI Transformation
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, AI Transformation based in United States.

This is a high-impact operating leadership role focused on making AI a fundamental part of how an organization works.
You’ll lead enterprise-wide transformation across business units and shared services, redesigning workflows around what AI makes possible.
The role combines applied AI expertise, operational strategy, process redesign, change management, and organizational enablement.
You’ll build practical AI capabilities, deploy virtual workers, and establish standards that support responsible, scalable adoption.
Success will be measured through tangible outcomes such as increased capacity, reduced cycle times, improved quality, and stronger margins.
You’ll work at an ambitious pace, influencing leaders and teams across the organization while turning AI opportunities into measurable business results.
This is an opportunity for a proven transformation leader to shape an AI-native operating model from the ground up.

Accountabilities:

  • Define the future-state operating model and establish a practical roadmap for becoming an AI-native organization.
  • Redesign core business workflows around AI-enabled possibilities rather than simply automating existing processes.
  • Identify, prioritize, and implement high-value AI transformation opportunities across business units and shared-service functions.
  • Build and oversee a digital workforce of virtual workers capable of taking on meaningful responsibilities with appropriate human oversight.
  • Establish AI capabilities across the organization through role-specific training, internal champions, enablement programs, and adoption measurement.
  • Define measurable operating-leverage targets, establish performance baselines, and validate realized benefits with Finance.
  • Own the internal AI tool stack, operating standards, governance principles, and pipeline of potential use cases.
  • Lead AI and automation initiatives from initial opportunity assessment through production implementation and organizational adoption.
  • Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes, establish new ways of working, and drive sustained adoption.
  • Manage change across teams and influence stakeholders who may be skeptical or resistant to new operating models.
  • Measure the business impact of transformation initiatives through metrics such as capacity created, cycle time reduction, quality improvements, and margin gains.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can create meaningful operational or commercial advantages.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrated experience personally leading AI or automation implementations into production within a real operating environment; hands-on implementation experience is essential.
    • Deep practical knowledge of applied AI, including large language models, agentic workflows, automation, integrations, and AI-enabled process design.
    • 10+ years of experience in operations, transformation, consulting, technology leadership, or a related field, including responsibility for organization-wide change.
    • Proven ability to map existing processes, identify opportunities for fundamental redesign, build improved workflows, and drive adoption.
    • Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable operational improvements that have been validated through credible business or Finance metrics.
    • Strong change-management capabilities, with the ability to influence stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
    • Executive presence and strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into practical business decisions and outcomes.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
    • Ability to move quickly, manage multiple transformation priorities, and operate effectively in an ambitious and fast-paced environment.
    • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build trust, coach teams, and bring diverse stakeholders together around shared objectives.
    • Professional services or consulting experience is a plus.
    • Experience with ERP or CRM implementations, EOS methodologies, or private-equity-backed organizations is beneficial but not required.

      • Benefits:
